text:
I was looking for a mat this size for a decent price and was happy when I saw this on Amazon for $10 after searching the site for a couple of hours. Once I got the mat, I was excited to use it in my bathroom. However, I was quite disappointed to see the permanent indentation down the middle because of how it was packaged. It was delivered in a slim box, folded in half causing unappealing fold lines down the middle (reason for 4 stars instead of 5). I tried pressing around the line with my fingers to see if I can get it to fill in a bit but, it didn't work.

I really like the mat but, I don't like how the fold lines make it look (see photo). I am thinking about returning it but, not sure yet. This should be delivered in a box slightly bigger than the mat so that it doesn't need to be folded for shipping. Or, possibly rolled up in a tube to prevent the fold lines. At least if it came rolled, it can always be rolled the opposite way to straighten it out or let it happen in time after use (stepping on it).

Update 12/5/2016: Changed rating from 4 to 5 stars. I contacted the seller about the fold lines in the mat I received. Seller responded promptly and immediately sent a replacement mat in a bigger box that was not folded (See second photo). Would definitely recommend!

title: Cleverly designed, quality leather belt for a surprisingly low price.
text:
This is a very nice genuine leather belt at a bargain price. The belt is much more adjustable than a traditional belt with holes and a prong. It also looks classy and has many buckle designs to choose from. I wasn't sure what kind of quality I could get for $9.99 including shipping and a nice box, but I was very pleasantly surprised.

The belt uses a ratchet system to tighten. On the back of the belt, from about 4 to 13 inches from the tip there is a strip of plastic sewn into the leather that has a sawtooth pattern. That catches a spring tensed metal latch on the buckle when tightening the belt. There is a small lever on the bottom of the buckle that releases the latch from the sawteeth when you want to loosen the belt. The sawteeth are about a quarter inch apart so the belt is much more adjustable than a standard belt. You also won't have the problem of wearing the leather out by pulling the end back to fit the prong into a belt hole. The belt is 53 inches long and will need to be cut to fit your size.

I just got the belt so I'm not sure about its durability. I suppose it is possible that the plastic sawteeth could wear out or chip off. However, I really like what I have so far and would highly recommend this belt.

title: Cute!!
text:
Few months ago I bought from Hiking World a black&white striped skirt and a couple of days ago they kindly sent me for free the top that matches the skirt to review it, even if a) I've never done it before and b) I don't know if I have a sense of fashion. So, bear with me and here I go.

Being quite insecure with my body and based on the photos of the top alone (modeled by a girl that probably is half my age and a third of my size), I wasn't sure what to expect - but I was pretty surprised when I received it and tried it on.

I asked for a large, because I'm not fond of clothes that stick too much to my body and judging by how the top fits me, I would say it's true to size. It's loose enough, comfy, soft, feels good and - when paired with certain clothes - doesn't makes me feel uneasy.
Don't get me wrong, it is short - laid flat, the large is 16" long by 15.5" wide - but I gave it a go with different possible pairings to see how versatile it could be and I found out that it seems to work well with different styles.
Also, the fabric is 100% modal, not see through and stretchy.

For reference, I'm 5'4", 125 pounds, 36B. I'm attaching few photos to give an idea of what I'm talking about - hope they help to decide if the top may work for you or not. I tried it with the striped skirt, shorts, high waist pants, a maxi skirt and - bonus! - being loose enough, the size large allowed me to layer the top on a tank top and I used it to do yoga!

If you have questions, I'll be happy to answer :) !

title: NOT 20-30 mmHg! More like 8-15 mmHg, or a good pair of workout tights.
text:
These are fine compression leggings if you only need mild compression, like you'd get from a good pair of workout tights. They are not fit for medical use.

I have POTS and have been buying the 20-30 mmHg stockings sold on Amazon by Briteleaf, which work quite well for me, but I thought it would be nice to try a pair of footless ones instead of just open toe, as I have problems with the foot part bunching in my boots sometimes.

These were a complete waste of money for me. They're not even skin-tight all the way up--I have regular leggings that are tighter--much less providing adequate compression. They're fine leggings, but I have plenty of leggings--I need graduated 20-30 mmHg compression, like the title said these were.

It may be possible to size down and get good compression in these, but I'm already wearing the smallest size.

Now I have to pay for 1-day shipping for another pair from Briteleaf so I can stop feeling awful, and I'm out the money for these, which were more expensive!

Please, be responsible and change the title to reflect your product accurately!

title: NOT UPF 50. PROVIDES LITTLE TO NO PROTECTION AGAINST UVA.
text:
Everything but the visor part itself is made of a gauzy mesh that provides exactly as much UV protection as it looks like it would.

How do I know? I have lupus, and after wearing it outside for 20 minutes I was horribly sick--about the same as if I didn't wear any cover-up, whereas a regular hoodie lessens it and real UPF 50+ fabric basically prevents it.

I have no idea whether this will help prevent sunburn, but I can tell you that sunburn is caused by UVB rays and my immune response is caused by UVA rays, which are also the ones that cause premature aging.

So if other people are saying that this works because they haven't gotten sunburnt, their skin could be getting aged while they wear this thing and they wouldn't even know it.

There are many true UPF 50+ products on the market. Buy one of them.

title: Cute dress
text:
Length
This is a nice, simple dress. I am 5’2” and hoped that based on the other reviews that it shrinks in the wash that it would fit perfectly. It is close, but still a little long. I’m guessing it would be a perfect length (for me that is almost to the floor) for someone who is about 5’5”.
Quality
I washed before wearing and when it came from the wash, it had some “pilling”, those little fabric balls on the bottom third of the skirt. The fabric is not a great quality. I don’t know how long this dress will last because of the fabric quality.
Pockets
I was thrilled that it had pockets, but they are not very deep. I have another dress with pockets that are a bit deeper and I love it. My iPhone 8+ (granted it is a HUGE phone) was protruding from the pocket.
Final thoughts
This is a cute dress. I love the empire waist. I received a number of compliments when I wore it. I hope the fabric holds up. Based on everything, I would probably buy again. If the fabric was a little better, it would be a no brainer.

title: Size chart found with item photos is misleading
text:
The pants look as described and appear well made. I followed their size chart found with the photos, but they ended up being way too big. I ordered the XXL, because their size chart indicated this as a match for my size. They are long; I'm 5'7" tall -inseam 31"- and the XXL definitely covered my feet and then some. The weight of the lace bell-bottoms tend to pull the pants downward -they need to fit snug but not tight to stay up properly. Other reviewers stated these pants have a 'lot of stretch' to them. Believe the reviews!
My advice is to order at least one size down from their measurements' recommendations. I am reordering these in a size large. Would have been 5+ stars if the sizing wasn't so off.

Update 2 weeks later:
Received the exchange; they fit so much better! From XXL down to size L.

title: Fit and feel like cotton athletic socks
text:
I have a few clothing items made from merino wool that I use for camping/backpacking. It's not as scratchy as other wools - soft like cotton, but still with the warmth and water-resistance one expects from wool. I prefer 100% merino wool stuff - socks + base layer - for cold weather camping.

These socks are a merino wool-synthetic blend. They are still soft and weather-resistant but not especially warm. It's honestly hard to distinguish them from the cotton-poly moisture-wicking Hanes socks I've got in my drawer, at least in terms of fit and feel.

Short story: I can't say anything bad about these socks, but these aren't for cold weather.

title: Light and sturdy
text:
These are my first folding trekking poles, and I like these so much better than my old aluminum telescoping poles. The shafts fold much shorter (15") than my old poles (over 25") which means I'm so much more likely to bring these poles along on casual hikes since they fit completely inside my day pack. Also, a huge plus is that they'll easily fit inside my carry on bag when I'm traveling. These poles are also easy to hight-adjust since once you assemble the three parts; there is only one hight adjustment to make instead of two on a telescoping pole.

The composite shaft helps to make these very light. Each pole is 211g/7.44oz without tips or baskets. I like that they seem very sound -- they don't rattle or buzz when you plant. I'm 6'0" and these are the perfect size for me: I set the length at 120-123 CM and still can shorten 5 CM when going uphill. My wife is 5'6" and 115 CM is good for normal walking but there's no room to go shorter than 115CM for uphill. I wouldn't recommend these poles for anyone shorter than 5'6".

The wrist straps are not padded like the ones on my old poles, but these straps are very smooth and soft which seems okay. I have walked about 6 miles with these and they haven't given me any problems. The straps are easy to adjust -- just pull on the loose end to tighten. The foam hand grips seem very comfortable. These poles came complete with rubber tips, three basket sizes: 2", 3.5" and 4" diameter, a handy storage bag, and two elastic bands, which are handy keeping the poles together when not using the storage bag.

Keep on trekkin'!

title: Absolutely beautiful, just somewhat lacking....
text: This watch is absolutely gorgeous - the style is can be casual or dressy, the watch faces can be changed, the band is comfortable and sleek. That being said - this is a very expensive watch.....and while the price tag definitely is associated with the Marc Jacobs brand there are some features that one would expect would be more streamlined given the price. I recieved this product in return for my honest review, but had i paid full price I would probably be a bit annoyed. As someone who has been a long time Fitbit user, I was hoping that this would be a more stylish version of what I have become accoustomed to with my other trackers. Unfortunately, there is a lot the needs to be “cleaned up” with the GoogleWear app (this is the associated tracking app) which really makes me uneasy about the validity and consistency of the tracking results. The watch is beautiful and the touch screen is very responsive, yet it is also very large. Coming from the Fitbit Alta, I had a hard time getting used to this watch. I do have naturally small wrists and the watch face just completely covered my whole wrist. Additionally, the band came undone several times (negative) but the watch wasn’t even the slightest bit damaged or scratched after falling both on a concrete basement floor and in a parking lot (positive)! However, the unsteadiness of the band made me really uneasy about wearing it (given the price) which pretty much takes away from the intended functionality.  All in all - absolutely beautiful - and such an attractive concept - just needs some work on the band design and adjustment and wish the associated app was stronger.

text:
Product: Men’s Fashion Braided Leather Wrap Wrist Bracelet
By: Zhenhui
Pros: Two colors (black & brown), genuine leather, metal clasps, unique design
Cons: -

My Experience:
I like the look of nice leather bracelets; it is the casual, rugged impression that lends a nice touch to a casual outfit. And, it is kind of sexy. :) The only thing that really messes up the vibe is a badly made bracelet or one made of plastic trying to be leather. Right out of the pouch, Zhenhui’s leather bracelets are attractive and the quality is clear. Plus, they have that amazing leather scent…

They come in two sizes (8” and 8.2”), so it’s possible to share with someone else whose wrist may be a bit larger/smaller. I adjusted mine to fit my wrist a little better. I am not sure that it is something that is meant to be done or simply possible because of the stainless steel clasp’s design. It was easy to do and did not damage either of the bracelets.

The embellishments are unique and encourage others to look at them and I’ve received so many complements on them! I especially like that they look great on any gender.

Zhenhui makes the following claims about their Men’s Fashion Braided Leather Wrap Wrist Bracelet:
Material: brown leather, black leather, raw leather, stainless steel clasp. (True)
Size: one length is 8 inch, one length is 8.2 inch. (True)
Perfect Match: Pack of 2 pcs. (True)

Conclusion:
Zhenhui’s braided leather bracelets are attractive, made to last, are unique, and add an additional “pop” to a casual look. I believe they would make an excellent gift for anyone who likes unique jewelry and cool, understated fashions. The leather is soft enough not to irritate or appear to be stiff, but sturdy enough that you do not have to watch your every move while wearing them. Overall, I am very pleased with this purchase, and would recommend to anyone who is searching for a thoughtful gift or distinctive bracelet.

title: A New Twist
text: I love little things out of the ordinary like these glasses.  Something different from everyone else, I don't follow trends well. Lol. They are sturdy and has a close fit. Or my head is just big. :). They are great in the sun, not overly blue and just brightens everything. I have extremely sensitive eyes so if these didn't reflect the harmful rays, I would know!  I normally wear Oakley and the comparison is close. Very close. My eyes feel relaxed and comfortable. I'm not having to squint and they do not distort color, which I love about them. The frames are sleek and strong and will absolutely hold up to me, and that's saying a lot, I'm clumsy and hard on things. I am always dropping my glasses, I put them on my head and forget them. The next thing I know I'm bumping them on something. The case is well built as well. Lined with a velvet cover to protect the lenses and a magnetic closure that works oh so well. I couldn't even get it to stay open long enough to snap a picture of the inside before they snapped shut. I would recommend these sunglasses to anyone in my family or abroad. I did receive a bit of a discount, not too much for my honest and unbiased opinion of the glasses and that is absolutely what you got. I would buy again at full price. I found a pair of Costo glasses similar to these several months back and fell in love with them but the price......whew, I just could NOT see paying over $200 for a pair of sunglasses that were subjected to my abuse.

text:

title: Too See-Through
text: This blouse is light, pretty, and feminine. I'm 5"2, petite, and in between a small and a medium; the medium size fits me perfectly, just like the model pictured. I like that it offers a casual, bohemian look that pairs very well with jeans, but it's nice enough to also be worn in more formal settings; I think it would go well with some skirts. [Although my fiance did say it looked "like a weird medieval peasant wedding gown" when he first saw me in it.] Its light layers are breezy and cool. The problem is that, even though there is another layer sewn beneath the very sheer outer layer, it's still pretty see-through. If you wear a darker bra under it, the bra will be very visible even from some distance, and even a white bra can be seen through it. So unless you want to be REALLY bohemian, you'll have to wear a tank top underneath. Also, I find the sleeves a bit weird. They're quite tight around the wrists, and the sleeve material is almost transparent, so your arms show through in a way that just looks sort of strange. Even though I almost like it a lot, because of its design, I'm probably not going to end up wearing this blouse all that much.

title: Cute costume, but waist band size is off
text: Since I'm a boring working mom who doesn't sew and doesn't have a crafty bone in her body, I bought this scrub/coat set for my 6 year old for Halloween this year so he could be a doctor (I bought a stethoscope separately).  He's autistic and Halloween can be very tricky because he is very sensitive about things he wears (masks are completely out of the question).  He's very average in terms of height, weighs 50 lbs and has a lean, muscular build.  I ordered the M 6x-8 size.  In terms of length, I'd say everything is about right for that size.  I expected that I would have to roll up the pant legs and possibly the coat arms, but the waist band size is almost too small for a 6 y/o and would be crazy tight on an 8 year old.  They really missed the mark on the elastic waist which is why I docked a couple stars.  I don't think it will be too uncomfortable on my son to wear for parties and trick or treating, but it's definitely snug.  For sure size up if you're in doubt, even if you have to hem or roll up arms and legs!  Also, I was a little disappointed that the coat doesn't have any buttons or snaps, but otherwise it's not bad for the price.  Though I wish it fit better, I'm glad I found this and can check off another Halloween costume!  Hopefully we can use it for a career day at some point as well haha!

title: Professional all weather dog hiker tested and approved!!
text: [[VIDEOID:618819090831e8f113552c18ce773ff0]] Yup, you read that right.  I am a professional dog hiker.  I take dogs off leash pack hiking on the foothill and mountain trails around the Salt Lake valley every morning, M-F for 3-5 miles (an hour and a half) in ANY weather (rain, snow, sleet, hail or blazing sun).  This poncho has become one of the things I can't live without in my dog van.  I have put it to the test in rain, sleet and snow and stayed nice and dry!  It's thick without feeling heavy.  I love the hood.  I love that you can make/adjust the "sleeves" with the snaps.  That is SUPER useful.  That way you can pop your hands out of small openings if you need to use them (which I do) but can easily pull your arms and and hands back inside for full coverage when needed.  I have a top of the line Mammut brand rain jacket that used to be the only thing I would use in wet conditions, however, I also wear a Camelbak backpack that isn't water proof.  It does come with a waterproof shell to protect most of the pack when needed, but I have to pull that out and put it on which can be a pain and it doesn't protect the entire bag.  Also, the jacket and rain shell do nothing for my legs.  In 5 seconds I can throw this poncho on over my body AND my backpack and have full dryness coverage from my head to about my shins.  I wear waterproof hiking boots and water resistant socks and pants on rainy days so that pretty much means completely dry!  I can't tell you what a difference it makes to be able to hike without having soggy undies!  I have also put this poncho to the test walking through scrub bushes and trees and have had ZERO tears or rips in the fabric.  5 stars very well earned!  Oh and I also love that it comes with a little zipper pouch to store it in when dry and that it actually CAN be folded up and put back in there easily after the first use haha.  RECOMMEND!

title: Puts all of our beanies to SHAME in warmth and comfort!
text: The material quality and comfort of this hat is TOP NOTCH!  I was hoping it would fit my head better but it's really quite large.  I'm a 37 y/o woman with a very average head and while it will stay on (especially with the flaps down and tied), it is NOT designed with my head size in mind.  My husband however has a much larger head and it fits him perfectly!  He's much more concerned about fashion over function than I am so I don't know if he'll be wearing it out other than for shoveling snow or maybe walking the dog very early in the morning, but truly it is PERFECT for that purpose during our long cold Salt Lake City winters!  It's supposed to be 9 degrees this week and it's not even November yet.  This is the warmest hat we have ever had in our house.  It puts every beanie we own to SHAME!  Another thing I love about this hat is that unlike most of my beanies which eventually give me ear fatigue (I have stick out ears that don't like being pinned to my head by hats or headphones) these ear flaps cause no ear fatigue whatsoever!!  I'll probably wear it for that reason alone, even if it is a little on the large side for my head.  Elmer Fudd would be proud!

title: My 7 y/o LOVES his "Dragon Feet"!
text: My 7 year old (we got the big kid 4/5) has a plush dragon that he adores and LOVES these slippers!  They're the first slippers he's ever had and he calls them his "Dragon feet".  They're probably supposed to be dinosaurs or monsters but to him they're dragon feet.  What is significant is that he as autism and is VERY particular about what he puts on his feet (or his body period for that matter)!  These slippers stay on (though are a little big) and best of all he finds them comfortable enough to keep on his feet for hours at a time while playing all over the house!  I never thought he'd voluntarily wear slippers, let alone love them, but he loves these!  The material on the soles could be a little more heavy duty to make them last longer, and the interior tag is obnoxious (had to cut them off).  Also, my son doesn't know what he's missing, but I wish they had chosen a softer, fleecier fabric for the interior but otherwise we're big fans of these over here!  I can definitely recommend for kids for fun.  Would make a very cute Christmas gift.  Just so you know either slipper can go on either foot.  There is no left or right, which makes it even easier for kids to put on themselves.

title: Quality materials/Runs too large in the waist and bust areas.
text: I have eight children. Eight. When people ask, “How do you do it?!” I reply, “I eat a lot of chocolate.” It’s true. Chocolate comes in so many delicious forms, each one designed to grant a few minutes of sanity-saving endorphin release, that it is my go-to coping mechanism. Unfortunately, both motherhood and nature’s stress reliever have blessed me with a few extra pounds around the middle and on my upper thighs. Enter the dreaded swimsuit season. The fashion industry has come up with two solutions to these problems; ruching to disguise slight fat rolls, and boy-cut bottoms to hide thigh girth. This swimsuit has both, and I was offered the opportunity to pick one up at a discount, in exchange for an honest review. I figured I have nothing to lose, so here we go, the pros: The swimsuit arrived neatly folded in a reusable plastic zippered bag. Save it, as it will come in handy for stashing a wet swimsuit into your gym bag or car. The seams are well-sewn and the fabric is sturdy and thick. It is comfortable and not binding. This swimsuit would be really flattering to my figure if it weren’t for the cons: First, it simply doesn’t fit me. I try to be realistic, so I ordered the size that I normally wear, as opposed to the size that I’d like to wear. It is too long in the waist. I am 5’8”, so I don’t have an especially short waist, but this swimsuit is way too long. I thought, okay, maybe it’s just a little extra ruching, and I pulled it up so that all of the extra fabric was at the waist. That’s when I really noticed the draft in my nether-regions. The fabric that is supposed to cover my girl parts is way too narrow (or the leg holes are way too wide) if pulled up, leaving me exposed on the sides of my crotch. I haven’t had a Brazilian, so imagine how attractive that must be, and it kind of negates the coverage on the upper thigh, anyway. Unfortunately, when I pulled it back down to once again cover my upper thighs, the fabric at the groin hung down about two inches. Finally, I am currently breastfeeding my youngest, so I have an ample bosom. I’m sporting D’s, yet I don’t even fill the (very nice quality sewn-in underwire) cups. I do wish that the built-in bra extended all the way around to the back for extra support for my “girls.” Tying them up using the straps at the neck just doesn’t win the battle against gravity. Perhaps all of these problems will be rectified if I exchange it for a smaller size. I'll give it a 3 star rating in the meantime. Disclaimer: Before making a purchase, I research a product thoroughly, and I depend on honest reviews to aid in my decision making. This product was received for free or at a discount in exchange for an honest and unbiased review. While I have shaken my head at some of the 5-star reviews I have seen other professional reviewers give to lousy 1-star products, simply because they received them for free, I do my best to keep my reviews thorough and unbiased. I won’t give a good rating to anything that I wouldn’t be willing to shell out my own hard-earned cash for. Feel free to ask any questions that you may have. If this review has been helpful for you, please indicate by hitting the “yes” button below.

title: One of The Most Disappointing Amazon Finds
text:
For the longest time, I have wanted a good pair of flare jeans. When I saw these, I thought that they were funky and cool. I thought they would be an excellent way to spice up any outfit. The material of the jeans is more like jeggings which is unfortunate because I was hoping the material would be like regular denim. However, they are stretchy, which can be a plus.

They are also very long. I am 5’6, and I would have to wear them with heels or boots so that the fabric is not dragging on the floor. They were loose on the legs but tight on the hips. I was hoping that these jeans would work because I have wanted them for a long time, but they just did not. I ended up giving these pants to my sister, who has a different body type than me, and they looked lovely on her.

Overall, I feel unsatisfied and upset with how these looked on me. The jeans were uncomfortable because they were tight on the hips and loose on the legs. They were also way too long, so they would only work if you have long legs or wear them with heels. I gave them to my sister, so I am happy they worked for someone, but I wanted them to work for me. I am incredibly displeased and unhappy with these jeans.

title: Good Jacket But Could be Better
text:
Since my gym class started this semester, I have needed a workout jacket, and I found this one. This jacket is good, but alas, it is not to my fullest expectations. I have organized my thoughts by category for your convenience.

THE FIT
The jacket fits me like a glove in the best way! I am 5'4, 125 pounds, have a 34-35" bust and a 27-28" waist; the medium was perfect. I ordered according to the size chart, and I recommend you do the same. It is accurate. However, I will note that the thumb holes are very uncomfortable. I feel like they are digging into my skin and pulling my thumbs; it is pretty unpleasant for long periods.

THE FEEL
I do not care for the feel as much as I do the fit. The jacket has a cheap swimsuit-like material, and I had higher expectations for $35. It is not uncomfortable, nor is it super comfortable. It is just meh. You can probably do better than this for less.

WORKOUT
I have yet to use this jacket in my class, but it is a sturdy jacket from the feel of it. I do not have any concerns in that regard. I will use it tomorrow and update the review if things change.

CONSENSUS
I probably would not recommend this jacket. It is on the pricier side for something that is, all in all, just average. It fits amazingly and is very flattering, but its overly apparent flaws overshadow that. I recommend you look elsewhere for a better jacket unless you desire a specific color.

The purse itself is pretty stiff as you would expect a patent item to be, but I can see that mine is starting to loosen the more that I use it. There are snaps on both ends of the purse to make it just a tad smaller, but I found that I like it better in the unsnapped position as it makes it easier to get to the items inside.  My purse did not have any smell to it as some of the other reviewers had noticed. What I like best about this purse is how nicely it stands up and does not flop and fall over.  I will be getting a lot of use out of this purse. I did received this item at a discount in exchange for an honest, unbiased review, and I am grateful for that opportunity.

title: Love this little wallet!
text: The LifeTek front pocket leather wallet was exactly what I was looking for. Although this item says it’s for men, I bought in anyway because of the design. I wanted an item like this that would hold  a few credit cards, drivers license and a little bit of cash. I also wanted to be able to put this in my front pocket without a lot of bulk. This wallet certainly filled all those desires. The wallet only measures 4” x 2 ¾” and is very thin. The high grade quality leather used in the manufacturing design is very evident as it is soft and luxurious. With a slot to put your driver’s license that has a see through plastic cover, allows you to show your license without having to remove it from the wallet. I really like that feature as the fewer times you have to remove cards, the less wear and tear you will have on your wallet. With two card slots on the back, each slot will hold three cards each, although I only have a total of three cards in order to keep my wallet very slim. The wallet opens slightly across the top and one side so that if you wanted to slide a bill or two inside, you can do that as well.  When I have this inside my front pocket I can’t even tell it is there, and you really can’t see that it adds any bulk to the look of my pants. The only thing I may have a problem with is forgetting that it is inside my pants pocket. I would hate to run this through the washer as I really like this little wallet. I don’t think either a man or woman can go wrong with this leather wallet. This does come in a nice gift box ready for wrapping.  I did receive a discount on this item for an honest, unbiased review. I can guarantee that this review is honest as I really love this item.

Yes, the plaid does not match up, but because of the cut and style of the dress, it appears as if that is part of the design, so it works. The fabric is thin. Depending on the conditions of the room and the color of your dress, you might need a slip. The dress was easy to slip on.  The belt it comes with is just a simple sash in the same pattern. It really need to be an inch wider so it covers the waist seam. I replaced it with a black suede sash belt that matched my boots, and it looked great. The look on my body, however, wasn’t so great. text:
This wallet is so great. I needed a small wallet for a ridiculously tiny purse. I found this after a bit of searching and then wondered what took me so long. I have another one of these in a smooth lighter pink leather that I carry my government ID in for work. I use this every day. I have a larger wallet in my pocket book to carry my less frequently used cards. This one is small enough to put in a pants pocket so a woman doesn't have to take her purse with her. I love the bright pink color. The pebbled leather feels quality and having had another leather wallet by this company for a while I feel certain it will hold up and look good for a long time.

I don't keep much in it. Two cards per slot fits, but makes it feel thick. Also, while the center pouch is zippered, I prefer to not carry change in it. It makes it fat quickly. I like to carry a small amount of folding money, a few credit cards, frequent diner cards, my driver's license and that is about it. It would hold more, but I think it's thinness is it's best quality.

title: Three Way Convertible Bag with Canvas and Leather Retro Look
text:
I like the FRESION BAGS CO. MESSENGER BRIEFCASE BAG as it can be used as Backpack, Briefcase or Shoulder Bag. When used as Briefcase both Shoulder and Backpack Straps are hidden away in enclosed compartments.

The FRESION Messenger Bag is lightweight. Construction is of retro looking Grey/Brown canvas with leather straps, zipper pulls, handles and accent. There are nine (9) zippered pockets showing on the outside of the bag and one inside. I like that all the little compartments have zippers which keeps smaller items from falling out. The largest compartment will house a computer and there is three inches of space for business meetings materials. The internal zipper section is here also. The computer space is padded with an elastic security strap over the top. The other large compartment is good for quickly needed files, calculator, pens and pencils.

Even when almost empty the case will stand on its own. This facilitates putting items into the bag, finding things and removing used documents. The Backpack Straps have their own zippered compartment. They are totally out of the way when not in use. The same is true for the shoulder strap which fits into a slotted compartment on the cover material of the backpack straps. There is a slotted compartment on the other side of the bag. When the bag is used in shoulder or backpack mode the carry straps fold away into these same two compartments and secured with magnetic snap. There are two “D” rigs on one end of the bag. All of the interior is lined in a satin type material.

Recommended Five ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Star

title: Outdoor Umbrella Feels sturdy…subdued red Chili color… single crank raises/lowers/tilts
text:
The TEMPERA (ASIN- B09NW1VKH6) CHILI 🌶 COLOR TILT OUTDOOR UMBRELLA arrives assembled and ready to use. The bottom post section of the ten foot (10’) tall umbrella slides into a weighted base ( not provided ). The top section of Umbrella and crank assembly slides into the bottom post locking in place with push-button spring loaded detent. As I have an existing post in place I tested compatibility finding the top half of the Tempera Umbrella works fine with my post. However, we are using the manufacturer post as provided.

The crank requires 14 revolutions (360 degree turns) to raise or lower the awning. After awning is raised, continuous crank will tilt the top to user desired location. As it is cloudy day we only tested tilt a few degrees and returned it to straight position.

The Chili 🌶 color is NOT bright. In our opinion it is subdued and pleasing to our eyes. There is no stripe in the material. There are black speckles along with darkened red background. We like it! It adds color but not overpowering.

The umbrella kit includes the top half which is the Umbrella and all controls, the bottom post to fit into weighted base and User Instruction Pamphlet. Permanently attached to the material is a two inch (2”) strap of the same material, with Hook and Loop fasteners, to secure around the awning.
Recommended Five ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Star

title: Lightweight talking Watch connects with APP and Bluetooth
text:
[[VIDEOID:7ace2370399902867ebce2d61f0e8ae3]] FIVE SENSES ATOMIC WATCH 3rd generation talking watch is supplied with User Setup Instructions Manual, extra battery with tool to replace battery. The band is expansion style and is aluminum look matching the case which appear to be aluminum.

The watch arrives charged but not activated. Press of top side button activates watch. Once activated there is NO, OFF switch. Setup requires download of Android or IOS APP. Bluetooth on cell = ON. The APP requires NAME and EMAIL address. Attempt to avoid providing this information, stops setup. It also causes APP confusion.

Backward to restart setup ….. Insert name-email. Next screen requires pressing lower right button. Instructions State … “ Press/Release” - that step, will NOT work. Press until TONE IS HEARD - then Pairing will commence. This was no issue. We were in 8:xx AM time zone and watch in 9:xx AM setting. It proceeded to wind through all of the hours until it returned to “7:xxAM time” No…this is not an error. Time shown on face of Watch is ONE HOUR BEHIND ACTUAL TIME - INCORRECT! VOICE PROMPT does state CORRECT time. Time SHOWN in APP is CORRECT time. WATCH is not usable showing time one hour behind actual time!

Cleared APP … Reloaded APP… Same result. Except this time I had to go through several screens to prove I was not a BOT.

LAST ATTEMPT….. RESET Watch by holding lower button over ten seconds until hearing beep. ( Twice )
Erased and Reloaded APP …. Completed Setup procedure with no issue.
RESULT…. Watch Face Time = One Hour behind actual time
Voice Prompt states correct time ….. Time shown on APP FACE is Correct Time

Manufacturer has used EMAIL INFORMATION to send direct communication to user before this review has been published by Amazon. NOT Recommended…. One ⭐️ Star

title: Excellent for the price
text:
These leggings compress the abdomen enough to help with dizziness on standing (not exactly POTS but you get the idea), as long as you size down once. Usually I am medium/large, I got small/medium, 5'2" 150. They are very similar at the top to the Simiya shaping shorts in that regard.
I have one small complaint and then a huge bonus.
Complaint: Tiny hole, appeared to be a manufacturing error, on the left leg seam near the ankle. Easily mended, has held up on gentle wash cycle in cold water and air dry (method I use for all compression garments)
Bonus: I got caught in a downpour the first day I wore them. They are more moisture wicking and fast-drying than my very expensive sporting goods store athletic leggings (which don't give me the needed compression)!
Absolutely worth the $7 I paid for them, came back and bought more. They will not keep you warm in winter, but no need for compression socks underneath like a lot of my other leggings, which makes them a solid option for spring, fall, and early summer.

title: Love these 100% organic Cotton, adjustable ear loops, no metal, kids masks
text:
Dual layer, with pocket option where you can add in an additional filter sold separately. Supper soft cotton and mentioned to be organic as well, which is important since your young child will be breathing through this all day into their delicate lungs. No metal in mask at all around nose which at times gets messed up over time from bending and washing mask. The ear loops are elastic, comes with double barrel on each ear loop and even a generous knot tied on the end to prevent the barrels from coming off. There is also elastic on the top and bottom of the mask to help with comfort on the child face. I was happy with other masks that I have had in the past but these make me rethink, as these are a true 5 star item ... actually 6 star. I wish they came with the filters or even a neck strap to secure and not loose but those items can be bought separately to make this full proof.
Happy to recommend and appreciative that I found these.

title: 4 stars only because of the clasp on the band
text: Just received today. The only part I don't like is the clasp on the band is very difficult to use. I already purchased a nato band for it anyway so I never intended to use the leather band that came with it. Tritium is just right, not too bright but bright enough to see the time clearly in total dark. Very good quality construction, nice size and weight. I will update this post after six months so we can see how well it holds up but first impression is that it's a damn fine watch! Update, so after about 6 months of nonstop wear I have to say I'm extremely impressed. The movement has only lost about 45 seconds which is almost unheard of. I have several high end watches that don't hold a candle to this model. I can't believe they aren't more popular and higher priced. I am already shopping for another one but this time I'm going for a formal look, I tried putting a stainless steel band on this one but it just didn't look right. If you are looking for a tritium watch at a great price then you should definitely buy from these guys, you won't be disappointed. Be aware the watch band is not a typical style but I had already decided to use a nylon band before I even purchased the watch.

title: Affordable Excellence
text:
SHORT STORY/SUMMARY AT END, LONGER STORY FOLLOWS HERE:

Just because one may be able to unload the wallet, or load up the plastic, to buy a decent (or even a pricey) automatic watch doesn't necessarily mean one wants to spend a small fortune to keep it wound when not on the wrist. While a Swiss KubiK or Orbita might be an amazing luxury home for your luxury time piece, the cost is just not desired for some folks, leaving us searching for more affordable options.

After a lot of research on what brands get the job done right, but don't cost a mortgage payment, my go to brand was Wolf, and I love the single winder I have from them. It's beautiful, silent, and performs brilliantly. But, when it came time for a double winder to add, for the slowly growing Swiss collection, shelling out four hundred dollars plus just seemed a lot, if I could get the same overall quality for less. I'd rather put that money in the Future Watches piggy bank, quite frankly, or help to make a payment on a watch already bought.

Having ruled out the super cheap brands, and still wanting top notch fit and finish, a full range of individual control options and reliable performance, I came across the Belocia brand and found that Amazon carried it. Reviews seemed a bit mixed, but for less than half the price of a Wolf, it seemed worth trying.

On arrival, it was well packaged, not a single scratch, and I was impressed it came with a storage cover and cleaning cloth. Controls were simple to figure out, cycling through each winder to individualize turns-per-day, direction of rotation and power status (on or off). I love that I can program each of the winders individually and I appreciate the wide range of settings which can be matched up appropriately for any watch.

It's a really beautiful piece of furniture, and is extremely well made, easily as pleasing as my Wolf. Gorgeous finish, latch and hinges are great quality and it operates in complete silence.

The only drawback is as others have noted -- concern for the watch bracelet/strap. Wolf provides a spring pillow which holds any size watch securely without any strain. Belocia gives us here a three springed system. It has upper and lower compressible padded pushers around which the bracelet or strap goes, at the top and bottom of the watch case holder and these are, thankfully, quite gentle, but then there is a main back rear pusher with a very aggressive spring, where the watch strap or bracelet closure rests, and that is the cause for possible concern.

There are two pad options for the back pusher, a thick one and a thin one, but even with the thin one it just seems they went overboard on spring tension. Plus, the pads on all three pushers are hard rubber, with almost no give, which only adds to the element of strain. Yes, the watch is held securely, but it is apparent that a more bracelet friendly set up might be much preferred.

For my leather strap watches, with clasp closure, I can just adjust the strap larger for more give and almost no strain when in the holder, but it's a little annoying to have to re-size the strap each time I want to wear it or return it to the winder. Of course for the bracelet ones, I don't have that option, so it just strains the bracelet.

While it is a concern, I'm not seeing any actual signs of wear or damage to the pins or bracelet, so my thought is that it seems worse than it is, and, with a high quality watch, the level of pressure exerted by the holder is likely negligible, or even non-existent, but it just seems that constant stress could be done away with if Belocia redesigned their holder mechanism.

So, why five stars still? Well, first because I have yet to find any account of this spring tension issue actually causing any problems. And, second, at this price point I think the winder definitely delivers, and in fact seems worth much more than the asking price, in terms of craftsmanship and performance. A bit of paranoia on bracelet stress doesn't warrant a drop to four stars, however, I think, until they ever redesign the holder to be more bracelet conscious, I would say I recommend this more for adjustable leather strap pieces, since continuous strain on a bracelet just seems something to avoid, regardless of the level of potential risk of damage or premature wear to the pins or links or clasp. Maybe that's just for peace of mind, given that a well constructed solid stainless steel bracelet may well be unperturbed by a bit of spring force, but such is my opinion, for what it's worth.

Overall, I think this is an excellent winder at a very reasonable price, providing most if not all of what a winder twice or even three times the cost provides. If you're looking to save some bucks and still get a winder that works great, and looks fantastic, this is worth a buy.

SUMMARY:

* beautifully made, display it with pride
* all the functions of a top tier winder, silent operation, individually controlled winders
* excellent value for the price
* would buy again, especially versus cheaper but lower quality brands, or more expensive brands that don't do any more than this model does
* would recommend to a friend, with the caution that it is maybe better suited for adjustable bands as opposed to fixed length bands, if one is concerned about tension on the band.

Hope this has helped! Thanks for reading!

title: Best rubber strap, period.
text:
These are fantastic! Came across the brand when I bought their own watch (the Crafter Blue Hyperion, an incredible watch at its price point). I was so impressed with the watch, and the strap was phenomenal. I later learned that CB is a maker of customized straps for Seiko, even Rolex.

With several watches in my collection needing better options on their 22mm lugs, I tried one of these, then bought another, and now have four of these straps. One is on my Orient Kanno, another on my Glycine Combat Sub, and a navy blue one is on my Mido Oean Star GMT. The other one floats from watch to watch.

Whether it's a watch of a few hundred dollars, or into the thousands, these are just perfect, and I can see why well-established brands rely on Crafter Blue.

Comfort is amazing, with plenty of venting to keep your wrist cool. They are super strong, the brushed hardware is beautiful, and an ideal match to brushed elements of most watch cases. The fit is superb, and, you can even use the included rubber keepers, if you don't like the brushed stainless one, provided.

They also provided spring pins.

This is Isofrane quality, at half the price. I'm also checking out Marathon, which is even half the price of this one, but, the CB straps have a look I prefer.

This is top quality rubber and is infused with a light vanilla scent, which I LOVE. Probably because my mom did so much baking when I was a kid, haha, but, it's a warm and pleasant scent I enjoy.

I think these are the best straps on the market. I only wish they had a wider range of sizes, because I'd gladly have these on even more of my watches.

As mentioend, they also have curved options for specific Seiko models, and just released one for my Baby MM 200, so I just ordered that strap, straight from their website. Prices are pretty much the same, whether ordered here, or from CB, or a few other places that do stock them, but, here, of course, I get free shipping as a Prime Member, so this is where I get them, mostly.

Absolutely love these watch straps, and a great find for any watch enthusiast. A lot of much cheaper options, but they tend to be exactly that, just cheap. These are premium quality, and well worth the price.

Hope that helps! Thanks for reading.

Perfect fit on the 22mm strap. Looks awesome and now makes the strap match the watch case.

Highly recommend!

title: Worth the price!
text:
So, I work way too many desk hours, and, while I am endeavoring to take more frequent breaks, and even bought a little stepper machine to use in my office, research on health led me to compression socks. given that I've got a bit of neuropathy setting in, which is not good. I was pretty surprised at the prices, and, of course, it's hard to know if the "knock off" brands are any better than "branded" brands. Since I knew nothing of compression socks, it's been a hit and miss of trial and error.

I wanted something white (not sure what's up with so many compression socks coming in wild color combos and designs?) and, starting out, I eventually found some great copper infused compression socks on here, by FuelMeFoot, that are 15-20mmHG which was a good beginning (and three pairs for ten bucks is awesome!). Then, hot weather hit, and it's very difficult to find a regular athletic or crew length sock to wear with shorts (wasn't really wanting to rock the lederhosen look, haha), but, finally found some from ADLU. Of course, a shorter compression sock doesn't do the same job, and I get that, but the ADLU are a nice balance of looking like "normal" socks plus providing some compression benefit and, at 15 dollars for two pairs, it's not that bad, since regular socks have gone up in price, yet seem to have gone down in quality at the same time.

But, having gotten used to (and actually really liking) how compression socks feel, I wanted to notch up to a more therapeutic level of compression, that I could wear while sleeping, at least a few nights a week, so I started exploring brands of those type. Read the many great reviews for these, but, with seeing much less expensive options, I tried those first, just because 20 bucks a pair is steep.

I ordered one of these, to compare, and, NO comparison, these are definitely the BEST of what I've found. The level of padding, and comfort, and excellence of fit is phenomenal. Extremely well made socks, and they just feel wonderful to wear. I know, kind of odd, socks that feel so great, but, seriously, these make my feet and legs very happy. I sleep great, and it seems my neuropathy is not getting any worse, and may even be starting to improve, so three cheers for compression socks, and a thousand cheers for these Wanderlust socks, the best of what I've found thus far, in a higher compression sock.

They even sent a coupon for my next order, and I just ordered two more pairs. They are thicker than the FuelMeFoot ones, so I'm not sure they will work as well in my sneakers, but, as an around-the-house and sleep-at-night sock, these are awesome. If they don't make my shoes fit too tight, I will likely switch over to these when the weather warms up, and possibly wear these exclusively, since they offer more therapeutic effect.

A terrific sock, and thanks to all the reviewers on here for sharing their findings. Wish I'd had these when I used to do overseas travel, but glad I've found them now!

SUMMARY: Well made, perfect fit, plenty of padding, "normal" appearance, super comfortable, and, in a case of getting what one pays for, these are worth every penny. Highly recommend!

title: Cute but uncomfortable :-/
text:
I thought the shape of these masks would make them more comfortable than the simple pleated ones but I was wrong. They’re actually very uncomfortable.
Pros: They’re cute and very well made. The cotton isn’t soft and is kind of stiff, but I like that better than the stretchy kind personally. Nose bridge is adjustable with a metal clip, and elastics are adjustable too.
Cons: The problem for me is the overall shape. Because of the added under-chin part, every time you move your mouth (as in talking), the mask gets pulled down. So you have to constantly re-adjust it. Not only is it annoying, but the end result is the mask keeps rubbing against your face which makes it itchy and irritated. They’re ok for a very short time, but no way could I wear them all day. They might work better for kids or people with a tiny face, but they don’t fit well for anyone in our household. :-/

title: Quality Black Moissanite Earrings
text:
[[VIDEOID:f60409935ba0b34647f2fbec85df0dcb]] These black moissanite earrings would make a lovely gift, they are beautiful, classy but a bit unique. They come in a very nice gift (ring) box with 2 certifications, one for each black gem. If you are wondering how these compare to black CZs - CZs are closer to a solid black and are less translucent and slightly less glittery (although black gems are, of course, always going to be a lot less glittery compared to white gems) - moissanite is more translucent, closer to a really dark smoky grey, more flash with movement. With both CZs and moissanite, the bigger the gem is, the more translucent it appears. Personally I think the translucency makes the gem look a lot more expensive than if they were just solid black glass and you should probably just buy that if you want it to be opaque shiny.

The setting looks good quality and these do not irritate my sensitive ears. Hoping the silver holds up well over time as I really like these earrings.

title: It's not the worst thing i've bought on amazon
text:
Per the heading of this, it really isn't the worst thing I've bought. I got this for my bachelorette party so its most likely a one time wear and i'm okay with that, for the price it works perfectly.

I'd size up one, material isn't stretchy at all. I'm 5'2, 118 and wearing a medium.

The bottom is see-thru (for the white) but to its defense, its hard to find white clothing that isn't. I bought a skirt slip and it hides everything you want. The top is double layer so it isn't see-thru but I am wearing nipple covers to be safe. since the back ties you can make it as loose or tight as you want. The other thing that bothers me, which can be fixed with a stitch, the longer "flap" on the skirt isn't attached to the rest of the skirt so when you're walking it moves. but like i said it is an easy fix and isn't that big of a deal.
It came very wrinkled, so we will see how it does with an iron, will update if the material cannot manage the heat. I might buy the green for next summer because I like the style so much.

title: Really great leather belt, holds up well and comes in a great gift box
text:
I bought this belt for my husband who is always running out of belts due to his harsh work environment.
Upon arriving, i could tell this belt is very well made.
It comes in a really nice gift box, and then inside a really nice pouch inside the box.
I ordered a size bigger as per the instructions on the product listing.
The leather belt is very well made and is nice and thick.
It comes with a tool and instruction on how to cut the belt down to size if need be. and on the other end of the tool you can use it to punch new holes.
My husband has been wearing this belt to work for over a week now and it is now his GO-To belt.
The belt has held up wonderfully, it has not lost its shape or twisted in any way even with his high impact work.
I will definitely be purchasing more of these when this belt wears out.

title: Great, comfortable, and washes easily.
text:
I have been wearing this off and on for several days and after washing it a few times I decided it was a good time to leave a review.

I use this for yoga and for home based workouts. I also have a toddler so I need something that actually holds my hair back without tearing it. I wasn't sure if this was going to work because frankly most of these types of headbands slip or fall off after a bit of activity. Here's what I found and the key points I want to pass onto a potential buyer.

1) It stayed in place in at least three of the positions I used it in. One was as a traditional headband, one was as a open head covering (just covering from the front of my hair to the back), and one was as a headband/ponytail holder but the not traditonally. What I mean by that is I sort of cupped my hair in the back of the headband, pulled it back up, and made it look like a traditional headband option. It stayed in place throughout the day with no issue.

2) It isn't hot at all. I had no issues with being too hot or sweating with it just because I had it on. It looks heavier than it is and it is very lightweight. It doesn't feel like traditional spandex styles.

3) It doesn't retain odor at all. There were a few days that I did a heavy workout and expected that smell to get in the band and it didn't. It wicked away the swat and stayed cool without stinking.

4) You can hand wash it and hang it to dry. I tried the washer once and the hand washing several times. The handwashing was quick, easy, and it did just as well.

title: Way too thick to fit into my ears..
text:
Disclaimer: I received this product for a free or a discount in exchange for an honest and un-biased review, this does not change my opinion of this product whatsoever. This is my honest opinion on whether I liked or enjoyed the product, thought it was of a high quality and did the job accordingly. I have no qualms on warning fellow customer of a bad product

These are sooo super cute! They are sturdy and feel and look very high quality. I am super bummed because they are a little too thick to fit in my ears (it's been a while since I wore earrings) I am going to have to slowly stretch my holes a little to fit them in :( ughhh I am soo sad!

This is the second pair of MOWOM earrings I have purchased and have been way too thick to fit through my hole, if they were pointed at the tips i would have probably been able to get these into my ears but the edges are totally straight like a screw, unlike normal earrings and so I can only get these about half way in before they get stuck and hurt :(

So attention anyone else who has particularly small holes or hasn't worn earrings in a while you might struggle to get these in your ears but apart from that I am going to give these 3 stars because i love them but these are so much thicker than regular earrings! I wish they were pointed at the tip so it would be easier for me to slide them into my holes.

This bag arrives scuffed up with a distressed look. It is hard to believe that a leather purse costs under $30 but this is real leather, I inhaled.

The bag has two zipper pouches for storage on one side of the purse (outside). My wife really likes that. Inside of each zipper pouch is enough room to store a large cell phone, mask and keys. Anything you want to access easily. Inside, there is another deep zippered area, There are also two "pouches" for storage. Inside the bag itself, there is enough room for a wallet, short hairbrush, keys, phone, and credit cards. The crossbody strap is adjustable by moving the buckle.

I knocked off one star because of the zipper closure of the bag. My wife doesn't like that when you zip up the bag, there is way too much zipper. title: Nice wide lenses with great case, easy to adjust and put on, plus built in earplugs
text:
As a former competitive swimmer and swim coach, I have worn a LOT of goggles. I also have 4 little kids, 3 of whom love to wear goggles when they are swimming for fun, so I have can comment from both my experience and from a parenting/coach experience. Let me tell you why I really like these:

SUPER easy to put on...if you have ever put goggles on a child (or even yourself) you know how tricky it can be (we went swimming tonight so it is quite fresh in my mind!)...do you put the lenses on first and then flip the elastic over and hope the lenses stay put or do you do the strap first and then pull the lenses down over the eyes? These have a clicking buckle in the back that eliminates that dilemma! Simply unhook the buckle, put the goggles over the eyes, and then buckle in the back! No adjustment needed...what an awesome idea! I was worried that it might be uncomfortable but so far it has not bothered me but my 8-year old did say it hurt him after a while when he had the clip lying low on his head but I was able to fix it by pulling it up higher. The silica gel is also soft, so it does not stick so much to your hair and/or swim cap. I hate yanking out my hair when I pull off my goggles!

Easy to adjust...some goggle straps are crazy complicated to pull out and rethread only to put them on and find out they were too tight or too loose. These slide easily to tighten or loosen and stay secure...all you do is squeeze the piece on the hard plastic in the back, slide (they have those raised little lines to "click" into place), and then release the lever and they stay in place! Definitely the easiest I have ever had as far as adjustment.

Soft gasket around the eyes! This I LOVE. Not only does it make the goggles so much more comfortable, it also offers a comfortable seal to keep the water out. It takes a little bit to make sure none of it is flipped out but it is totally worth it.

Nice wide lenses. This feature makes these SO comfortable! It distributes the pressure better over your face so you do not end up with raccoon eyes. Plus it is great for competitive swimming because it eliminates your blind spots, so to speak.

Anti-UV and anti-fog. All important features in your goggles, especially if you wear them for extended periods of time!

Mine have a lovely silver lens but it is still easy to see through them while swimming. They are also mirrored, which means they fingerprint easily. I would use a soft microfiber cloth to clean them...be wary of towels so you do not scratch the lenses. Beware of the mirrored lenses, though, as they do scratch very easily. It is super important to use the case. My kids have already scratched up one pair just from lying them facedown on the concrete deck around the pool. The blue straps are also very pretty.

Comes with an awesome case! Very sturdy and great for storage so you do not have to worry about them being squished, broken, or scratched.

The only problem I can see right now is the nose does not seem to be adjustable, which would be an issue if you have widely-spaced eyes or a broad nasal bridge. They fit my smaller face quite well (I'm 5'6") but not my 8-year old's or my 6'9" husband as well...they were okay, but would be better with a more adjustable option for various face shapes and sizes. My kids still fought over them, so they did not seem to mind, though. :)

Something I have never seen before is attached ear plugs. I am on the fence about this feature. I think it is great if you need them and love the face that they will not get lost since they are literally attached to the goggle strap, but I do wish you could remove them if you did not need them, as they look a little odd with these extra little antennae sticking out of the side of their little bug faces. They seem comfortable enough, so they would be ideal for someone who needed ear plugs every time they swam. Definitely a hot selling point for that population.

1 year guarantee...if you do not like them, you can send them back for a refund.

I think these are fantastic and I absolutely recommend them for anyone needing goggles for sport or play. title: Welwits Stands Behind Their Products
text:
EDIT 22 May 2019: Welwits reached out to me after I wrote my original review. They wanted to know how they could fix my problem. First, they refunded my money immediately and told me to keep the dress I had received. They also offered to send me a new dress. Unlike some companies that have done this, it doesn't feel like a bribe to get me to change my review. Since that time, I have ordered (and paid full price for) another dress that looks wonderful, fits perfectly and is constructed very, very well. When trying it on for my husband, I told him it was quite possibly my new favorite dress. So, based on my full dealings with Welwits so far, I am adding two stars to my original rating. Once I have received the replacement striped dress, I will update again. I really do love the look of this dress.

Original Review: I was so excited to get this dress. The striped version was so cute that I felt the polyester fabric was worth it. Oh boy. The fabric is not pink or coral or anything like that. It is more of a sick apricot brown stripe and looks/feels like it should only be use for delicate draperies. The dress itself is sewn with the skill of a 7th grade sewing class student with no patience ... and one shoulder is so much higher than the other that it created a crease/fold all the way across the front bodice, where the neck facing is also showing.

As a seamstress, I could have repaired the flaws, but why should I? I paid for a dress, not another mending project.

On the good side, the dress did fit beautifully based on the size chart. It actually pains me to be returning it.

metadata.title: AX Paris Womens 2 in 1 Crochet Top Maxi Dress(Blush, Size:12)

title: Blatant lie in ad
text:
The only reason I was willing to pay over $70 for a made in China item is because it clearly states DOWN in the title. When you get it in real life, you will see It is 100% polyester. What is with the top 1000 amazon reviewers not even touching on this?

*not warm. I tend to run hot (I'm usually hot), wore this outside in the high 40s, low 50s and was cold. I had a fleece, leggings underneath and was wearing boots.

*not down. I'm really sick of ads blatantly lying. I just bought a hat on amazon advertised as 100% wool and I open it up and tag shows it is mostly poly. This ad says down, and tag in person says 100% poly.

*overprices for being 100% poly.

*hood is cosmetic only. It is dramatic and beautiful bc it's so large but the slightest wind knocked this right down the very first time I wore it for a test run. It wasn't even an extreme wind. Imagine how this would perform on a windy day? There is nothing to secure the hood (no snaps, no strings) so it doesn't stay up - and it also completely obscures your peripheral vision.

*no waist definition. Look at the widest part of your body. for me it's the hips. Since this has no waist definition, it will create a box shape on your body, as wide as the widest part of your body. It looks like a giant shapeless sack.

*not puffy - not much filling, and flat - so it's not warm.

*great length. The other vest I tried on seemed to be much thicker and more shapely and flattering, but short. This has a great length and keeps your arms free and covers your bum if you're wearing leggings, even if you're tall.

But since the sellers have no qualms about lying to your face about the material and grossly overcharging for polyester, and since it's not warm nd has no functional hood and is shapeless and not flattering, I am returning. I do love the length and wish there were more options out there. I might have kept this for warmer winter days and cinch a belt on it if it were cheaper and didn't lie in the ad.

-Lightweight- Did not weigh down feet. Easy to pick up feet.
-Provided good arch support
-Attractive hiking boots

Cons:
-Not enough insole cushioning. Feet started to hurt after longer walk.

-Hard to tie shoelaces tightly
-hard to pull off

Overall pretty good boot but could be better.

title: Large Stylish Quality Bag
text:
As the owner of several Bostanten products, I decided to order this purse (in Pink), and am very satisfied with my purchase. This shade of pink is slightly "muted"...not a bright shade, nor a pale pastel. Pink is my signature colour -most of my accessories are pink or rose gold- and because this particular shade of pink has that slight greyish "muted" look, I'll be very comfortable carrying this bag thru all four seasons.

I've provided two photos: the first one includes my Bostanten Camellia pattern wristlet-wallet in Taro Pink to show how closely the colour matches this Pink bag, in the event you may also own the same wallet and are wondering about the colours.

In the second photo, I demonstrate how the diagonal pockets open on the front of the purse. While the pockets are roomy (my iPhone 6s Plus in a Dreem case fits), they are two separate pockets and do not "connect" thru the front of the bag.

Also included are a long, adjustable shoulder strap suitable for cross-body wear, and a chocolate-brown dust/storage bag. The bag has two cutouts at the top (handles), but does not close like most dust/storage bags via the usual drawstring-ties.

Hardware is gold-toned and of sturdy quality.
The bag arrives with every single piece of hardware shrink wrapped (in-transit scratch protection).

Zippers operated fairly well fresh out of the box, but much more smoothly after I overlapped them lightly with the same Mink Oil I applied to protect the purse.

As for the "upside down handle" mentioned by several reviewers... Actually, it I isn't at all "upside down". I own several bags with this same strap configuration. The seams are intentionally placed on the outside so as to avoid irritation against one's shoulder.

This is a lovely, large purse with ample room for a full day's load. Great for shopping, office tote, gym, etc. As a part time instructor, I like that I can carry my usual purse contents plus 8x10" lesson planner, files, A4 magazine, a couple of thin books, 9.7" iPad Pro, Kindle Paperwhite, pen cases, and still have room to slip-in my ever-present bottle of Evian.

Beautifully made, high quality, reasonable price.
Highly recommend. Will definitely be purchasing more products from this fine company.

Thanks for reading,
-CC, Amazon Prime Member-Reviewer

title: Comfortable Compression, But They Aren't Going to Win Any Fashion Awards
text:
The workout comes when you try to take off these socks! I don't have too much trouble getting them on, but they are not easy to get off, especially with my rough heels. I had to wear thigh-high compression stockings in the past for a period of time, and I thought those were easier to get on and off.

Assuming you are more adept than I, you probably won't have as much trouble. These really do make my calves feel good. I don't run very far, but I do walk and hike a lot, and these socks help. My legs are not as tired after a long walk.

Where I live, these are winter socks unless I am having an unusual issue and really need the extra compression. They are warm enough that they won't be as comfortable in the hot summers.

I was impressed with the upper band. It didn't roll or pinch or move at all, just stayed where I put it, a bit below my knee. The seam near the toe is a bit bumpy on the end, as with many socks, and I had to adjust them a little to make them comfortable in my running shoes. Part of the issue might be that these felt just a little big on me. I usually wear a size 7 women's shoe, and this size is supposed to go to size 7.5. I think it would be better if small, medium, large, and extra large sizes were offered rather than small/medium and large/extra large. I'm sure that would be more expensive, and with regular socks the two sizes wouldn't be a problem. However, with this design, fit is important, and I think the sizes are just too limited.

These do just fine with a regular trip through the washer and dryer. I don't know if bleach is acceptable but I would avoid it because I'm afraid it could hurt the compression capabilities.

Now, you aren't going to wear these under short pants unless you are going to an ugly sock party. While I do like the way they make my legs feel, I can't say they are pretty. I think the gray and the bright blue are to emphasize the different areas of compression, but they are a bit on the gaudy side. Yep, definitely winter socks for me.

title: Updated Review:  Poor Quality
text:
I initially liked these pants with some reservations. However, after washing gently for the second time, I found a hole in the seam and a long stream hanging out, loose. These did not split -- they fitted loosely. But the quality is so poor that bad sewing, which was not obvious at first, makes these a poor choice. I've sewn up the pants but don't know where the thread will come out again, and I don't think I should have to repair pants after two washings on the delicate cycle. Below is my original review:

First of all, ignore the "Terry" in the product title and pay attention to the 100% polyester in the description. Polyester is far from my favorite fabric, but I do like these pants. They seem to run a bit large, but I think they are cute. Apparently, a lot of other people do not, but that's a matter of personal preference. I was afraid they would be too hot, but because they are loose around the legs, so far they are working fine. There are pockets made of lining fabric, not very deep but still handy for small, light objects.

These are NOT workout/jogging pants, and anyone who gets them for that reason will be very disappointed.

Also, they are supposed to be "capri." They actually are longer than the top of my foot, but I'm 5'3". I think you'd have to be pretty tall for them to be capri length.

If you like these despite the misrepresentation, be sure you comparison shop. At the current listing, they do not seem like a good value to me.

title: Very Short-Waisted, Not Good Quality
text:
The polka dots on this are retro-cute, but overall, I don't like this jumpsuit. I'm fairly short, but even on me, this is very short-waisted. When I first tried it on, I wondered if maybe I didn't pay enough attention to the photos on the product page, and it was really supposed to be empire-waisted. But no -- on the models, it looks like it sits at the waist. But being either too high (or too low if it were supposed to be empire), it looks just kind of dumpy. The stitching is not very good and mine has bits of thread sticking out here and there. The stitching is rather crude, especially starting below the (supposed to be) waist and through the legs.

The loop is stretchy and hard to find. It's not hard to unhook but it's very hard to hook, and if you are a typical female who wears this for the day, you are going to have to unhook it multiple times a day - avoid coffee.

The polyester can be hot but the legs are loose enough so that it doesn't feel as hot as if it had slimmer legs. It is, as it claims, cut quite deeply in the front, so a low-cut bra is needed.

I thought this would be a fun outfit and I didn't expect fabulous quality, but I expected better than this.

title: Better For Tall People; Comfort Over Looks
text:
This velour set is really comfortable, and nice for lounging around the house. It has survived my washer and dryer without any problems. I do turn the pieces inside out as suggested. There hasn't been an undue amount of fiber left in the dryer trap from these. But the set does have some shortcomings.

I usually wear a size large in clothing like this. The extra large I got fit well on top, more like a large than an extra large. The bottom has very wide legs that aren't especially flattering on me, especially because I'm short. The sleeves and the legs are much too long for me, and I have to roll them up. This isn't so bad on the sleeves, but the legs are cuffed, and rolling them looks kind of weird. The fabric right above the cuff is pretty wide, so it balloons out. Tall people probably won't have this problem. And because of the cuffs, it is not as easy to change the length as it would be if the sleeves and legs were just hemmed. I'm not going to bother trying that. To me, it seems the top size doesn't quite match the bottom size.

The nap of the velour is fairly short, but it is soft. So far, I haven't had any problems with the metal zipper or with the hoodie cord. But rolled sleeves and all, it is comfortable.

title: Meh, they aren’t as good as I’d hoped they’d be.
text:
For the price, I suppose they’re fine but I have a similar pair from Gap that I love that fit way better; although admittedly they cost 3x the price. I’m 5’8” ish about 190 and bought a Large. They are snug, which I prefer but fit way tighter than the name brand pair I own.

The waist band isn’t great, I like a firm high waist to hold the goods in, this is medium hold at best and not quite high enough to stay in place. The band has nothing keeping it in place, it rolls down frequently just a bit. Not a deal breaker necessarily because it’s comfortable in a non restricting way, but if I were to rely on these to exercise in, which I certainly DO NOT there’s no way I would feel secure. I keep my ever present camisole tucked into them to make me feel more put together.

The length is also a touch shorter than my other pair, enough to be noticeable. I didn’t return them, they’ll be fine, just not a dupe for my other pair. I love the color, the stretch, and the fabric is decent quality. Just the fit is off for me. I won’t buy another pair but worth a shot.

title: Very Comfortable, but They DO NOT Wick Moisture
text:
I am currently pregnant and was looking for underwear with fewer irritating seams and with a forgiving fit. These fit the bill, and I like the colors. There is not a seam in the front of the crotch, which is a huge plus. When not pregnant, I typically wear a M/6, when I am pregnant, I size up to a 7/L. In these, I ordered a medium based on the reviews and they fit fine, and may continue to fit after I lose the baby weight.

One thing I wanted to mention was the fabric - it seems like athletic fabric like running/exercise clothes are made of, but I have found, unlike other reviewers, that these do NOT wick moisture. If you are sweaty, or damp for any other reason, you will know it and feel it. I'm not talking about a ton a moisture here, just a drop is super uncomfortable. That is the reason I went down a star. However, I have to say these are probably my most comfortable underwear right now, despite their lack of wicking power.
