title: My husband likes them
text:
I got this pair of polarized sunglasses for my husband because he drives quite a distance to and from work each day, driving into the sun both ways. I figured that the polarized lenses that these glasses offer would suit him better than the sunglasses he had been using, which are just tinted.
These glasses come with a hard outer case that zips to secure the sunglasses. On this case there is also a hook so you can hang the case from a bag or your belt loop if you wanted.
There is also a soft pouch inside, ths seems to be at least two layers. The other layer is mesh and the inner layer seems to be some kind of thin foam. A cleaning cloth is also included.
The sunglasses themselves are heavier than most sunglasses I've ever owned. They are made of a black plastic and the ear pieces and where your nose rests are a soft blue silicone. The silicone is comfortable and flexible.
The lenses are polarized so they cut down glare from the sun but they also mess with color perception. For driving they seem to be ok but I tried them on as a passenger and I couldn't really focus on anything up close. I do not normally wear glasses or contacts but these lenses seemed to stress my eyes. I would not be able to wear these sunglasses, but my husband does not seem to have the same problem. He did say these glasses sit lower on his nose than he likes so they're a bit uncomfortable.
Other than that small issue he likes these sunglasses very much.
I received this item at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

title: Distressed look perfect for Independance Day!
text:
I wore this American flag infinity scarf yesterday for the Fourth of July and it made a perfect accessory.
The fabric is very thin and airy sort of like a cheesecloth. It is very wide so it can be wrapped around your neck twice and look very nice. When laid flat the scarf measures 36 inches wide and 35 inches long.
Upon opening the package I was a little bit surprised because the colors are not what I thought they would be. The white is not white it is more of a cream color and the other colors look distressed as well. Personally, I like this sort of vintage look better than bright colors with white stripes but this is definitely something you should know if you're considering ordering. Also, it does not appear that the seams are so evenly or straight. Since it is an infinity scarf, it is meant to be wrapped around you so you probably wouldn't notice but again, something to be aware of.
I got several compliments on this infinity scarf and it makes the perfect accessory for when you need that extra bit of patriotism. I love that it's not too thick and it was not too hot to wear in July.

text: I am a pharmacist and am on my feet all day, and  have been wearing compression socks for years.  I wore these socks to work for the first time today and I am impressed. My legs feel great! I bought these in large and it is like they were custom made for me. Usually I have to size up in compression socks to get them to fit my calves and make sure they are high enough, but then I am left with the problem of the socks being too large in the foot, and too loose in the ankle. But these fit perfectly!  The only downside to these socks is the size chart is a little off, and you may need to size up. title: Not 100% Cotton! Not Linen-Cotton
text:
False advertising and false description.

Not "linen-cotton" or "100% cotton."

Seller should be ashamed of listing the scarf falsely. Amazon should start punishing sellers who make such false listings, because this is a rampant problem.

The green color was not accurate, and I'm very good at determining colors.

Scarf is very soft, slick even. I should have done the burn test before putting it in the laundry, but I was doing my delicates, so I didn't do the burn test until after.

The green scarf was wrinkle free out of the front load washer. Hung to dry next to the beige one (actually cotton). After about 30 minutes, used a lighter on the fringe and it melted, so proof it's not 100% cotton.

The green scarf has a straight, generic fringe, like cheap fabric.

The green scarf also included a "Rich Moment Accessory Designs" probably cotton or linen drawstring bag, which is possibly nicer than the scarf.

I'm quite disappointed. I wanted a 100% natural fiber scarf, I have enough bamboo and viscose scarves!

I'll not trust the company/seller again!

Pictures show side by side comparison of the beige scarf and (not accurate color shown) green scarf that are supposedly "100% cotton" according to descriptions.

Also, green scarf has raw edge on all sides. Note burn test melted fringe on green scarf, and lack of wrinkling that 100% cotton is known for.

I can't recommend, since seller more than once incorrectly stated fiber content.

title: Good choice. Bought three.
text:
I have three of these dresses in different colors, and the green is a different fabric than the others. Not a game-changer, but definitely good to know. The others (I have the dark blue and the pale yellow [more like a cream]. The pale green is a crinkly crepe-like material, whereas the other two are a smooth, flat fabric. The green and cream have the buttons pictured, with the split in the front, but the blue one is solid from the waist or so to the floor. The buttons on the lower half are apparently just for show.

All of the dresses shrank CONSIDERABLY in the wash (cold, machine, dry low). I wasn't super crushed, as I bought smalls, and at 5' 4", they were all quite long. Only the cream color was the perfect length out of the box (exactly to the floor). That said, once washed and dried, they each shrank close to 4-6 inches in length. The cream became ankle length, the blue floor length, and the green still a bit long, but passable by wearing a wide belt and kind of fluffing some of the fabric over the belt.

All of the dresses are slightly longer on the sides than in the front/back. I believe this must be a purposeful design element. It's also nice so you are less likely to step on your dress as you are walking.

All of the dresses have great twirl-ability. All of them breathed fantastically so they kept me very cool on 90+ degree (F) days outside.

For whatever it's worth, although the green one is still a bit large and crinkly, and I had to do the belt/fluff to keep it from dragging, my boyfriend said he liked that one the best.

5' 4", 117-120lbs.

title: How can they do it for the price
text:
I have been lusting over a similar watch that costs $2000 which is similar to a $12000 watch that in no way fits my budget. I've been really considering spending the $2000 and decided I wasn't sure if I would like the size and weight or the fact it needs to be wound every day

A friend at work that travels to China mentioned that Sea-Gull has greatly improved their quality trying to get back on the international market. It's what I was looking for Sea-Gull that I stumbled across this watch with their movement.

I started thinking that I could afford $100 to see if I liked the size and feel of a watch like this before I bought the expensive one, so I ordered one.

It got here in 2 days as promised and when I opened the box I was stunned. I was expecting "Too good to be true" and putting it back in the box to return. But, it's beautiful, same as if it was made in Switzerland. I like the feel, it's easy to read, and it's right on the button in accuracy. I'm thinking I just saved $1900 because the expensive watch can't be that much better.

Time will tell, the crystal is mineral instead of sapphire but I've never broken any of my previous mineral crystals. People say the bands on Parnis are poor but this one is fine, dark brown that passes for black. There's even another lighter brown band in the box. If I had any complaint, the lume isn't as bright as other watches I own.

This in a case where the price does not reflect the quality. I expect I'll be buying more.

title: Beautiful rose print skirt!
text:
I'm excited to be the first to review this beautiful rose print skirt.
I love this skirt but it runs small. If you are larger than a US size 12, it probably wont fit. My hips are 38" and according to the chart I can wear a large, but I had to exchange the large for an XL. The unstretched flat waist on the size large was only 13.5". The XL is also tight on my size 12, 38" hips, it fits very bodycon. I do love it though! Looks fantastic with a red top. The white is fairly white, but I wouldn't try a white-white top with it. I don't like cream, so it's not really "cream" at all. Also note worthy, it is not very see through. In the pictures I am wearing black spanx and you can't see them at all. Still for wearing out, I'll probably switch to nude. BTW I am 5' tall so it will probably be shorter on most of you! Over all it's quite stunning, I expect to get lots of compliments! The fit and the print make modern and very exceptional.

title: No love for the stretchy shirt
text: Did I get the wrong product? Nope, it looks like the picture. But from all the 5 star reviews, I was expecting a fabulous, fashion-envy, super-sweet top. The top is really on the cheap side. The material is super stretchy old lady nightgown stuff. The inside of the top is white and it shows as the top hangs longer on the sides. You can see the shadow of the design print on the white inside even more as the top moves when you walk.  Now this might not be a deal-killer on a $10.00 top (which would be the proper price point for this piece), it is a deal-killer for a $40.00 top. The material is also highly clingy with a lot of static electricity. I don't understand all the rave reviews. If you must see for yourself, order your regular American size. It should be forgiving enough because it is so stretchy and it isn't Chinese sizes. Stretchy and clingy together are just not my thing. Btw, I am 5'6" and the front of the top hits about 4 inches above my knees and about 1 inch above my knees at the sides and back. The sleeves are fitted all the way down but don't stay pushed up because of the stretching of the fabric. The neckline is also pretty high. I did not receive a wash bag with mine. Perhaps it was a previous return.

title: Some of the negative reviews disliked that it shows every single curve
text:
SO comfy! Some of the negative reviews disliked that it shows every single curve... that's definitely something to expect when purchasing a pencil dress made of Polyester and Spandex. Anything that's tight to the body or has thin fabric (like this dress) is of course going to be a little more revealing about body shape than we want it to be. I usually end up wearing some Spanx under dresses for extra coverage, but you could see the seams of the shorts through the dress, though it wasn't shockingly obvious.

This dress should be fantastic for summer! It's lightweight, silky, and shouldn't get super gross on the hot, sweaty days. One could wear this dress in the winter, it just depends on climate and level of warmth, but in general it seems that adding a pair of tights and a cardigan/sweater would make it okay for winter. It does well as repelling water droplets- I wore it on a drizzly day and the water rolled off instead of soaking in, and any drops still on the dress come off easily with a shake of the dress, or a quick wipe with a hand.

Sizing is just as expected- the dress does reach down to the knees, though it can be pulled up to be shorter without looking weird. It's super soft and isn't so tight to make it hard to breathe, it honestly feels like wearing yoga pants or leggings. Except you also feel more fashionable and confident. The high neckline is nice to prevent any worries over the cut width or depth, and keeps you covered and good to go! I expected the sleeves to be super weird, and they aren't! The short sleeves don't cut into or terribly reveal your armpits like many formal dresses do. The chest area is small enough to look good on those that are smaller, but it does stretch to accommodate those that are bigger.

I always struggle to find clothes that fit well AND look good that don't drown me, but I scored with this dress! I'm about 5' 3", 100 lbs, 24 waist, and can usually wear a XS or XXS in womens and a L or XL in girls, and I ordered a black XS dress. Fits real nice and doesn't make you want to take it off as soon as humanly possible. It truly allows you to be classy, comfy, and confident- all at the same time.

title: Also be aware that the pockets are just like in the picture- they're not the type of pockets ...

It was well made and seems durable- though not much elastic in the waist, the navy color leans more toward purple than blue, and lengthwise, it hits the top of my knee. Also be aware that the pockets are just like in the picture- they're not the type of pockets you'd keep your hands in when relaxed, although they are actually a decent size. Since it was a bit large, it wasn't the most flattering on a slim body type.

It's a great dress, how pleased you are with it just depends on body type, and preferred fit, as well as attitude and expectations. Keep in mind that it ships through the mail... so of course it might come out wrinkly! There isn't a tag or label in the back of the dress, but there is one sewn into the seam on the inside of the dress- if you cut it out and throw it away, you've lost all the fabric and washing information.

title: The inexpensive dress that makes you feel like a princess
text:
Despite the wide assortment of models in the listing, I was a bit dubious about this dress looking good on me (mainly the ruffles on the top). Still, with that price point and all the great photos, I just had to try it.

I needn't have worried! It really does look good on everyone! It's light, comfortable, pretty, and flattering. I chose the red, and I'm very glad I did. It's bright and pretty, a real blue-red. My favorite shade.

My only criticism is, it says to hand wash. Who does that? LOL Seriously, though, I am thinking gentle wash in cold water, in a good net bag, remove promptly and hang to dry would work. I am going to try this and will update with results.

Also, I guarantee the color is going to bleed, so wash it by itself.

I really love this dress, and I highly recommend it. Even if you don't think it will look good on you, give it a try. You'll probably be surprised!

title: Good quality
text:
Size ordered: XS
Measurements: 5'2" tall, 32DDD bust, size 0-2 pants, size S/M in tops

I knew this dress was supposed to have a flowy/loose look before ordering, so I ordered an XS because I'm so short and I didn't want it to look like a potato sack on me. I'm very pleased with the quality of this garment and the color is a very prettty deep red just like the photos. I like the elastic arm bands around the upper arm and wrist so I can shorten the sleeves if desired and it makes the sleeves not so baggy looking, however I felt the length of the sleeves for an XS were too long and they went past my fingertips, while the shirt itself seemed short in the front and back.

Overall I liked this shirt/dress, but I felt for an XS it should have been a little smaller; it is more suited for taller people in the torso/waist, but shorter people in the length.

metadata.title: Romwe Women's Loose Long Sleeve Keyhole Flowery Floral Beach Dress Burgundy XS

title: Cute, but see-through
text:
Size ordered: S
Measurements: 5'2" tall, 32DDD bust, size 0-2 pants, usually S/M in tops

It's a very cute dress and looks just like the photos, however I'm giving it 4 stars because it's very see-through on the top (my bra is clearly visible), it came extremely wrinkled and took a good 10 minutes to steam out, so this dress will probably be difficult to travel with if put in a suitcase as it will most likely get horrible wrinkles, and it is really low-cut in the arm holes, so if I wear a bra it's extremely visible and if I don't, I will be showing major side boob.

Overall I'm pleased, but I definitely think this dress needs to come with a built in slip or come in a different fabric so it's not see-through.

title: Love these tops!
text:
Size ordered: XS
Measurements: 5'2", 102lbs, 32DDD bust, S/M tops

Omg I love these tops! They are made out of a comfortable and not too thick fabric, perfect for the summer. After reading reviews I decided to size down, and I'm glad I did. The XS fits me like the model photo, and any bigger would probably not be flattering, so I suggest ordering down a size or two. I ordered both the beige and green and will be ordering more colors!

Also, there is only one spot in the split that is sewn together (see photos) so if you are worried about it coming apart, you may want to add a little extra stitching, but I don't expect it to come apart any time soon.

text:
Size ordered: S
Measurements: 5'2", 102lbs, 32DDD bust, S in tops

Gorgeous! I am extremely pleased with this purchase and highly recommend it. The color is a warm muave, and the fabric is just the right thickness to not be sheer, but also not be too heavy. The top of the dress was fairly tight, but not enough to be uncomfortable and if I ordered any larger, I don't think it would have fit well around my waist as the small still had some room on me. I would suggest an XS for band sizes of 30-32, S for 32-34, M for 34-36, and so on, ordering up if you're busty.

There is a zipper closer on the right side of the dress, hidden underneath the top ruffle, and the fabric gives only a little bit of stretch. The dress also comes with two clear optional straps that can be removed and replaced with hooks.

title: Comfortable and stretchy material
text:
I recently purchased the Ocean Blues Women's Light Support String Swim Top Triangle Bikini Top and I am extremely pleased with my purchase. The bikini top is made of 82% Polyamide and 18% Spandex, making it stretchy and comfortable to wear. The tie closure is easy to adjust, ensuring a perfect fit for my body shape.

The triangle top has perfect coverage and stays put while playing in the water. The halter and tie back provide additional support and the good stretch in the ties allows for a comfortable and secure fit. The removable pads and wire-free design make this bikini top perfect for a day spent lounging on the beach or swimming in the ocean.

I would recommend this bikini top to anyone looking for a comfortable and supportive swim top. The only downside to this product is that it should be hand washed with cold water and not use bleach.

Pros:

Comfortable and stretchy material
Adjustable tie closure
Perfect coverage
Halter and tie back for added support
Removable pads and wire-free design

Cons:

Should be hand washed with cold water. Do not use bleach.

title: Packing Cubes With Convenient Handles
text:
There’s a lot to like about these packing cubes. There are 2 bags included in each order. These are soft sided, which allows for easier packability. The larger cube is 13” X 12”, and the smaller cube is 13” X 9”. The cube is expandable via the zipper on the side. It expands to a maximum of 3.5 inches for the larger one and 3 inches for the smaller one. I was able to fit 2 large sweaters or 3 ladies’ slacks/jeans in the larger one. For the smaller one, I was able to fit 3 ladies’ tops or one sweater. I like that it organizes my clothes in my suitcase. There is a white mesh on the front. It’s not see-through. This is great, because I can also use this for after swimming to put in our wet swimsuits.

The material is durable, and fairly thick. There was no smell. I machine washed them in cold and hung to dry without any issues. There is a single handle on one end. The handle is long enough that I can sling it over my shoulder. These bags can also be used for carrying stuff while shopping on your travels. I was able to fold it up to a 5 inch square and store it in a backpack. I found these packing cubes very useful and durable. I would recommend them.

title: It Works! But Messy.
text:
It was easy to use. The bottle works on an average medium pumpkin (about 5 lbs.). I had to do at least 3 coats to get this to really cover over the orange of the pumpkin. I let it dry really good before doing another coat. So, I don't recommend doing this the night before Halloween. Start painting your pumpkin a few days before.

The paint is a bit messy with the sponge, but it washes off your hands really easily. It did, however stain the ends of my fingernails. (I painted them later to cover it up.)

After Halloween, I put it outside. It's now been one month outdoors, and survived rain and high winds and the paint has not washed off. It's still turquoise.

On Halloween night, only one parent asked me "Why do you have a blue pumpkin?" :D

title: Darling, but do not believe it is leather
text:
This is a darling bag. It looks better than pictured. It's a perfect size for me - not too small, not too large. The two pocket inside are not helpful for many of today's larger phones, but imagine something will fit in there, such as a folding brush or a small container of lotion. The zip pocket is a good size. Mostly, though, it's just one open section. Given the size, that is all I'd expect.

There are two things to note about it if you are going to purchase it. First, when I opened the box, there was a strong outgassing smell. It doesn't appear to be real leather, rather some type of poly vinyl leather-ette. It's been sitting out for two weeks and now still smells some. While it's getting harder to get real leather at this price, the description is incorrect, I believe, and should not say it is leather. The second is that the watermelon color has more coral in it than I expected. I know colors on the monitor are not always accurate - if it looks more dark pink-red/cherry on your monitor, know that it's a bit lighter and has more of a peachy/coral undertone than a blue/red undertone.

title: High quality great dress
text: What a great dress.  I'm 35 years old 5'4"ish weigh around 150-160 I wear a medium to large shirt depending on cut (34DDD bra so top heavy) and a 10-14 pant (depending on maker).  I do have a belly I have had 2 kids in the last 4 years.  This dress was on a lighting deal for under $20 so I figured I would give it a try.  I love this dress, I got it in Large the navy color.  It fits great which is always really hard for me being top heavy.  It seems to have a bit of a mermaid cut to it so it looks very faltering.  I will be wearing it with spanks (what women wouldn't).  You will need to get at least a strapless bra if not a backless strapless, I put it on with a strapless and you couldn't see my bra at all. This is a dress I would expect to be $100+ at any major dept. Store (jcpenny, sears, kohls...ect).  I got it to wear it to a wedding and can not wait to wear it.  I could see this being a great dress for weddings, bridesmaids, prom, any formal party.  Some dresses I wear as small as an 8 others as large as a 14 so I was unsure what size to buy I figured worse case I would send it back.  If you are on the fence I highly suggest getting it you have nothing to lose I would buy the size shirt you normally wear.  It is very well made I couldn't find any poor seams or strings or anything.  I buy 4 to 5 formal dresses a year this is by far the best one I have bought in a long time (and cheapest)

title: My FAVORITE Dress ever! Here’s why:
text:
I bought this dress since I had been eyeing it for a few weeks but ended up taking the plunge on Prime Day 2019 since it was a few bucks less (if it’s on sale...you may as well). It arrived the next day and to my surprise it wasn’t even wrinkled one bit when I took it out of the package! The photos you see here are of the dress straight out of the package. The belt I am wearing didn’t come with the dress but I did buy it on Amazon here for like $10 (yup, I proudly say I buy all my clothes and accessories on Amazon). I wanted to make it a bit fancier. The tie-belt that comes with the dress is the same material and print as the dress.

Why it’s the best dress ever:
1. Zero wrinkles!!! I travel often and need something I don’t have to spend an extra 30 minutes steaming or ironing.
2. Fancy, dressy, but also VERY comfortable. I wore this dress on muggy, hot summer day (88°) and I felt perfectly cool even though the dress has long sleeves.
3. No static/No cling
4. Belt loops

I could go on...but you get the idea!

I’m 5’4” and took a size medium. I could have worn a small but they didn’t have that option. The dress doesn’t stretch, so there’s no give to it, but it has tiny functional buttons from the waist on up. The top portion of the dress was a TINY bit loose on me (no big deal, it just wasn’t tight).

Also...just ordered another one as well, same size :)

The following are some of the issues I have with these socks:
There is not enough elastin so the socks creep down a bit or roll up at the top.
With one pair of socks they got a pull in the foot catching on something in the shoe (never had this happen before but suspect the weave being the cause)
While the pattern is nice, most of the fun part is on the foot, which is not seen when wearing shoes. If you like running around in your socks at home this might be a better use of the sock design.
Overall, not bad but also not great

title: Okay but light weight
text:
First off I wear boxer briefs. When I grew up you either wore boxers (usually made out of cotton with no elastic) or you wore briefs (spun cotton that gave you support). When they combined the two, I was in hog heaven. The comfort of a boxer but the support of a brief This is how I base my review and taking into consideration cost.
First off, as many have noted, this does not have a fly front (Y front for the Brits). This is nice for obvious reasons.
The fabric is very thin so it does not give much support.
As the fabric is mostly polyester, it should last but the briefs will probably loose even more shape.
The one good thing is the price at $5 which is about what they are worth. I will probably stick to better known brands and wait for the Black Friday sales where I can get a much better product at about double the cost.

title: Note there is no pocket for filter but very nice masks
text:
Lively pattern and easy to wear. But I didn't realize there isn't a pocket in which a filter can be inserted -- I missed that. But bc the virus is way out of control where I live (Florida), I've severely limited my trips out of the house, esp any when I'd be around others for more than a few minutes.

And bc our weather has been esp humid for weeks, with months to go, I've discovered the best thing for me is to wear at least a lightweight disposable or an N95 under a more decorative mask such as these. I trash the inner mask that is sweat-soaked and if my exposure has been minimal, I carefully fold the outer reusable mask to wear again.

When I say minimal, I mean I've used the drive-thru to pick up prescriptions or the occasional fast food, or at my vet, the tech comes to my car and gets the cat carrier from the back seat on passenger side. I discuss my cat's needs w/vet by phone and pay that way, too. Cat returned to car in same manner.

These masks washed nicely and there was no shrinkage.

title: Love the Hat - Wish it was Bigger
text:
I originally wanted the hat in an XL for my husband, but they sadly sold out.

I have no idea why anyone is complaining about this hat - it's a $20 hat. I'm not sure what they were expecting. I have a felted wool tophat similar to this (granted it's heavier and actually a boxed and shaped hat) and I paid about $100 for it. This hat is absolutely perfect for a costume - especially if you're going to be in the heat.

It's lightweight, totally shape-able and goes FLAT. That means at the end of the costume party if you don't want to wear a hat anymore, you crush it down and don't worry about ruining it.

It's a feltlike material (heavy) and a wire in the brim does the trick of keeping shape after you un-collapse it.

Top notch, I love it.

title: It actually worked pretty well
text: I was at an estate sale and found this kit priced at 25 cents. It was brand new--unopened--and for a quarter I figured it was worth a try. I actually have a lot of sterling silver flatware and also some silver plate flatware that we inherited and use as one of our everyday sets--the other being the stainless flatware pattern we received when we got married.  And THERE is part of the problem. I like having these two sets because we are busy people and with two sets of flatware we can go a while without running the dishwasher.  I have LEARNED that in the dishwasher one must separate the silver plate or sterling flatware from the stainless flatware. The stainless makes the silver tarnish. The silver seems to make the stainless get small rust spots.  Anyway, the silver plate was looking a little dingy and I thought it would be a safe thing to try this thing out on before using it with my nicer sterling flatware.  Initially I followed the directions--I got a rectangular plastic tub (it said don't use the sink if it's metal--mine is stainless) and put the larger silver lightning plate in the bottom.  I added two tablespoons of baking soda (as per the directions) and put in about four tarnished pieces of silver plate. Then I  heated a big pitcher of water in the microwave to what I thought was boiling, or just about, and poured it on.  I was underwhelmed. It looked as if a few areas were looking a little bit shiny, but all in all---meh.  So I headed to the internet and Googled the product. There I found some reviews that said the device works better if you use MORE baking soda than the two tablespoons stated in the directions. Also--use BOILING water--so I filled up the tea kettle, boiled the water, added FOUR heaping tablespoons of baking soda to the plastic tub with the silver lightning plate, added the tarnished silver, and poured the BOILING water in. Well, I could see it working right before my eyes.  The silver plate was actually dropping tarnish in seconds.  I got some plastic tongs to fish out the cleaned items. I rinsed everything with cool water and spread it out on towels to dry.  Once I got started I did the WHOLE drawer and then went on to the sterling flatware.  If your silver is heavily tarnished you will need to dump the concoction, rinse everything off, and make a new mixture with baking soda and boiling water. I could tell when it was time to change it out because the tarnish would actually be floating in filmy chunks in the water. I probably made about five or six clean batches to clean two services for ten.  Afterwards I rinsed everything with water or soap and water and dried the pieces before putting them away.  It was a project that took a couple of hours, but the flatware looks SO MUCH BETTER, and I have to admit it was pretty easy.  Now I did try to put a section of a VERY HEAVILY tarnished candelabra in the mixture and It didn't work nearly as well. It took SOME of the tarnish off, but nothing like the instant clean I got when I was dropping knives, forks, and spoons in there.  So...NOT perfect--but overall pretty cool. It was definitely worth a quarter. It's worth more--though I've read that the plate is just aluminum and the baking soda causes a chemical reaction that you could also create by using an aluminum turkey pan, etc. However, MY set up cleaned up very easily. I rinsed the plate between uses and scrubbed it with a little baking soda to get the tarnish off. I'll definitely use it again.

title: Classy Bib has Body and works well
text: I bought this for the 79 year old advanced Parkinson's patient in the house. We've been using bibs three meals a day for three years now. I have a drawer full. Lately I noticed the terry cloth ones I've had for three years are showing a lot of wear--unraveling, bleach spots, and the Velcro fasteners are pretty worn out too. And they look institutional. There are some choices out there for nicer adult bibs. At Christmas I bought the one that looks like a tuxedo and it cost around $25 which is expensive for a single bib. We needed another and I saw this one. I think it looks great. The pattern is attractive yet subtle enough to use on a man without looking feminine, and the fabric has body, which helps it stay spread across his chest. I like the snap closure at the neck over the Velcro on other bibs. The food catcher does a decent job catching drops. I've caught the bird dog with her head under his tray rummaging around in it for tidbits. So far it has laundered well, but it also lends itself to a quick wipe with a wet cloth if it has made it through a meal that involved fewer spills. It cost around $12, which is half the cost of other bibs of this caliber. I keep telling myself I should make some bibs for him, but when you factor in time, material, hassle...well I may get around to it, but in the meantime I will buy another of these. It's classy and I think it helps preserve his dignity.

title: Good solution
text:
I was very excited about these rings when I got them I was wanted to try the silicone rings to see how they feel and if I would like them. Well I definitely do like them they take a little getting used to since I'm used to a metal ring . Some of the things you should consider are the ring doesn't slide around your finger like a metal Ring will. silicone is also gripping so when driving I noticed that it really stucks to my steering wheel When turning. It might sound weird but the ring is also a little warm. The silver ring I think must've had paint on the outside because the paint started wearing off after just a couple of days but the solid silicone rings seem to wear just fine without any problems . Overall I'm very satisfied it's a good solution when working out and working with machinery to protect your hands. The ring is also very comfortable to wear . I did receive this product at a reduced price in exchange for a fair and honest review
I understand that the 1-5 star rating is to help both buyers and sellers. Here is a breakdown of how my 1-5 ratings are determined:
5-star rating that means that I truly love that product and it has features that put it above and beyond what would normally be expected, and it is something that “wowed” me and I am truly glad I purchased it and would purchase it again. Also I recommend it to everyone and anyone!

4-star ratings are items that do exactly as would be expected of the item, is of very good quality, but does not stand out significantly in any way unless I specifically state why it stands out. But all in all, this item is a solid item and is still highly recommended. It just didn’t have the wow factor that my 5 star ratings would have had.
3-star ratings are given on items because my feeling about the product is neutral. I do not consider it a negative, but it just did not wow me, or there is nothing of great significance.
1 or 2-star ratings are rarely given unless the item is completely worthless and not worth the money, and I am only giving that rating as a warning to others. Some items have received lower ratings because of the way they were made or put together, and it is getting that review because of the quality of the item, which is specifically described in my review. It has to be pretty bad to get these ratings from me!

title: Do your homework like I did and you'll give 5 stars too.
text:
Read the reviews like I did and if you choose wisely, you won't be disappointed. Because some say they ran smallish, and because I know cotton shrinks, I ordered the large for my medium-sized hands. My hands measure 8-1/4 around the knuckles (without the thumb). Medium in the men's size chart is 8-1/2. I ordered the large and thought they fit just fine with room for a little shrinkage later. Unlike one reviewer, I found the grip beads on the palms perfect. I marched in a HOT Fourth of July parade today and they were a GOOD grip. I carried a metal pole with sweaty hands. No problems at all.

Also, the photo seems to exaggerate a coarseness to the look in stitching and texture that was FAR LESS so when I opened them. From a few feet away, they look very nice. They certainly would to viewers of a parade.

title: Careful consideration is needed to purchase this item
text:
I recently received this item from China. The item is as pictured except for one thing. The wings do not lay flat like I assumed. The pin runs vertically on the back of one of the wings. So with every movement the pin rocks which is not something you want with such a large pin. I carefully stuffed material on the back side of the pin to keep it stabilized. However, this didn't solve the problem concerning the way the wings are displayed as a two dimension effect.

It's kind of hard to explain. But the weight of the pin isn't so heavy that the pin pulls forward from the material it's pinned against. But because the wings do not lay flat, it's as if it had. Essentially this is not the best designed pin to have in your collection. The wings are a great distance from whatever they are pinned to. I haven't measured but it could be as much as 1/2".

title: I'm on the fence about this top
text:
I should start off by saying I do not wash anything by hand. So I washed this top in the machine in cold water and hung to dry. Of course being rayon, it was a wrinkled mess but I was afraid it would shrink if I put it in the dryer. I ended up putting it in the dryer at the end of a load that was already in there. It didn't shrink and it got most of the wrinkles out. I think I'll be putting this in the dryer next time and not bother hanging it to dry.

I am 5'4", weigh 147, wear 38C bra, normally wear a 14 and have an apple shape. I like the length of this top. It's a great length to wear with leggings and covers my butt. As I said I am apple shaped so could stand to have it slightly looser in the waist but chest and shoulders fit perfectly.

This top is very light weight and perfect for summer. Although tag reads rayon and spandex, description of shirt says, "Material: high quality cotton and polyester". No where is rayon listed in description.

I'm giving this top a 4 star rating because I can't give a 3-1/2. The low price definitely helped with the rating.

title: Very nicely made and designed. Perfect vacation hat
text: Unfortunately the neck strap was lost between ordering and receiving - i made another. This thing is awesome. I live in Japan and sun hats are a part of life (no woman wants a tan here!) but as a taller caucasian lady with fairly thick, curly (very)  hair, I've had a hard time finding a hat that fits without feeling like I crammed my skull into a child's hat. This? Actually ever so slightly loose, I can slide my pinky between the band and my head which is perfect as it leaves a touch of room for flatter hair clips or decorative Bobby pins. The detachable brim is huge, it actually shades the width of my shoulders but it looks adorable and between the wired brim and nicely stiff material, it doesn't flop onto my eyes. The bucket style, once the brim is removed, is perfect for more on and off days when I'll only be in the sun between jaunts to the car. The buttons are actually quite nice looking, I'd worried they'd seem weird. It has held up to a sticky handed toddler and two washes (using woolite in the sink) without looking the worse for wear and it collapses well. I try not to cram it into purses or anything since it will Wrinkle a bit, but it's weathered a few hours flying in a carryon and come out looking pretty nice - nothing a steam in the shower didn't fix.

title: Have held up a year of use, international travel and constant on off wear while keeping their shape.
text: Even too big for me (I was between sizes) these slippers are perfect for what I was after. I'm a full time mom and often indoors with my toddler in a japanese apartment with very slick laminate wood flooring and tatami mats so I wanted something a little non-slip, a bit of cushioning and some warmth that wouldn't fall off my feet but was easy to take off whenever I need to go into our tatami room (no shoes on reed flooring)- these are comfortable to wear, even in a Tokyo summer, and breathe well which was a pleasant surprise, and fit all my needs. They also don't quite look like old lady shoes or something too cute and childish if I need to open the door for deliveries or mail during the day. The travel well too, I've had these on an international flight and once in the seat with my child, sneakers off, slippers on to keep from being that person on the flight airing out their bare feet for all to see :( These launder well, wad up fairly compact in a carry on if that's a concern, and dry quickly. The foam (obviously) compacts during wear so they definitely lose their cushiony feel after standing on them for a bit, but I think that's just an obvious reality of a slipper versus a more substantial shoe. Good product, will buy again if mine ever wear out.

title: I was extremely pleased! I will warn you that these suits run ...
text:
I needed several new swimsuits for a trip to the Dominican. I really did not want to spend crazy amounts of money. I did my reading of all reviews of anything I ordered. However, I was still nervous. I have to say of the four suits I purchased from Runbox...I was extremely pleased! I will warn you that these suits run very very small. I took the time to read through and find customers who reported being my size and looking at the photos as well as the size that they ordered. I typically wear a sz 14 or Large to Extra Large. I am 5'8...185 pounds and bust size is 36DD. The 3XL fit perfect.

What I feel was most impressive was the quality. I had not in any way expected this. These swimsuits are better quality by far than something I would have purchased from Target or Khols. I know I will be wearing them for several seasons.

If there was one issue of concern...it was the clasp. It is very simple and therefore I stressed that it would unexpectedly come undone. However, this never happened and by the second full day on the beach I realized that I had no reason for concern.

I will be ordering from Runbox in the future!

title: Thick, soft, shiny, well-made wig
text: This wig is what you want. Of course it is thick and heavy so I would advise getting it thinned. I liked that they have the ponytail detachable - you can adjust the head part how you like it and then put the ponytail on. This makes it easier than trying to put on such a bulky and unwieldy wig all at once. It looks like a wine color in the photo, but don't worry about it fitting Kyoko Sakura from PMMM, it is definitely more bright red irl. It's soft, shiny, and even though I've worn it a few times it still didn't get frayed or tangled. As long as you take care of it, this should be a good cosplay wig. Does not come with a wig cap, so if you're thinking of ordering this one I would consider ordering one at the same time. I didn't really need one, but it does make it easier to get your bangs pinned back.

text:
I am very glad I read the reviews and decided on this Alice costume. It fits me perfectly (I'm about 125 lbs, 5'3") but my favorite part is that this dress is an appropriate length. Still short but I could bend over without my whole booty falling out. The fit is not skin tight but is snug and cut correctly which is nice because after all that Halloween candy I need a bit of wiggle room (don't we all?). I love that the neckline is high and that this is an actual Alice costume- not an opportunity to dress like a "you-know-what" and get away with it, just because it's Halloween. As others have mentioned, the sleeves on this dress do make arm movements slightly limited. But unless you're playing volleyball in it I don't see it being any sort of problem. My favorite part is the apron. It really is adorable and looks just like the picture when it's on.

This costume is very well made for the price I'm happy with the purchase and can't wait to wear it this Halloween!

text:

There's enough padding that they can be worn under just about everything, however, there's no lift or pushup so still have to wear regular bras under nicer blouses. I will turn them into nursing bras when baby comes in June and I think they'll work perfectly for that as well.

These will also be great for wearing under summer clothing like low cut, flowy dresses etc. where you wouldn't want a regular bra with clasps hanging out the back.

Even with my growing "size" I wouldn't mind these fitting a bit more snugly. But the adjustable straps make them very comfortable.

title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words
text:
[[VIDEOID:4a95b9fc4789fb40771178f296c15cee]] For what this is, it is VERY nice.
No, it isn't supposed to look like a diamond pendant worth thousands, and if that is what you are looking for you will not be happy with this.

It looks like what it is...a highly polished costume jewelry pendant with crystals.
And it is just lovely. It is well worth the money at under twenty dollars, but judge for yourself by the video.

It is a golden heart inside of a silver one, and the silvertone has a double row of crystals. Not the super sparkly kind, but crystals none the less. In my opinion, it is a little nicer than my video could capture.
Mixing metal tones is not only very trendy, but also allows you to choose whatever metal color you like for your other jewelry you wear that day. It will go with your gold hoops or your silver huggies.

Threaded through is a petite box chain. The heart doesn't slip around easily, which is a huge plus. How many times have you worn a pendant only to look in the mirror and the clasp is no longer at the back of your neck?
This one stays put.
The clasp is easy, it's the lobster claw type. Sometimes they are hard to open, but this one unlocks smoothly, although if you have absolutely no fingernails you'll have to master using the side of your thumb or finger. The extender has a tiny little fob at the end, a nice little touch.

If you are thinking of getting it for someone else as a gift, it comes on a card that is in a clear bag, and then inside of a velvet drawstring pouch.
The velvet isn't that awful scratchy kind that screams 'Cheap Stuff Inside!'. It is soft, and printed with the company name (Mondaynoon Jewelry) in gold.
Shipping was a lot quicker than I expected. It was nicely padded in bubble wrap for protection from careless postal equipment.

Is it Tiffany? No, of course not. But if you've ever been in the costume jewelry department at Penneys or even Macy's, they sell similar things.

For Christmas, as a holiday stocking stuffer, a birthday, or for Valentine's Day, or just because someone likes hearts, this is a sweet little gift.

title: Bad Batch? Wrong Product?
text:
With a great big bottle of hand sanitizer, I was looking forward to decanting into smaller bottles for on-the-go.
I understand that it's a fine line between getting a flip top strong and tight enough to stay closed, yet loose enough to open easily.
It could very well be that I got a bad batch, but each and every flip top was so hard to open that I had to not only use two hands, but also struggle a bit. Sometimes more than a bit.
Closing them is easier, but you still have to press very hard to get them to snap closed all the way.
All that aside, they're actually very nice bottles. I will not be able to use the flip top, I will have to unscrew the bottle each time I want to use some hand sanitizer.
If you have extremely strong hands, and don't have any fingernails that might get broken, maybe these will be all right for you. It's also a possibility that after opening and closing 10 or 20 times, they would loosen up. Unfortunately, I don't have it in me to open them up even once or twice.

also I'm not sure if this makes a difference, but the bottles I received are slightly different than the photograph in the sale listing. Three stars just in case there was some sort of mix-up in what was received.

title: No Side Gaps! And UPDATE
text:
I've been a germaphobe long before the pandemic, and one thing I really liked about this mask is that it arrives in a sealed bag. No chance of it being used by someone else and returned, and I've had that happen.
The color is between purple and magenta, probably a little more magenta. It's a nice bold statement.
Another thing to love is that it's adjustable thanks to the beads as shown in the photograph. You get a perfect fit because the beads adjust the elastic. That makes this mask very comfortable.
The inside of it is a nice clean white, and it's quilted which I find very comfortable.
Best of all it doesn't leave the side gaps that disposable masks are known for. It totally covers your nose mouth and chin.
Very pleased.

UPDATE: Even while social distancing, I wear lipstick. LOTS of lipstick. So naturally, I got some on the inside of this mask, which by the way is still one of the most comfortable and nice looking masks I have. Hand washed it, and the lipstick came right out. Yet another reason why I'm very happy with this mask. Stay safe everyone!

title: My pics show the front and side views as best as I could do with my tablet camera
text:
My pics show the front and side views as best as I could do with my tablet camera. This thing is very, very long, I'm 5'8" or so and it sweeps the floor unless I pull it up over my navel...attractive. It has four big, thin, chiffon like panels that are evenly gathered around an elastic waist band giving a nice round barrel look. Forget that sleek, flattering look you see on the model, you won't get that. It could've done with 2 to 2-1/2 panels for the skirt to look like what's actually pictured.
I like the color and pattern, it's see thru fabric but has a non-see thru built in slip below the knee. And it is fixable if you're good at alterations. But that's not why we BUY our clothes, is it? I can alter it but I'm not sure I want to bother. I'll mull it over some since it's winter and this is definitely a summer skirt. On the bright side, if your 5-11, 6 feet and you love ruffles, this is the skirt for you.

title: Runs on the small side. Good for average size heads and smaller. Easy to adjust; strap snaps in place.
text:
This is a cute little cap and I like how easy it is to throw on if I need to run out on a quick errand, check the mailbox, take my dog on a walk, etc. At first, I thought it might not fit since I have a bigger than average head (LOL) and poofy hair! Luckily, the strap is adjustable and pretty easy to adjust so that you get a tighter or looser fit.

Once I lengthened the strap as much as I could, it did fit but fit snuggly. It's hard to get the cap all the way down on my forehead but it fits and looks fine, nonetheless. The back strap snaps in place and doesn't come loose. The cap itself is soft while the bill is pretty hard. I like the look of the hat on me and so does my husband. I only wish it could be a little looser so that I can pull it all the way down.

I am honored to have received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. All opinions are 100% mine.

title: Perfect for the right person. Comfortable, stylish and easy to change your look.
text:
My husband's favorite color is red, so he was drawn to these right away. The color is very bright and bold. The lenses are stylish and have a mirror finish. It's pretty cool that you can change the lenses whenever you want to suit your needs or match your outfit. Changing the lens is fairly easy.

Looks and style is obviously according to your own personal preference. My husband and I both like them just fine. They fit him very comfortably and he likes that they hide his eyes. They're great for blocking the sun and make it easier to drive on extremely sunny days (which we often have here in the South).

They come with a nice, sturdy and hard case that is very protective. There is a little sleeve with four different slots to hold each lens. Yes, the case is large but it has to be to hold these sunglasses along with the lenses and other accessories. Speaking of accessories, there are plenty of them and all very useful: straps, cleaning cloth, holding case, etc. If you like to change up your look often, I think it's a great set.

title: great value
text:
Just received this so i cant comment on reliability or accuracy. The face is MUCH whiter than appears in the picture, but in certain angles it looks quite nice (especially on a brown strap). The gold numerals are a bit difficult to read in direct sunlight, but holding the watch at an angle fixes this. Very light, good quality feel, (russian) movement is completely undecorated and unpolished... I wish there was a little finishing. My only real complaint is that the movement is also shared by the female equivalent of this watch and as such is quite small. It is held into the center of the case by a white ring which is not visible through the caseback, however, if you remove the caseback, the ring is evident and gives the watch a cheap feel.I wish there was a date complication, but i can get over that.

I would definitely recommend this watch - where else can you get a German made (albeit Russian movement) dual sapphire watch for less than $150

title: Several zipper compartments
text:
This is a nice large sized purse. I like my purse to have multiple zipper compartments, preferably two in front, one in back, and on the main part. It's actually not so easy to find a purse with the zippers I want, in a good quality material that won't fall apart in a month or two. I can't vouch for the quality of the material on this one yet, but it feels decently durable so far. And it has all the minimum pockets I need.
The front pockets can fit keys and other small objects. The back pocket fits a cell phone (probably not the overly long ones), or other items in that size range. The main pocket fits a small sized umbrella (about 10" maybe) and most random but necessary paraphernalia that somehow ends up in our purses.
I wasn't specifically looking for the additional wristlet that came with this purse, but it's a nice addition.

Tl;dr: nice large purse. Feels like good sturdy material. Nice amount of zippered compartments.

title: Sturdy Strap/Belt!!!
text:
I wanted this Belt mainly for securing our soft luggage pieces (medium and small sized duffel bags and back packs) into a more compact width size(able to do so by stacking) to save space in the back of our Ford Cmax Hybrid without the pieces falling over. The cargo space in the rear of these cars are not very spacious. You can stack things higher though! Anyway this belt did help me to achieve my desired outcome.

When unboxing the strap/belt came in a nice zip slide protective bag. Nice little touch in my opinion.

-This belt material is sturdy, nice and thick, and well made.

-The Belt width is about 2 inches wide.

-The clasp is a hard plastic, it is also very sturdy and will not come apart. I doubt it would be easily broken either.

- I did not measure it. But the belt length does adjust to be quite long!

- The color I chose was orange, because I personally thought it was the nicest looking of all the color choices.

I can see many useful purposes people may want this. My purpose may be one of the rare ones, but if I were to travel by any form of public transportation with luggage... especially when they put your luggage in an area away from you, this strap would provide a sense of extra security, a brightly colored identifier, that would make it easier to spot on a curb, or a baggage claim conveyor belt.

This is a great strap made very well!

***I received this BlueCostco Luggage Strap/Belt at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest unbiased review***

title: Too childish, too fluffy and stiff in the waist
text:
This dress left me feeling very indifferent.
I did not find anything special about it.
I can not say it is ugly, it is just that I did not like it.
It looks like replica of a doll dress, too childish, maybe ok for a child, but not for a woman.
I was way to fluffy in the hip/waist area that it made the bottom look heavy and bulky.
The fluffiness is not the "flowy" kind (tuille is probably too thick for that),
but has a very stiff pastic-y looking "fixed" look, it does not move when you move.

It might be a good fit for someone very skinny with narrow hips and/or rectangular shape since it will create the curves for them.
For someone with a little extra pounds it will be too boxy and unflattering.

I feel like the quality is good for the price.
And if you will be willing to invest some time to rearrange the waist area, this dress could be very beautiful.

I am 5'5'' 144 lb, 36DD/E. My measurements are 39.8 (101cm)/ 34 (87cm)/ 39.8 (101cm).
I recommend to base your sizing for this dress on the chest circumference since it will be (too) roomy on the bottom anyways.
I ordered size M and I feel that it is slightly on a smaller side of M or a larger side of S in the chest.

Do not buy it!

title: Not genuine leather
text: At first I thought it was leather, but after a closer inspection I decided this is actually not genuine leather and definitely not high quality cowhide leather. In fact the outer layer is completely synthetic. I was able to pick away some of the outer part with my nails at a not so visible place so don't accidentally ruin the bag and it looked and burned like plastic. The inner layer feels like leather as well but after picking away some parts it actually looks like fiber. The bag does not have any of the leather odor I'm used to. It's very good quality and very much like leather bag but that's all it is. If you look at the images, there's a distinct separation between the outer synthetic and the inner fiber like leatherette. And the pattern of the leatherette is very uniform. The inside pouch with zipper is obviously all synthetic. It's cute and keeps your stuff in. I still like the bag and will keep using it. It looks like it's sturdy and can last a good while. I removed 2 stars for false advertisement, other wise it's a nice tote.

title: Secure for shopping or theme park
text:
This bag is way more useful than I thought it would be! It has 5 different compartments and can hold quite a few items before it becomes bulky.

The three interior pockets can be closed off with a zipper. And one of the pockets has 3 card slots. That pocket is so hidden, I didn't realize it was there at first. No one is going to slip their hand into your bag. Two more pockets are on the outside. One pocket is large enough for a cell phone and is closed off by a flap with a magnet - so you don't have to go into the zippered section to retrieve your phone. The final pocket is on the back of the purse and is closed by a zipper.

I used this for shopping trips and it gave me the security of knowing my money, cards and phone were close to me while my hands and arms were free. It's also thin enough to be good for theme park visits when you don't want to drag around a purse or backpack. You just can't wear this on the thrill rides (coasters, etc).

I have the brown bag and I think it looks fairly attractive. The strap is adjustable. The different compartments are all lined and the compartments are about as deep as a woman's hand is long - so you won't lose items inside them.

text:
Epic watch. Truly looks vintage and substantially more expensive than the 60-70 USD you can acquire it for.

I have several Orients and Seiko 5s and this watch is my unequivocal favorite.

I've been wearing it a week or so, in the shower, etc., and it's keeping accurate time.

The push-bottom to scroll through DAYs on the day complication is a nice feature.

The lume is extremely weak, but that is its sole problem as far as I'm concerned.

EDIT: Its diameter, by the way, is 36mm. It's very chic and understated, while absolutely gorgeous. Does not look contemporary in any way - but vintage. Second hand beats at 6 but looks smoother owing to the faceted crystal, which is a genius touch.

Many other reviewers have mentioned that the dress doesn't fit like on the model but I think that is because most of us (myself included) don't have a model body and breasts that stand perfectly at attention (LOL). text:
Very soft scarf. Pretty for fall and early winter. It is very long and could be wrapped and knotted many different ways. It is not super heavy so could be worn indoors if you are cold natured or work in a cooler temp building. It is so wide you could drape around your shoulders to ward off the chill.

It it easy to wear, and functional, hypoallergenic and Oeko-Tex certified.

This is one of the softest scarves with a brushed quality which gives it the softness of cashmere at much better value. European designed and produced in Germany.

A quick hand wash in the sink with cool water and lay it out to dry. No need to worry about ironing here!

If you would prefer not to wear, it would make a lovely table runner for fall and Thanksgiving.

title: Keeps Your Mask Where You Can Find It
text:
On second thought, I probably didn’t need this many. But, for this price, I can gladly share some with friends.

These lanyards are sturdy enough that needing to replace them won’t be an issue. The color options ensure that I will always have something that will blend in with whatever shirt I am wearing. I especially appreciate the tail adjustment that allows me to cinch the band around my ponytail so that the strap is not flopping on my back.

These are great little tools to keep my mask close when I am putting it on and off during the day. I don’t have to worry about losing it or stowing it in a dirty pocket.

These lanyards are also pretty versatile. They can be used as hat or glove keepers. I can use them to attached something to my coat or gym bag, . . . . I will definitely find a job for each strap in the package.

I have found that the plastic clips have a little gap, just big enough to slide off of some ear straps - particularly the ones found on disposable masks. Now that I am aware, I make it a point to occasionally check that it is still attached. That little quirk is not enough to remove a star or stop me from recommending these to anyone searching for a simple way to stop losing masks.

title: Wonderful Product!
text:
I am a crafter with a touch of OCD so I have been searching for the perfect organizer for small parts for a long time. I have tried various different containers with compartments such as [Akro-Mils 5807 Plastic Parts Storage Case for Hardware and Craft, Medium] and [Jolee Jewels Storage Bead Container, Mix 3] but this is the one that has worked out perfectly. I currently scrapbook and make cards so this item stores all of my brads and eyelets along with a few other embellishments. I am thrilled that each compartment actually does hold a substantial amount of product. Even better is that I can see all of the contents through the lid of the box. Because each container is the lid of the next container, they take up so little space. It amazes me that the same items I stored in multiple boxes and locations now fit in just one and a half of these containers. I currently have two of these boxes but I am contemplating getting a third if the second gets full (but hopefully instead I can limit my spending).

Comparison:

In comparison to the Jolee Jewels Storage Bead Container, this item wins HANDS DOWN. The Jolee comes with 10 larger containers and 20 smaller ones. The smaller ones are double compartment containers so the amount of items they hold is incredibly small (I can't even fit the tip of my pinkie finger in one of them). The only thing they really fit well were my swarovski crystal embellishments. Those items were TI---NY. The larger containers are comparable to the size of the containers in this current item. However, this item has thirty containers and the Jolee only has 10 compartments of that size. I would have to buy 3 Jolee boxes to have the space in just one of these items, and the Jolee boxes would take up much more room.

In comparison to the Akro-Mils container, this item far surpasses in organization and functionality. The Akro-Mils box has a maximum of 15 sections, and a minimum of 2 sections. Even with the maximum, the compartments are huge. The whole box is bigger than this Storage Box Divider Tray, so it holds less but takes up more space doing it. I would have to buy 2 of the Akro-Mils containers to equal the 30 compartments in just one of these containers. And each of those two would be larger than this one box. On the other hand, The Akro-Mils does hold larger items. But for the eyelets and the brads, this box is PERFECT. At the moment, my Akro-Mils box only holds smaller containers of embossing powders and glitter. Personally, this is my least favorite storage container and I do regret buying it.

In comparison to a couple other boxes I have purchased from the Art Store made by Art Bin, I still prefer this container, at least for brads and eyelets. The Art Bin containers have 18 and 36 slots each and they are perfect for holding larger items such as buttons, pins, and brackets. These are my second favorite storage containers after the one featured here. The reason these Art Bin containers are not as good as the Storage Box Divider is that they take up more space and it is easier for items to get mixed up together since they do not have their own separate containers within the box. Also, with the Art Bin containers, it is not as easy to travel with just those items you will need. Instead you have to take the whole box. With the Storage Box Divider, you can actually just take a few containers with you to a gathering instead of the whole set of items, making travel much easier.

All in all, this is the perfect box for very small items.

title: They're fine, seem to be holding up ok
text:
These were a cheap, temporary solution while looking for something warmer/better quality. They're sorta medium weight, but very thin in the areas where they stretch (heels, toes). But they're surprisingly warm.

They do have a bit of hanging threads inside behind all the lamas/coffee cups, which I kinda hate ... but my toes don't seem to catch the threads as I'm putting them on. They'd be better, too, if they came in at least a couple of sizes. This one-size fits all thing means the reinforced heel goes well past my heel.

The big toe section is fine ... the section for the rest of the toes is a little weird but not uncomfortably so.

They've now been washed multiple times and to my surprise, they're holding up well. No holes or running threads inside. I don't expect them to last years but they are better than I expected.

title: Weird Fabric
text:
I really wanted to love this dress, but it has some things I am not a fan of. Let me start by talking about the fabric of this dress. The fabric is very heavy. I have quite a few vintage style dresses and none of them are made from this type of fabric. It is thick and stretchy. It reminds me of a table cloth or upholstery on a restaurant chair. There is an invisible zipper down the back. The front has false buttons on the front and a collar with bow in the center. The bow is probably my least favorite part of the dress. The bow is two stretchy ribbons that are sewn in between the collar points in the front. No matter how I tie the bow it makes the collar lay weirdly. It would have been better to have a pre-tied sewn together bow.
I am about 5’6.5” tall and weigh between 135-140 pounds. I usually wear a US M or 6-8. After looking at the measurements in their size chart I ordered a large. The large is a smidgen too big, but a medium probably would have been tight. The bust of this dress is larger than I wanted. I need to wear a good push up bra with it to make it look good. This dress can be worn with or without a petticoat. I prefer it with a petticoat. I wear it with a 26-inch black petticoat. The petticoat adds a fullness to the skirt that I love. Because of the thickness and stiffness of this fabric it does look better without a petticoat than some vintage style dresses. This dress is okay, but the fabric and the bow make it not as good as I would like.

I received a discount on this product in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

title: Good Dress for Church
text:
This dress is cute. I am always looking for good dresses for church. A good church dress needs to be nice looking and a good length without being frumpy. I also love when I can find a dress with sleeves. So many dresses now days have no sleeves. Finding a dress with cute short sleeves or cap sleeves is great for me. The top of this dress is black and is a soft fabric that is a blend of cotton, polyester, and spandex. This fabric is thick enough to not be see-through but still light enough to be comfortable. It fits well, hugging my curves, while not being super tight. The skirt is a polyester and spandex mix. It has a different feel than the top. It is a pretty white fabric with a blue, grey, and yellow floral pattern. The skirt is full and hangs beautifully. It also comes with a narrow red belt. The dress does not have belt loops so the belt just sits around your waist. I am torn between liking the belt and liking it better without the belt. Part of the reason I am torn is because the tail of the belt is too long when I wear it and it feels a little awkward.
I ordered this dress in a large. I normally wear a medium or US 6-8. Make sure you use the size chart in the product description when you are picking your size. I weight about 135 and am about 5’6.5” tall. The medium would have been too small, but the large is a tiny bit bigger than I would like in the waist. Overall it fits pretty well. The neckline is perfect. It is not too high or too low. This dress looks pretty good on me. I like to wear it with a pretty silver necklace or with pearls. You can wear it with red, black, or even white shoes and look great. The skirt falls right on my knees. It is a nice length. Not too long not too short. I like this dress but it does have a couple of minor things that keep it from being perfect.

I received a discount on this product in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

title: Disappointed, used Bitbelts website and JR did not fit my Samsung Gear Fit.
text:
I'm a bit disappointed. I went to Bitbelts website to figure out what would fit my Samsung Gear Fit and they said the Bitbelt Jr. Unfortunately, when they arrived it didn't fit. I can barely slide it onto the one half but there's no way I can fit the other end into this. The one side of the watch warps this like crazy. I think perhaps, the regular Bitbelt would have fit? I was only going off the recommendation of their website.

I think they should put sizes on their website to help with any confusion. That way you can measure your band and you'll be sure of the fit each time.

This would have worked well. I haven't had any issues with my Gear Fit, luckily, but I was trying to prevent it from becoming lose or losing it in the future. I suppose I'll just try to be more careful with it.

*UPDATE*
Okay, so I spoke with Bitbelt customer service and they told me that the Bitbelt Jr does fit snugly. I thought there was no possible way for it to fit so I tried it again. With a lot of pulling and tugging I was able to get it over both straps. So I tried putting it on my wrist and I'm struggling to get it on one handed. I don't want anything to be this difficult. Customer Service was very nice.

title: As promised
text: There eye masks do the job and are well constructed. The only reason I knocked off a star is that the curvature of the eye cups is not deep enough for me. I'm a night shift nurse and have to have an eye mask to sleep during the daytime...I like it pitch black. In order to block out all the light around the edges, I have to velcro it a little tighter on my head which flattens out the mask a tad. When I open my eyes with the mask on, my lashes brush the interior. Minor thing but when you HAVE to get great sleep and are a light sleeper, that minor little thing can wake you up enough to be annoying. That being said, I usually buy the 40 Blinks brand and comparatively, this mask seems to be superior in construction. It's been several months and the interior lining is not peeling up at all on me, which usually happens and signals immediate replacement for me. :) I think this is overall a great deal for the price. I do not use the earplugs but they seem pretty standard. I would recommend this sleep mask bundle to others.

title: Wide and thick celestial ring with nice details.
text:
This is a pretty big hunk of metal, 12 mm wide and 3 mm thick. The inside is smoothly rounded for enhanced comfort. In theory it could be worn by a man or woman, if it is available in their size, it probably works best as a man's ring, due to it's size. I ordered a size 10, and mine is actually slightly oversize, maybe a 10 1/4, but it still fits well and doesn't fall off my finger. Despite it's large size, it's comfortable enough that i can forget it's there.

The deeply cast design consists of a vintage Sun and a vintage crescent Moon, both with faces, 180 degrees apart. They are joined by a sort of vine which weaves between a background of stars. The vine may possibly represent the ecliptic, the apparent path made by the Sun during the year.

The surfaces of the Sun, Moon and stars, as well as the vine, are all highly polished. The background is unpolished, and either oxidized or painted black. The ring is cast from very durable stainless steel, and should last a very long time, possibly longer than the original purchaser.

title: These sandals take my PF away. I wore them for >17 miles over two days with no pain!
text:
I may be the only runner ever to stop running and then get plantar fasciitis. I stopped running because of the pandemic/quarantine (ah, depression) but started walking a lot in not-as-supportive shoes and wound up with heel and arch pain. That led me to searching out stuff to make walking painless again and I found Telic here on Amazon for a lot less than on their site. Bought one pair and it was INSTANT love. Now I own 4 pairs of Telic sandals and am getting one for my kid!

We took a summer road trip and did a 10-mile hike. Now that I don't run distance and do have PF, I was in a lot of pain after... until I put my Telics on and walked around in them and weirdly felt better almost instantly!

Last week we went to Disney World (the reports are true: definitely feels safer than the grocery store with all their protocols in place and super low crowds) and I brought two pairs of Telic sandals in case something happened to one of them. I rotated them every day and had zero foot pain despite walking a total of 47 miles over five days! They also were great for water rides and when it rained, because they don't slip, and water doesn't hurt them.

I've worn them to the beach, where sand rinses right off. I've worn the Mallory sandals to church. Quite simply, they are the best. I'll keep watching for deals on them to get more.

There are only two cons for me:
1. The flip-flops are ugly. They just are. They remind me of Crocs, honestly. But I don't care since they're so comfy. They are so good for my PF I can wear them all day around the house and switch into non-supportive shoes to go out and not die. I tried to paint the straps with acrylic silver paint and even went over it with an acrylic fixative, but they still flaked after a day of steady wear.
2. They do shrink in heat. They've been fine at the beach in the shade and walking in Orlando summer heat, but I had to leave my extra pair in the car while I was at Disney our fourth day, and even though I insulated them and made sure they were out of the sun, they still shrunk a full size. :( But Telic customer support is great and they replaced that pair for me for free.

The Mallory run a little bit big compared to the Energy flip-flops in my experience. I'm a women's 10.5 and I went up to an 11 in both.

title: Snazzy, very slim a few caveats. Read on. Otherwise B+ is my grade.
text:
OK. Overall I like the watch. It's got a decent band with plenty TY of holes for my small wrists. The watch is very thin so not for people who prefer big watches. It's got a nice classy look and so far performs great and fits nice and I'm happy I received one free for an honest review.

Cons. I for the life of me can't figure out why the hour hand is a VERY deep red color. You can BARELY see it even outside in the sun but you can see it. I side the house in the evening I can't see it at all unless I hold it up under a light so that makes it really IMO a very odd color choice to even color the hour hand. It should be left white to match the second and minute hands. Another thing is the second hand is much larger than the minute hand. Usually the second hand that ticks is the skinniest because it's usually the most irrelevant hand to see unless it's a chronograph watch which this isn't.

Overall the look is slick and I like the pattern behind the glass etc, all that is cool but the hour hand illegibility makes it hard to give it a five star so I'm giving it a 4 for great looks, a nice slim fit if you don't want to bang a big watch in walls and such but it's still pretty cool looking so I'd still wear it out to dinner when dressed up etc. But PKEASE change the hour hand to white or silver. That was a poor design choice big-time.

My honest review. Thank you.

title: Beneficial Tool If Used, Very Giftable
text: This INSYOHO Anxiety Relief Necklace is a very well made and handsome looking item. It comes with a gift case, the anxiety tool and chain, a very nice tan suede carrying pouch, and a simple bifold card with instructions on how to use this device. I chose mine in Matte Black. This is an effective tool for bringing a sense of calm and regaining emotional control. It's use is simple. While the same thing could be accomplished with simple deep breathing exercises, this tool creates a focal point for doing the breathing, and serves as a constant reminder and comfort when being worn as a necklace. I do not suffer form panic attacks myself, but I know how devastating and crippling they can be for someone who does. The current listing price of $45.59 for this necklace seems pricey, but it is far cheaper, faster, and easier than a visit to the emergency room to deal with a full blown panic attack. I feel that if it works for the person who has it, then it is a good value, it's that simple. I consider this a thoughtful, useful, and elegant gift for anyone who might need it.
