title: Comfortable, Good at Blocking Loud Background Noise
text: This package of Banaware High Fidelity Earplugs comes with two pairs of silicone earplugs (one larger, one smaller), a blue carrying case with a carabiner clip, and a set of instructions. The larger pair of earplugs has a noise-reduction filter in each earplug. If you need to switch to the smaller earplugs, the instructions tell you how to remove the filter from the larger set and reinsert it into the smaller set. The larger set fit fine for me so I didn't need to do any of that, but it's nice to know I have that option if I decide to let my wife borrow them. These earplugs work very well to reduce loud noise to a more comfortable level, and they are easy to wear all day without any discomfort. They are also extremely easy to clean. I love the carrying case, and can clip it to my backpack when I'm traveling, and to my belt loop when I'm otherwise out and about. I like the fact that these earplugs do not block all noise, but instead just bring it down a notch. I still want to be able to hear and react in case of emergencies, and even to respond to something as basic as my phone or doorbell ringing. These allow me to do that. This set of Banaware earplugs is currently marked down to $15.29 from their former price of $20.99, and I consider this a good value. They also make a nice gift for anyone who works, lives, or plays in a noisy environment.

title: Delightfully Comfortable, Love These Socks!
text: Per my wife: I had never worn bamboo socks before. From the moment I slipped these socks over my feet, I fell in love with them. I ordered one pair of white socks with ribbons of black on the soles. The toes and heels are nicely padded, and the seams are smooth and well sewn. The socks hug my feet nicely, without being too tight or too loose. They stay up well. The sock has two bands of cross mesh material that run across the top part of the sock. The lower one is about two inches wide and runs from about halfway down the length of my toes to an equal distance on the other side of where the toes meet the rest of my foot. The upper cross mesh band is about 1 3/4 inches wide and runs from halfway through my ankle joints down to the beginning of the arches of my feet. These cross mesh bands seem to provide extra breathability and keep my feet from sweating so much when walking. In between these two cross mesh bands is a white band of ribboned material that runs vertically. As previously mentioned, the sole of the sock is also ribboned with alternating white and black stripes. That covers the physical description. What is harder to describe is the FEELING these socks provide when worn. It's like a delightfully soft foot massage that stretches and moves with every step. It's pretty rare when a sock makes me go "Ahhhh" when I put it on, but these definitely do. I am now a definite fan of bamboo socks, especially these made by Sunew. 5 stars!

title: Good Work Belts, Good Price
text: These are extremely strong work type belts.  Having worn actual "tactical" belts I wouldn't actually call these "tactical" unless you're talking about paintball.  I've been using these type belts for the past year or so and none have worn out yet.  I suspect they'll outlive me.  Important to note that you do have to remove one of the buckles to fit the belt through standard belt loops.  Bottom line is that the quick release feature works great if you're not changing the belt but every time you put the belt on a new pair of pants, you have to remove one of the buckles - and you can only remove one of the two - in order to string it through a normal set of belt loops.  Basically you leave the two parts of the "buckle" connected, sting the belt through your belt loops and then restring the webbing  through the one side of the buckle.  It's quick and easy once you get used to it.  They recommend that you not cut the belt but I cut it a 3 or 4 inches longer than I need and sear the new end with a heat gun.  Works great.  A number of 3 belts sets on Amazon are identical, and I mean identical, but these are the least expensive I've found.

title: Strong Wire Cable Attachment, Bright Color
text: This order comes with 6 bright orange silicone luggage tags. The owner information goes inside the tag with the exception of one line which shows through a clear window. I use that line for my last name, although it could also be used for an email address, a phone number, or just about anything. I like the security of not having my address displayed for the world to see as I get ready to leave town. The stainless steel cable that attaches the luggage tag to the luggage screws on and off. I counted 17 twists from the fully locked position before the cable was fully unlocked. Someone could always deliberately remove it, of course, but if I tighten it before I check my bag at the airport, it sure isn't going to accidentally come loose in transit, even with multiple plane changes. Each luggage tag measures 4 inches long, 2 1/2 inches wide, and a full 1/4 inch thick. It is very flexible, and the corners are rounded, so this should travel well without breaking or tearing. The bright orange tag is easy to spot from a distance, and will make identifying my bags a lot easier as they circle the baggage carousel. I am very satisfied with these luggage tags both in quantity and quality.

Unless my hands are in them, pulling them down - they are at my WAIST!
(Side pockets at the waist are NOT flattering on anyone!)
Then there are the sleeves - which seemed to be cut too high - no WAY was I able to roll them like the picture shows - they were at my armpit! Just so everyone knows - I even went up a size so it would be loose and flowy!
One last thing, there is a very odd seam across the middle of the back - adding some small pleats. This is not shown well in the pictures.
So very sad, I thought this was going to be "the" one for me.
I'm waiting on the response to return this, will update this review based on the ease of which it is done.
Very ODD cut - high neckline, short short sleeves, pockets at WAISTLINE ...And the search continues...

EDIT - This product just went down two stars because in order to send this back to China I have to FRONT the money ($20+) to pay for postage, then send the seller the tracking number in order for them to refund it! How about NO!! The "guarantee" says NO COST to return! I paid already over $20 for this and now have to double that to ship it back?!! I guess I'm STUCK with the thing - VERY UNHAPPY!!!

title: Perfect for staying cool in Texas summer!
text: My oldest son is disabled, and requires a wheelchair for mobility. It’s easy to overheat in a wheelchair (the chair restricts airflow) so my son typically wears tank tops everyday to help him stay cool. We purchased an adaptive jogger/bicycle for our son, and was needing something with more sun protection that would still keep him cool. These shirts have been perfect! While more of his body is covered, he doesn’t overhear. The shirts are well made, comfortable, and the colors are well pigmented. These wouldn’t withstand rough play, as they snag easily, but for running, cycle, and non contact sports, these are a great option. I bought mediums, and they fit well, if not a bit loose. I would say they run TTS.

title: Perfect Fall/Winter Boot
text:
For reference: I wear a size 8 1/2 in heels & casual shoes, and a size 9 in athletic shoes.

Ordered these in an 8 1/2, and they fit comfortably. I could easily wear thick socks with these with no issues. I do have to loosen laces when I put them on to get my heel in, but once they’re on they feel great!

These are so cute! Every time I wear these people stop me and ask where they can get them. I actually wore these to the DMV, and the ladies working that day were so distracted by my shoes, they forgot to do my vision test.

The only criticism I have about these boots is the name, I have to either get on peoples phones to pull up the product for them to order or have them take a picture of the listing on my phone.

I love these, and will be wearing them as much as possible this season!

title: Compact but spacious bag!
text:
This is definitely my new go to purse! It's made of leather and suede. It looks compact but it can hold a lot. Inside, I have my bulky wallet, crossword puzzle book, small notebook, two tablets, a comb, a compact mirror, lent roller, breast pads and pad pouch but there's still room to fit things on top. There's an inner zipper pocket which has my headphones, extra scrunchies, hair pins and a miniature sowing kit. The two inner pouches are filled with sanitizer, lotion, lip gloss, cotton swab travel pack and a mini notepad. It also comes with a front pouch which holds my vitamin pack, gum, more scrunchies, pens and hair pins. I say all this to show just how much the bag can fit. I'll see how well the straps can hold all of this over time. I do find the zipper to be a bit difficult to close (even before I packed the purse with my items) because the zipper descends like a roller coaster, but I greased it up zipped and unzipped it a few times and it seems to get easier each time. The strap of the bag is adjustable so you can shorten it to make it a hand bag or lengthen it to make it a shoulder bag. With everything that I packed the bag with the strap dug into my shoulder due to how heavy it was. I recommend packing less items if you're going to use it as a shoulder bag. Overall, it's a simple yet stylish bag. I find the bag to be versatile. You can wear it to work, a meeting, cocktail party and church. It's an everyday and everywhere type of bag. This is definitely good for the ladies who like to be prepared.
You even get a free clear drawstring backpack.

title: Quality timepiece, but . .
text:
I've had K&S watches for a couple of years now. And I must say this is a superb watch. Much better than my good Winner skeleton. This feels and looks high quality. It winds smooth. And the auto winder rotates easily. I'm in awe at the detail and quality for the price. Still need to learn how to get at the adjuster if necessary. Ordered mine for $15 less elsewhere and received it a week later from China with free shipping! Now that's a deal! Will buy again. You can't go wrong folks. It's a good watch. Be sure to get educated on the proper care of automatic watches. And you won't be disappointed.

Update - a few hours after initial enthusiasm I'm having a couple of problems. One is the offset center of the watch throws off your inborn logic as to the correct time especially around 9 and 3 o'clock. There are no numbers. The edge of the dial is too busy and confusing. I'd rather have a sweep second hand than that little red pointer spinning around. Company photo shows luminescent points of light at 5 minute intervals which is incorrect as only the hands glow in the dark faintly.The fake "tourbillon" of bright brass on the black face gets annoying after a while especially when all you want is a quick glance to check the time. It may be better with the white dial but in retrospect I would skip this model and look at their "Aviator" series or some other watch.

*update Oct. 2016* Watch is still going strong. Have worn it to work everyday. As a machinist I do a lot of wrenching and the watch gets wound automatically just fine. Have replaced the band with a good black mesh band. > Beauty7 Black 24mm Stainless Steel Shark Mesh Wrist Watch Band Strap Replacement Double Button Fold Clasp [[ASIN:B01LXHDZI7 Beauty7 Black 24mm Stainless Steel Shark Mesh Wrist Watch Band Strap Replacement Double Button Fold Clasp]] Still get compliments. Recommended.

For me personally, the elastic neck portion felt a little bit snug, but I know that it needs to be fairly close fitting to prevent air from escaping. It was slightly too loose around the neck for my 11-year-old.

text:
This product protected my Coolife suitcase while traveling overseas. However, I bought as advised, a size larger and the wheels kept getting caught in the fabric, and I t got pretty beaten up pretty badly.

I tried it on my largest bag before and after the flights. Before it seemed very tight, didn’t couldn’t get it on the larger bag. After the flights, it is tight, but I could get it on and zipped on the bottom.

The two largest Coolife bags are the only bags I will check when flying. Get yours a few weeks before you go so you can check the fit. The company is very good about returns.

I returned the XL after I found the L now fits my biggest bag. I just ordered a medium for the bag I used for this last trip. I’d advise for Coolife not to go up a size. On your biggest bag, muscle it on. Clearly I like the product as I just purchased the medium. I may be muscling on my medium. We’ll see. I adore this shirt! I ordered two, one in black and one in teal. I decided to get L in black and XL in teal because I had an event coming up and wanted to make sure at least one fit right. Happily I can actually wear either, but the L was the better fit. For comparison, I'm 5'8" and at the time of purchase I was about 25 lb heavier than now, so I wanted something to help camouflage my tummy and flab. I wasn't obese by any means, but definitely had some extra fluff to stuff. ;)

These are simply great and very attractive. I wore one with leggings and high top boots and it looked fantastic. Definitely versatile enough to dress up or down depending on the day. The neckline is stylish with a wide somewhat gathered scoop.

The sleeves were a little different than I'd expected, but not in a negative way. In the photo it looked more like what I would dub "princess sleeves" - tight on the lower arm and much looser above. Instead, it's considerably less pronounced than it appears in the images.

I really adore these shirts. They've come in handy for such a variety of occasions and I always feel comfortable and confident in them.

title: Review from 5'8" 150 lb 36C gal...
text:
For reference, I'm 5'8" 150 lbs and 36C. I purchased the L because I was concerned about it being too tight, but I should have gone with my normal M. It still fits and I'm keeping it (hopefully with a few tumbles thru the dryer it might shrink just a bit), but straight out of the package the L is just teetering on the verge of being too big to wear due to the style with the back of the shirt. The strap across the back feels a bit too loose at this size on me, but thankfully that's something I think I can fix with a needle and thread.

Other than the sizing mistake (my own fault obviously), the shirt itself is beautiful! Very stylish, comfy and high quality. It's nice and thick, smooth material, not too thin or clingy and definitely not see thru at all. It feels soft and somewhat breathable, not too heavy or hot.

I have a bit more fluff around my tummy than I'd like at the moment and for any of you ladies with the same issue you know it can be the death of an otherwise cute shirt depending on the "cling factor." This one is not an issue, at least not on my frame. Clearly a very well made garment and feels great on. Plus I love the unique design. It's sexy and flirty, but not at all cheap looking. Depending on what you pair it with, you could dress it up or down with ease. With my C cups the cleavage looks sexy and subtle, but not at all too low cut. It's a very stylish and elegant look.

Hope this review helps you ladies and that you look fabulous in this shirt! :)

title: Soft and cozy, well made, and one size will fit all...
text: These harem pants are soft and cozy, hit below the ankle (I am 5'4.5"), and the one-size fits my 14-16 frame very generously; if you are like me, with slow metabolism and always fighting--and yo-yo-ing with your weight--this garment is a great choice, because it should fit at pretty much any size, from 4-24. There are two differences from the photo, although the pants are so well-made, it is not a deal breaker for me: They do taper at the ankle, but immediately, without the pant leg narrowing gradually from just below the calf-- the more fitted look of separately tapered pant legs featured in the photo. Also, there is no little poof, or gathering sewn below each pocket, as in the photo, but even an amateur at hand sewing could put those in without much effort, and they are fine without. These are harem pants of medium weight cotton/spandex, absorbent enough to get away with wearing in warm weather, but best suited to fall, with a fitted top or as I have been wearing them lately, with a slouchy asymmetrically hemmed (triangular) sweater. Don't have a photo yet, but will see if I can add one later. All in all, this is another "can't miss" from Mordenmiss!

title: Great for everyday or work use
text:
[[VIDEOID:ed7d61f010f8777fbaeea9b7323618aa]] I received this tote from the manufacturer at no cost for evaluation, and here are my thoughts.

This small size wine red leather tote has a clean professional appearance that looks good enough to carry for everyday use or to work. It's large enough to fit everything I need on a daily basis without being overly big, and the handles are long enough to fit comfortably over my shoulder. It also comes with a detachable shoulder strap that adjusts long enough to carry it across a shoulder or cross body as well. It has a mild aroma when it first arrives, but that goes away in a day or two.

This is definitely made of leather, but it's not thick full grain leather like you would get with an expensive bag like Coach. Of course, this doesn't cost what those purses do either. This tote is made of split leather that's polished to a smooth finish then bonded to a thicker substrate material and given a protective coating to make it soft and pliable while also being scratch and water resistant. It won't last as long as a full grain leather purse would, but it's well made and should last more than long enough to get your money's worth from it at this price point.

The leather is soft, and the stitching is straight and tight. The tote has a reinforced bottom (without feet protectors), but it isn't a stiffly structured bag so it is sort of floppy when empty. It has a zippered top to secure the contents, and the interior is fully lined in a dark brown fabric that won't show ink stains or grime.

The inside is basically two large open compartments divided by a zippered center compartment with a zippered compartment on the rear wall and two sleeves for cell phone or other gadget on the other wall. I don't think this small bag could fit a laptop, but I was able to fit a full size iPad along with books and some spiral notebooks inside it and still zip it shut. The opening of the center zippered compartment was a little too small to be able to get a full size iPad in though, but you could fit an iPad mini or 7" Kindle into it without a problem.

The tote is well made with neatly done stitching, and zippers that open and close smoothly. The brass-tone hardware is lightweight and feels like plastic however, so while it's most likely adequate for everyday use, I'm not sure it could hold up to supporting a heavily loaded bag. All in all, this is a nice bag for the price, and it delivers the look of high end leather without the high price tag.

title: Whimsical and cute
text:
I received this bracelet from the manufacturer at no cost for evaluation, and here are my thoughts.

This is an adorably whimsical bracelet that features sparkling sapphire blue cubic zirconia stones and silvery moons along a 6.5" chain with a sturdy lobster claw clasp and a 1" extender. Made entirely of hypoallergenic 925 Sterling Silver that's been plated with Rhodium so it will never tarnish, the bracelet has four 6mm size blue sapphire colored zirconia stones and three smaller clear diamond-like cubic zirconia stones that are prong set onto the larger moons for a total of seven stones in all.

The brilliant sparkle of the cubic zirconia stones is beautifully balanced by the shimmering silver moons, and because of the flat backs the bracelet lays nicely without twisting when worn. The silver chain links connecting stones to moons are delicate enough to look nice yet also sturdy, and the lobster claw clasp is large enough that I can fasten the bracelet without assistance. I have average size wrists, and the bracelet fit me without needing to use the extender, but that extra inch the extender offers should make this bracelet long enough to fit most wrists.

Overall, this bracelet is feminine, whimsical, fun, and affordably priced. It's cute enough to be worn by grown up women or teenage girls, and it looks good with casual outfits.

title: Cute matching watch set
text:
This is an attractive looking matching watch set that would make a nice gift from a boyfriend to his girlfriend for Valentine's Day or to mark a special occassion. Each watch has a black dial which is textured in the center with tiny hearts, and inlaid rhinestones form one half of a heart which forms a whole heart when the couple wearing them holds hands. The men's watch contains the letters "Lo" where at the 3 o'clock position, and the women's watch has "ve" at the 9 o'clock position forming the word "love" when they come together.

The watches feature a glass lens, a Japanese Quartz movement, and stainless steel bracelets with push button deployment clasp closures. It's pretty easy to adjust the bracelet size yourself if you have a link removal tool ([[ASIN:B00HTU4OB0 Leegoal Watch Link Remover with Pins (12pins)]] ) to push the pins out with. According to the manufacturer's description, the watches are water resistant to 30 meters (99 ft), so they're safe to wear when washing your hands or caught outside in the rain, but not to swim or shower in.

Overall it's a cute inexpensive watch set that's most likely to hold more appeal for a woman than for a man. While a man might find the lovey dovey hearts and "love" a bit too sentimental for his liking as a daily wear item, the romantic sentimentality of the set will endear him to the woman he gives it to.

Sample provided directly by manufacturer for evaluation.

title: Gorgeous and practical women's leather wallet
text:
[[VIDEOID:ac9456b22b011f9bd0fa3c324f83a6dd]]This Yahoho leather wristlet wallet looks even more gorgeous in person than it does online, and it feels very soft and luxurious. I measured it to be 8.25" L x 4.5" H x 1" wide, which makes it a spacious enough to hold an iPhone 6+, but still comfortable to carry by hand if you didn't want to use the wristlet attachment.

It comes nicely presented in a dust cover inside a gift box that has a pretty polka dot and bow design. There is a mild new leather smell when you first remove it (which I happen to like), but it dissipates fairly rapidly once aired out for a day. The polishing, oiling, and waxing of the top grain leather results in beautiful patina that's glossy and buttery feeling, and also gives the wallet a high end look.

It is solidly constructed with contrasting thread and gold tone hardware that compliments the leather which is true in color to the product picture. This wallet has enough compartments to easily store money, my cell phone, Id card, store cards, bank cards, credit cards and then some, and it's the first wallet I've had where the card slots are actually the right depth for the cards and not too deep.

The outside of the wallet has a 7" x 2.75" zippered compartment for keys or other small items I want quick access too, and like the inside of the wallet, it's lined in a very attractive satiny feeling brown colored material with angled gold and black stripes. The zipper is well stitched in, has an attractive gold and leather pull, and opens and closes smoothly.

The main compartment has a sturdy zipper that functions well and also has an attractive gold and leather pull. The inside is also lined in the same beautiful satiny material, and there are an impressive amount of compartments and slots for cards (9 card slots and one transparent ID slot). There's a slot for bills on the back with slots for six cards in front of it, followed by an open sleeve for receipts or cell phone, a zippered compartment for change, followed by the see through ID card holder, three more card slots, another open sleeve, and finally another zippered storage compartment on the front inner wall.

The number of storage compartments and card slots this wallet has provide me with more than enough places to organize everything I need to carry, and it all looks and feels very well made. This is a beautiful wallet that is intelligently designed, practical, a nice size to carry, and it should provide many, many years of use.

This wristlet wallet was provided at no cost by the manufacturer for evaluation and review.

Measuring 7.2"L x 1.18"W x 4.25"H, the wallet has a snap down lid on the front that features six card slots, a see through slot for your ID card, and two sleeves for cash. The interior of the wallet has three compartments separated by a center divider for your bills, receipts, and cell phone, plus a zippered compartment on the rear wall for lip balm etc., and four more card slots. Finally, there's a snap closing pocket on the outside rear of the purse that can hold loose change, keys, and whatnot. Simply put, this is an attractive, well made and nicely organized leather wallet that can hold a surprising amount of stuff.

title: Platinum plated so it won't ever tarnish
text:
[[VIDEOID:5fe08120129044defabea18feea15ca3]] [[VIDEOID:a8c398caf3412f6f68f3e09e786fbdb7]] I received this bracelet directly from the manufacturer at no cost for evaluation during the product's launch, and here are my observations.

This platinum plated stamped 925 sterling silver bracelet is smooth, brightly polished and beautiful with its sparkling cubic zirconia encrusted bead shaped snap clasp closure. It's beautiful enough to be worn without adding any charms at all, but it does have the same diameter as a Pandora bracelet, so any charm that fit a Pandora bracelet will fit this one as well, and unlike a plain sterling silver bracelet, this one won't ever tarnish.

To open the clasp, you push your nail into the crack on the sparkling snap clasp bead, and it pops right open. I keep my nails on the shorter side, so this isn't a problem for me. Once you add beads to your bracelet be sure to add a bead stopper or a clip charm to keep your beads from dropping off when you open the bracelet. To close the bracelet again just insert the end and push the clasp back together over the end, but don't stop until you hear it click shut. Once it has clicked shut it is very secure and even tugging on the bracelet won't make it pop open.

title: A great way to get the look of high end leather without the high cost
text:
This tote in blue is absolutely gorgeous, and I love the soft buttery feel of the split leather it's made of. I'm 5'8" tall, and this tote is just the right size for me to carry, not too large and not too small. It's just the right size to carry my iPad plus a couple of spiral notebooks, an infusion bottle, and everything I need to take with me to classes. I begin my internship this coming summer and this tote will help enhance my professional appearance quite nicely.

I love how versatile this tote is. The short handles are rounded nicely for comfort when carrying it by hand, and the longer handles let me carry it over the crook of my arm, but what I really love best about this tote (besides it's appearance) is the fact that I can detach the longer handles entirely when I want to carry the tote as a shoulder bag! I prefer to carry shoulder bags, and this one comes with a detachable strap that adjusts long enough to carry it as a shoulder or cross body bag.

In addition to plenty of storage space and compartments inside the bag itself, there are two zippered storage compartments on the outside of the bag as well, a vertical one in front that's convenient for stashing my car keys and other small items, and a long deep pocket on the back big enough for my passport, boarding passes, or other items I'd prefer to keep right next to my body. All of the zippers open and close smoothly, both compartments are nicely lined, and that back compartment is large enough to even fit an iPad mini.

The main compartment of the tote has full zippered closure, and the interior is lined in a lovely brown fabric decorated in a hearts and flowers pattern. The spacious interior is divided into three sections by a zippered center compartment. Deep enough to hold a standard iPad or small tablet, with room left over for clutch and notebooks, there are two open sleeves for cell phone and another gadget on the wall of the front compartment, and a zippered compartment on the back wall of the rear compartment. Despite it's reasonable size, this tote offers plenty of storage capacity.

I'm very well satisfied with the workmanship and quality of this tote. All seams are impeccably stitched, and the hardware is actually sturdy metal rather than plastic, and nicely done in a silver tone that complements the color of the leather nicely. I really love how it looks and feels. In summary, if you're in the market for an attractive leather tote that's affordably priced this one is a good option. Sure, it's split leather rather than full grain, but for the price, this tote offers a very affordable way to get the look of high end leather without the exorbitant cost.

title: Soft absorbent lightweight robe

This is a full length robe that comes to just above my ankles, so while it fits me very nice (at 5'8"), a smaller person might find it a bit long. title: High quality boxer briefs
text:
It's hard to say a lot about men's underwear. Is it comfortable? Does it stay up? Does it breathe? Does it fit? Will it last under normal use?

This package arrived this morning, so I've been wearing a pair since then. It's comfortable. So far, it stays in place. It's cotton, so it wicks and allows moisture out. It mostly fits fine, and the material isn't flimsy. So it checks pretty much all the boxes for "good value for the price." The only thing that's a bit off is that the very back is a bit low at the waist. Not a big thing, not a deal-breaker, but the fit is definitely slightly different than my other underwear.

So buy and wear with confidence. There's nothing wrong with it.

metadata.title: Awesome 360 Men's Cotton Stretch Classic Fit Boxer Briefs, Multicolored, 3 Pack, L

title: Avoid
text:
My wife, who is just about exactly average size for an American woman tried this on. She had to scrunch her shoulders to keep from damaging the garment. Her arms had no range of motion. So right off the mark this product is not as advertised. It is closer to a Small than a Large. Three quarter length sleeves may be a thing, but even when the snapped-up portion was released they did not reach her wrists. It would take a strangely proportioned woman to fit this.

Taking a look at the jacket's construction, I was not impressed. The pockets were fake, just flaps where pockets should be. Anyone who has actually talked to women knows this is not acceptable. Women want pockets. It would not have damaged the appearance of the garment to provide pockets and would have only cost a few pennies, a definite strike against it.

The stitching on the outside was adequate. I don't think the sleeves are going to come off in normal use. The stitching on the lining is another matter. The stitches are long and widely spaced and not terribly sturdy. The lining is not well sewn-in, and I am afraid it will start coming out in fairly short order.

All in all this is not a good garment. The sizing is wrong. The construction is not great. The lack of pockets is worse than annoying.

title: LOVE the purse, but the color is more plummy than red. Works with medium felt organizer.
text:
I was disappointed that the color is much darker, more of a plummy burgundy than a red, than it looks on any of my devices or computers. If I had known, I would have chosen black instead. I realize color varies a lot on displays, but the color name is "red" so...

That said, I love the purse itself. It is incredibly roomy without looking like a hobo sack, and the two divided compartments make organizing/finding your stuff easy. The zippered tops also mean that if I have to slam on my brakes, my purse contents don't spill all over my car floor.

It's roomy enough to hold one of those structured felt purse organizer (medium), which I always use. I put all my gear in the organizer in one section, and the other holds a pouch full of my reusable shopping bags plus my ipad, which was a struggle for my last purse--and this one doesn't look any larger.

The two straps are wide and feel good on the shoulder. I love that if you want to use the detatchable, long crossbody strap, you can actually remove the shorter straps, so it doesn't look weird. They're secured with two heavy snaps through a ring at the end of each strap, both very secure and easily removable.

The main compartments each have an interior pocket as well. One side has a zippered pocket, and the other side has a unzipped pocket with a reinforced edge, which makes it easy to grab what's inside (I'm using it for keys).

There's also an exterior zippered pocket. It's too small for my absurdly clunky keys or bulky wallet; otherwise it would be perfect for that.

title: Surprised at how flattering it is. Long peasant dress with belt (mumu without)
text:
I didn't expect too much from this dress, but I liked the neckline, so I gave it a shot. It was surprisingly flattering and pretty on my pear shape--with the belt. Without the belt, it's basically a mumu. With the belt (which is just a long self belt you wrap around twice and bow), it is surprisingly flattering and pretty--and more surprisingly, it doesn't bunch up an an unappealing frumpy way in front or back, which is my usual experience with self belts. It actually looks better on me than in the picture, as rare as the yeti. Also surprisingly, the belt stays tied until you untie it. The neckline and raglan cut are very feminine and flattering.

I'm 5'3" and 140-145 lbs, 34C, and the medium fits me perfectly--but it should also fit someone much larger as well. It would make a great transitional maternity dress, belted above your belly, empire style. At my height, it is much longer than pictured, which is a good thing. It falls close to my ankle.

It looks great plain or with a cardigan. I like that the neck is woven and fixed, but the sleeve cuffs are elastic, so you can push them up. This is especially handy pushing up cardigan sleeves--both sleeves go up and down together. The sleeves stay pushed up well but don't bind.

It's a wrinkle-resistant fabric that would be good for travel. The floral print is casual, interesting but not gaudy. I tend to favor relatively plain clothes and this isn't too much for me.

If it had pockets, it would be perfect. As it is, I'm still very happy.

title: Love the prints & subdued colors. Fit great, feel good. Wool content seems iffy. One had a hole.
text:
Update: While I still think these socks are cute, the longer I have them, the more iffy the wool content seems to me. If you're mainly buying these with the wool in mind, maybe look elsewhere. If you're buying for the looks, they're super cute.

With the caveat that you should check all the socks when they arrive (one of mine had a hole in it), I love these socks. I wear wool socks pretty much exclusively 3 seasons a year, so, although I'm a knitter, I can't make enough socks and usually buy lots of storebought ones to keep my sock drawer full all winter. Typically, I buy the warehouse store wool multipacks, but I'm never thrilled with the pattern/color selection (but the price is right--about the same as these per pair, but perhaps a little better value because they have a higher wool content than these).

As a knitter, I'm always underwhelmed but the selection of storebought sock patterns and colors, and I really love these. They're slightly unconventional, murkier than the colors you typical see in socks, but very pleasing to me. They're colorful without being loud or jarring. The patterns are similar across the socks (just different color orders, similar patterns), but the heels, toes, and cuffs are different solid colors, so they're super easy to pair up in the laundry.

The fit was perfect on my women's US size 8-8.5 foot. You could probably go up to a 9, but not bigger, and they would still fit well on a 6 or 7. They're soft and warm. The patterning means they're thick and cushy over most of the sock, but that the heels and toes, which tend to wear the most, are actually thinner because there are no extra threads being carried behind the pattern. I hope this doesn't negatively influence wear. I'll report back if they wear poorly, but they're great starting out.

title: Good economy masks for the price. Good fit for smaller adult faces and kids. Soft elastic
text:
I sew, so while I prefer the fit and materials of my own masks, it's good to have cheapie masks on hand for emergency use, shop customers, or family members who constantly lose their masks. These are a very good value, especially with the coupon, and they have soft earloop elastic and the little silicon adjusters, a nice touch. A couple lanyards are included as well.

The fit is good on a small adult or kid's head. It doesn't sag and gape like disposable masks, and should give a better fit than those. The nose wire works pretty well and the ear loop elastic is softer than most cheapie masks. They're comfortable to wear for extended periods with the cotton side (plain black) on the inside. The problem, of course, is that the holiday print side, which you probably won't want to wear for the rest of the year, is polyester, and doesn't feel good against the skin, and might be bad if you're prone to breakouts. And of course a knit fabric is less effective at restricting germs than woven cotton, the CDC's recommended fabric.

But if you're using these in an environment with good ventilation and room to social distance, they're a good, economical choice for short-term wear. I personally couldn't wear the poly side against my skin all day, and I wouldn't feel confident in a knit mask with close contact. But they're certainly better than the single-layer knit masks you see and ill-fitting disposables.

The Christmas dog one is super cute.

title: Not so serious looking, but solid mask and good fit. My daughter's favorite.
text:
KN95 Face Masks for Women Men, 30 Packs Individually Wrapped Tie Dye Design Mask, Adult Sized Colored Mask, 5 Ply Breathable Comfortable Protective Mask

We're starting to feel like the last family still masking indoors, but at least with these masks, it's more comfortable. These masks are nice and thick and solid feeling, but still breathable. The ear loops are soft and comfortable, and the nose wire is handy and minimizes glasses fogging. I like the prints, which make me feel less like I'm in a decontamination unit than the all-business medical masks. But they still have a good seal and good filtration. I like that they're individually wrapped so I can keep a few clean in my purse or glove box.

My only complaint is that the joints for the ear loops occasionally break when my daughter wears them at school. She does knot the loops for a better fit, but I think that makes the little heat-welded "seam" more vulnerable.

For extra close wear like air travel, I still prefer the clunky old N-95s for the superior seal, but for everyday wear, these area great compromise of security, comfort & appearance.

title: they come with a nice carrying bag
text:
I ordered the black and red ones for my three year old son.

They fit perfectly, they come with a nice carrying bag, which made my son THRILLED because daddy has a carrying bag for his glasses. The pouch also makes them easy to store when he does not want to wear them.

The lenses can pop in and out, you should be able to just pop them back in if your child does manage to get them popped out. I would not suggest trying to replace the lenses with another brand since although the frames are flexible they are not super stretchy, therefore only their brand of lenses will fit the way they should.

They fit my sons head perfectly, however the size and fitting really depends on your child's head. Each child's head is different in size, therefor like adult sunglasses you are buying these hoping they fit.

The great thing about these is that they are flexible and will stand up against a toddler or younger child playing and using them without them falling apart.

title: Better than I expected, but...
text:
When I received the package (which arrived in around 10 days, coming from China) I was super worried. It was just a thin plastic envelope with a tiny sheet of bubble wrap in it. The ear cuffs were loose in the packaging, not inside of the bubble wrap at all. I expected them to be crushed beyond salvage. GOOD NEWS, they were not crushed at all.

Upon unpackaging and inspecting them I was really excited. They're way better than I expected them to be! They're bigger than I expected (over 1/2" at the tallest point) and are actually very nicely finished and polished all the way around. Unfortunately the antiquing is very obviously just black paint, and isn't done very well. I think this product would look better without it, as it cheapens the look a bit. Over time silver tarnishes and would develop this patina naturally anyways. However, it's unlikely that anybody will be looking at your ears closely enough to identify it as paint, so I guess it's fine.

I had to adjust them a bit to get a comfortable fit, but this was easy to do with my bare hands, no tools required. However, after wearing them for a little while I still found them uncomfortable. It turns out that the part that wraps inside of your ear is actually too tall to fit comfortably inside my very petite ears, and presses painfully against my cartilage. The very thing that I was so pleased with upon unpackaging them (their substantial size) was what ended up being their undoing!

I will continue to fidget with them and hopefully coax a more comfortable fit out of them somehow. Somebody with a less petite ear would not have this issue, so this isn't a universal problem.

Fyi, it seems like some people don't understand where ear cuffs are meant to be worn..? Ear cuffs like this aren't meant to be pinched onto the cartilage on the topmost part of your ear. They are worn around the middle of your ear, roughly halfway between your lobe and the uppermost arch of your ear. Put your index finger inside your ear and your thumb behind it and feel around. The narrowest part between the inner loop of your ear and the outside of your ear is where an ear cuff is worn. If you have to be prying open and pinching your ear cuffs closed onto your ear then you're doing it wrong. If you want something for the cartilage on the uppermost part of your ear then look into magnetic earrings.

title: Great quality and lasts years
text:
I've been using this brand for years, and I always get compliments on how real they look. The first time forming the thermoplastic is tricky but after you get the hang of it, fitting the fangs is easy. Here are some tips for first-time users:
1. You only need a small amount of the plastic, just enough to fill the fang and cover two adjoining teeth. The first time I used too much and had to cut away a lot of excess. I had a lot of leftover plastic pellets from what was sent with the fangs.
2. Smooth the plastic out as thin as possible: this serves to look better on your real teeth and also results in less bulk in your mouth, making it easier to talk and drink.
3. Don't leave the plastic in for too long. If you let it set while still in your mouth, the mold will be very hard to remove. While firm but still malleable, remove the mold and let it fully harden. You want the ultimate fit to be snug but not uncomfortable.
4. Don't panic if you mess up the first time. The great thing about this plastic is that it can be re-melted and reformed.

Have fun!

title: Well Made and Pretty, But Cut Waaaay Small-Not One-Size Fits All-Only Fits Small to Medium if Even That.
text:
I like the construction of this towel wrap. It’s very well sewn with snaps down the front. Usually the wrap towels just have Velcro or one button at the top, but this one has snaps all the way down with nice soft lace edging on the top and sides. The color is a very pretty apricot/peach and the material an absorbent microfiber. The problem is it is cut small and I mean very small. It is suppose to be a one size fits all and I got this for my disabled mom for after her bath. She usually wears a large and this just is too tight. The elastic around the top is very substantial but it can’t accommodate more than a small/medium person if that. Since she couldn't wear it, I adopted it and I’m med/large and it is really tight on me. The double snaps that are very sturdy hold when I’m standing but if I bend or reach, POP! I’m bustin’ loose. And the elastic pulls so tight it leaves, marks. It’s a shame because this is one of the best sewn towel wraps I’ve ever seen. But unless you are petite to a small medium it is not going to fit comfortably or stay snapped. I wish it came in Med/Large cut as like I said it is very well sewn. But alas the one size fit is not true. I use it as a hair wrap so at least it didn’t go to waste.
I’m giving it three stars because it is so well made. I want to give it more but since it isn’t a one size fits all and is cut so small I have to go with three. I mean it’s not a bad wrap just not represented correctly with the sizing. I like the construction but it’s not one size fits all. I'd give it two stars because it's veeery small cut but it is well made as I've said with the snaps all the way down so I'm giving it three stars for that.

title: Super hardcore boots - these are the real deal (and look awesome)
text:
These work boots are no joke - they’re serious and hardcore. Obviously heave got steel toes - and this toe is solid and harder than anything I’ve found or worn. (I got these for my nephew and he informed me that he ‘tested them’ by having his friend jump on the toe... not how I would have done it, but they look the same, so I’m impressed.) They’re also slip resistant for EVERYTHING! Heave got crazy high slip ratings for things I don’t fully understand, but how that translates - for me - is I don’t have to worry about my nephew slipping when he’s working on his car in the garage - with water or oil - and even working on stainless steel.

Other impressive features on the outside include CRAZY durable soles that extend up the side, big tread for dirt, mud, slush, and snow, and a crazy-cool leather-plus-manmade-membrane that’s not only waterproof, it actually pushes rain back out the surface leather AND allows evaporation of sweat from inside. Combine that with anti-bacterial properties inside and your feet stay dry - and don’t smell like death.

Insode, aside from anti-bacterial properties, they’ve got a mega reinforced heal, warm, comfy, and TOUGH lining, and a flexible tong that makes these boots way easier to put on than other work boots. I wore them around the house to get a feel before giving them to my nephew and they’re much lighter than I expected, and as comfortable as my old Doc Martins. Overall these are some serious, solid, and stylish work boots. (Look at them - they’re bad-a**!) Highly recommend.

title: Broke the first time I put them on
text:
I put them on and one of them snapped in half while on my ear and fell off - less than five minutes. The other seemed fine but one of them was obviously so weak it couldn't handle the pressure of just being on my ear so I took the other one off carefully and fought back tears.

I've been looking at these for a long time but could not splurge on myself. I finally saved up, gave in and bought them and they looked so pretty. I was dreadfully sick when they arrived so I didn't put them on. I finally got better and took them out of my jewelry box the other day and put them on - was impressed for a few minutes and that was it.

Considering all my health problems, it's nothing to cry about a broken earring but at the moment it was a total bummer. Apparently I should have put them on sooner because putting them on this weekend was a couple days past the return date. Not only did I finally splurge for myself, I assumed they were quality because they looked so pretty - bad idea. Now I wasted my only luxury money and got nothing for it. DO NOT BUY THESE, they are not sturdy enough to sit on your earlobe - I can't imagine they would last a night out or wearing them to work on a regular basis. I thought I would get a pair and if they were really great I could get them for my niece at Christmas, thank goodness I didn't get 2 pairs right away or I would be even more upset, a 14 yr old could never make these last if I can't wear them for 5 minutes.

text:

title: Skip these; they have a bad case of See-Through Butt.
text:
You definitely get what you pay for with these; they cost less than $15, and the quality reflects that.

The waist band is a 1" wide elastic band, it isn't even sewn into the pants. Instead, its just a loop that slides around inside the waist part of the pants, free to twist and move as it wants. The fabric is coarse, and doesn't have that normal soft stretch that a pair of yoga pants would normally have. I ended up purchasing a Medium and a Large, just to make sure that the butt part wasn't see-through in an appropriately-sized pair (which maybe a sizing up would solve). No matter the size, these leggings had a bad case of see-through butt.. and that's not really my thing.

If you're thinking about purchasing these, just...don't.

title: As expected
text:
I am super particular about fishing shirts because in the Southwest (Gulf of Mex) and in Sea of Cortez it can get brutally hot - way too many fishing shirts opt for a slim fit when way so many fishermen have a bit of girth on them from swilling drinks after a hard day fishing. I am 5'8" 195# and the XL fit comfortably without being too snug.

ALL of these polyester blend shirts they are coming out with nowadays lack ventilation, pockets, or an open V neck of half zipper to reduce heat. If they don't start adding these features I'm going to start my own brand and take their business from them. Nothing sucks more than wearing a snug long sleeve high neck shirt in 95 degree heat with 75% humidity. The only way to cool off with these is to CUT THE SLEEVES OFF AND CUT THE NECK OPEN WITH SCISSORS...it's a fishing shirt not a fashion piece. Rip it open and you will enjoy it much more in the summer seasons....

title: Nice product, good construction and details.  Sturdy and stable.
text:
I'm not an expert on trekking poles-- these are the first I've purchased. My motivation is improved stability when hiking on my beat-up knees. These fill the bill. They assemble quickly, are very lightweight, and they seem sturdy. The tungsten-carbide tips are great for dirt trails, and they come with screw-on plastic mud/snow baskets and rubber tips for hard surfaces. Everything fits into an included carrying bag.

The carbon fiber construction seems authentic and not some sort of veneer over a lesser material. The poles come out of their bag folded in thirds like a magician's trick wand. There's a spring cord inside that holds everything together, and when you extend the upper shaft it pulls everything taut. A little button on the upper shaft pops out to keep everything firmly extended. It's easy to press when you want to fold everything up again, and there's no way that will happen accidentally.

The fitments are machined aluminum and slide together nicely, with no slop. The cork grip deserves special mention: It's firm but absorbent of sweat, so it never gets slippery. The top tube has a graduated scale so you can reproduce a desired length each time. One of my poles' handpieces is maybe 0.5-0.7cm longer than the other, so the numbers differ by that much. But, your arms probably differ by as much too... bottom line, they are easily and quickly adjusted for comfort and stability for both arms.

So far I'm quite satisfied with my purchase. I'm sure that by spending twice as much for a set of Lekis you might get something even nicer, but these are great.

title: My doctor recommend I go to a shoe store and they fit ...
text: I recently was having foot pain and couldn't stand without pain shooting through it, so I went to a podiatrist and found out it was plantar fasciitis.  My doctor recommend I go to a shoe store and they fit me with an orthotic that is slowly helping me every day.  The pair looks like a cute pair of mary janes , but I can't wear them without socks or they'll start to smell.  But wearing them with socks helps out so much more, so when I saw these black socks were available at a discount for my review, I decided to try them out. I ordered the 5 pack in black and wore them with my new shoes and I've got to say, they are a life saver.  The package came pretty quickly, these were wrapped up in a plastic packaging; easy to open.  The socks are made of a good quality thread and they look and feel like they will last a long time.  They felt comfortable on and stayed on my feet most of the day, there was just one instance when my toe came out of the sock, but after I fixed that up, I didn't have that problem again.  I would definitely recommend these to anyone looking for good no show socks that will last them a while.

title: I ordered this in a L and it fits great, very comfortable
text: I'm 5'4 and 150 lbs.  I ordered this in a L and it fits great, very comfortable. I have a belly so the midsection part of this dress is really somewhat forgiving in slimming your shape if you buy the right size.  It can easily be too tight.  I could probably have ordered medium but I went with a L because I read people were saying it was short and I didn't want it stopping short of my feet so I got it by the longest length.  It was the perfect length.  I like dresses to fall a little below my knee because I expect some length as I'll be wearing heels or even flats that are slightly raised.  This was the perfect length, I normally wear a size 6 or 8 and normally an L would be too large in US dress sizes but this is more like a medium than large by our standard sizes.  The dress I bought was gray but it's more of a muted purple which is even prettier than gray.  Its so beautiful, sexy but classy.  The material is great, it's not cotton, but more of that synthetic jersey kind of dress that makes your butt look great.  I received this at a discount to test and review, but I'm glad I did because I order a lot of dresses on Amazon and it's hard to find a good seller with good quality dresses for cheap and this is a good one so I know who I can order more from.

title: Impressive running socks
text:
These are impressive socks. They are soft, but quite thick, with padded toes and heels which make them incredibly comfortable. The over-the-calf design provides “graduated compression” in the leg, which improves circulation during running. That means the socks are quite tight on the leg (the product description uses the word “snug;” I think “tight” is more accurate) – these are not the easiest socks to put on! But once in place, they are comfortable and supportive.

The L/XL size fits those wearing men’s shoe sizes 10 ½-12. My husband wears a size 12, so he’s at the top end of the range. While they did fit him (the foot, at least, fit him well), he struggled to get them on over his thick calves. He did like the way they felt once they were on, but he doubted he’d wear them on a regular basis. I tried them on myself (I wear a women’s 8 ½, so the foot was a bit big on me), and I liked the way the leg felt, but even I had a bit of trouble pulling them up over my calves.

Overall, these socks look good and feel good. If you’re looking for a classy running sock that will provide superior leg compression, these are perfect. Just be aware that they are very long, very thick, and not easy to put on.

title: Runs very small
text:
I usually wear a size large (including sports bras). This Truity sports bra runs very small. There are no hooks, which means you have to pull this over your head to put it on. And the fabric, while silky and nice-feeling, isn't very stretchy at all. This makes putting the bra on a real ordeal. Additionally, there is little to no room in the cups -- the front of this bra is almost flat.

There is a size chart listed with the product which provides measurements in choosing your size (it doesn't, however, include cup size). If you're anything larger than a B cup (and that would be pushing the limits of this bra), this won't work for you.

Bottom line, if you're very slim and curve-free, you might like this. It didn't work for me.

title: Love the bag; not crazy about the strap
text:
This is definitely a very attractive and well-designed bag. It's not real leather, though -- it's PU leather (meaning there's a bit of leather coated with polyurethane). It definitely looks and feels like vinyl. Still, the color is rich and beautiful, and I love all the zippered pockets and compartments. There's a sueded outside pocket with two zippered compartments -- a small one (perfect for keys) and a larger one (perfect for my phone). The bag itself closes at the top with two magnetic buttons, but there's also a zipper (making sure nothing you put in the bag will fall out). There are additional deep zippered compartments on each side of the bag -- this bag holds a lot!

I'm not crazy about the cross-body strap, mainly because it's too long to wear as a regular shoulder bag. I do own a few cross-body bags, but they are much smaller than this. I would love to wear this as a regular purse, but the strap (which is adjustable) is too long. The measurements of the bag differ from the product description -- it is 9 inches high, 11 inches long, and 4.5 inches wide (at the footed bottom). This is considerably bigger than the measurements provided in the description. Because of this, it would work much better as a shoulder bag, rather than a cross-body bag.

All that said, I do really like this bag. I will try to use it as a shoulder bag -- I just need to get used to the long strap.

title: Very small packing cubes
text:
I've been using packing cubes for a long time -- it's a great way to organize your luggage. The problem with this set is how TINY the cubes are. The larger one is so small that I was only able to get a few t-shirts in it. The smaller one is best used for toiletries, although I have other toiletry bags that are much better designed.

Additionally, these bags are not designed to compress clothing, which is one of the advantages of packing cubes. They are so formless and flexible that anything you place inside just bulges out (so that the cube ends up looking rounded and "stuffed"). This isn't the idea behind compression packing!

Overall, I can't see using these tiny bags (they definitely seem more like "bags" than "cubes"). There are much better options out there.

title: A bit small, and the strap is a problem
text:

Still, I like the number of outside pockets, and I love the little stars attached to the zipper pulls. The only real problem is the strap. There is a silver clasp on the strap that is supposed to help you adjust the length, but the slickness of the strap makes adjustment impossible. title: Attractive, small wallet -- but it doesn't hold much
text:
I do like the look and feel of this wallet. It has a snap-front tab that holds it shut, plus two small pockets in the front (great for a key or a small ticket). Inside, there are slots for cards (credit cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, etc.) plus a plastic-front pocket for your driver's license. There's room for cash, plus a zippered pocket for coins (it's a little difficult to get to this pocket, and it's hard to find the coins you want without dumping them all out).

The big negative for me is how little this wallet holds. I usually carry two credit cards, plus a number of other cards I might need. I filled four of the slots in the wallet, inserted my driver's license, and placed the other cards in the pockets behind the slots. Then I put in my cash and coins, folded up the wallet, and snapped it shut. Unfortunately, it was hard to snap it shut and the wallet felt too thick and bulky.

If you want something to hold just a few cards and little else, this might work. But the feel of the wallet changes greatly once you fill it up. I was hoping to like this, but I think I'll stick with my larger, easier-to-use wallet.

title: The perfect day trip bag!
text: This bag may be small but holds a lot of essentials needed for a quick hike or day trips while on vacation. It is made out of 100% high quality recycled polyester and nylon fabrics. Something I try and look for in things I buy. It has a long zippered pouch on the outside for items that you might need quick. Then another long zipper on top that opens to the interior. There is a long mesh divider that forms two halves of the interior. There are also 2 mesh pockets on one side. The interior was big enough to hold my phone, a small wallet, my earbud case, hand sanitizer, tissues and a regular bottle of water. The exterior pocket held my keys and lip balm. The stitching is well done and looks durable. I really love the ability to lengthen the strap to make it a long cross body carry or shorten it to make it more of a fanny pack or under the arm over the back kind of carry. Either way it works. This is a great bag at a good price. Highly recommend.

He gave me his thoughts..."they are very comfortable especially between my big toe and second toe. They have a good deep heel and I don't have to work that hard to keep them on. They fit good across my foot and are very cushiony. I have long toes so it is great that the front of the sandal is a bit long. The back however is long as well but not so much that I can't wear them. Be aware tho that they do run long. The leather is good but it does look a bit on the inexpensive side up close however the sandal fits and wears well. I like them with jeans and shorts. I am very happy with them."
The price on them is not cheap coming in at just under $50 at the time of this review and I do highly recommend just know they run a bit long.

title: The last hope for a desparate fit owner; it works but will give you eczema
text:
I, like you, have clawed through hundreds of pages of poorly rated replacement bands for the Gear Fit 2. I, too, have screamed and sworn at Samsung for not selling any god damn OEM replacement bands that will actually fit onto their otherwise amazing smartwatch.

This band, which wraps around the Gear Fit rather than attaching in the normal fashion, is guaranteed to fit your Gear Fit 2. There is no concern that it won't snap on or that the snaps will break, since it's just stretchy rubber that wraps around your Gear Fit 2.

However, this band is not without its flaws:

1. You cannot charge the watch while this band is around it
2. The way that the band buckles is inverted compared to normal watches. I don't know how else to explain it. This makes it significantly more difficult to attach the band to your wrist, although once you have it secure, there is no little tail sticking out that could catch on things and cause the band to detach
3. This band has a large metal snap which will be in direct contact with your skin. This gives me a severe eczema reaction after wearing the band for about 24 hours. As such, I cannot recommend this to anyone who has allergic or eczema reactions to metals.

title: Good watch with a good fashion style
text:
I purchased this watch as a gift for my wife. From the photo, I could tell that the billion was a good fit for her sportswear and I like the fact that the dial would be easy to read. When the watch arrived it was well packaged and protected. The vendor had it shipped within 24 hours and I had the watch within two days. Taking the watch from the packaging revealed a product with a good overall design as well as a fashionable look. The instructions are fairly simple, and operation can be done with the stem.

The watch shows hours, minutes and seconds on a nice white background with gold accents on the hands and number positions. Having the white background makes it easy for someone over 50 to see the hands. The size of the dial is also large enough that it makes a quick peek at the time easily. The date display is a bit small, though. If you are like my wife, then you probably wear bifocals for reading glasses to see something up close. With the glasses, you can see the date easily but if you don't have your glasses on, or you have not yet experienced decreasing vision, then the date will be a little bit small. That's not necessarily enough to give the watch a poor score.

The band on the watch seems to be well made and works pretty well. There was no problem getting it fit though someone with large wrist may have a little problem. But I would say this should easily fit 90% of women. The color combination of the band is a good choice I think it adds a nice fashion side to the watch. I have to admit, though, that I'm not a big fashion person, so I'll actually leave that choice up to the buyer. I simply like the way the watch works and looks.

I've only had two contacts with the vendor in both were very positive. The original contact was when the vendor offered the watch at a reduced rate if I would agree to provide an honest and unbiased opinion. This statement is intended to meet Amazons policy on such reviews.

My second contact with the vendor was after I received the watch when I had a question about the type of glass. I had missed the statement in the product listing but found the customer service from the vendor to be very good. They answered my question within 24 hours and provided clear information.

Let me close by saying that even though I received this watch at a reduced rate I am strongly considering buying a second watch is a gift for another family member. I would recommend the watch to both family and friends. Though there is a small problem with the calendar, its size only, I still rated the watch is five simply because I could not rate​ a 4 1/2 stars. This single issue is not enough for me to drop it a whole star, so please understand that on my own scale I would say I have 95% satisfaction.

title: Comfortable & holds up to a long day
text:
I opted to wear this to an upscale wedding and received lots of compliments.

However, the material can sure hold onto a wrinkle, although to be fair, besides the committed packaging folds my dress had a fair amount of extra wrinkles as it must have been a return & you need to be an origami master to get them back into the package!

I opted to dry clean and when I picked it up he told me "I ironed and ironed and ironed!" Poor guy, but better him than me! It did iron out well, and at the end of the day I did wind up with a few "committed" wrinkles in the dress from how we were sitting, etc. However, once it is ironed out, I think you're pretty good to go.

The material is a nice cotton blend, and even with a petticoat added to give the skirt some extra flare I didn't feel like I was suffocating despite a very long, very hot, humid Chicago day and evening. It still looked great at the end of the day! During the (outdoor) cocktail hour a waiter dripped water from his serving tray across the whole front of my skirt because all of the drink glasses were sweating so much and I had momentary panic that I was going to look like a huge slob for the rest of the day... Some material just doesn't do well with water spots. Thankfully, while it took a little while to dry out because of the extreme humidity, once dry there was not a single mark on the dress. So I'd give it 5 stars just for holding up to the environment.

The color was a bit darker shade of purple than I expected, however, it was extremely complimentary to my skin tone & hair and I think it would look great on a variety of people. I also ordered and returned the royal blue in a different size - the color seemed "flat" compared to the picture, and somehow that made if feel less dressy... (Blue is my go-to color, but I personally think that the purple is a knock-out in comparison.)

Depending on how busty you are (or if you're on the edge of one size to the next), you may need to secure the cross-over to make certain you're not "showing off".

Overall this is a really fun and comfortable dress that you could dress up or down. The belt is not attached, so you could also swap that out for yet another look. I think it is also a style that looks good on different body shapes and the high waist is definitely forgiving. As far as petticoats, it really looks nice either way. The dress has a nice drape without a petticoat, but if you want to complete "the look" it will kick it up a bit.

title: Nice dress, better quality than the cheap versions
text:
Beautiful dress. The fabric is a nice weight and sheen. The lace is very soft & comfortable.

[NOTE: If you're considering the $20 version, don't go there if you're looking for something dressy versus building a vintage collection. It's not the same dress, even though it looks close. The Missmay fabric is MUCH nicer and lays better, it's worth spending more. On the cheaper one the cami is stretchy fabric, separate from and slightly off-color from the dress and the skirt is more cotton-like/wrinkle-prone; the back pleats didn't seem to lay right. Missmay you could wear to a formal wedding, cocktail party, etc. The cheaper one really doesn't seem right if you need clothing for an event.]

Back to Missmay... Unfortunately for my size I found that the shoulders were a bit large (unusual as my shoulders are fairly broad), but it gaped at the bust. The cami is sewn into the top of the dress (no worry about straps falling down), but be aware that it is sewn into the button placket so it is actually split with the buttons, so I couldn't just let the cami show and open an extra button without putting on a big show! [38D trying the XXL.] However, it does look nicer than the cheap version because it lays well (and no worries about it shifting around). I adore this dress in the pics, but unfortunately it just didn't work for me. (They accidentally sent me the black, so I can't comment on the blue or compare the fabric matching throughout the dress.) It looks good with or without a petticoat, but the petticoat did jazz it up and give it a more classic feel.

If I had received the blue I might have been tempted to keep it & add a snap or hook into the button placket, but since I have to return it anyhow I'm looking at other options.

title: Pros & Cons
text:
This is a nice coat with interesting styling.

So far in crazy Chicago weather it has done fine keeping me warm, without overheating. The only challenge is being on a crowded train without room to remove it or being indoors with it on for too long - it gets a bit roasty, but obviously that's not the intended use for a coat...

The styling is super-cute, however I probably could have used an inch or so extra width for bulky clothes. (I tried ordering one size up in a different color & it was HUGE, so I just decided to keep this one. Why a different color? Because this one is over $30 more in the next size up, which IMO is ridiculous.) Nice size zip pockets on the sides & a breast pocket inside. The inside zip comes to the waist, but the outside shell snaps lower, so you can unsnap for getting into a higher vehicle without fear of wrecking the zipper. The hood is very fuzzy and warm. There is a cinch on each side of the waist with two options.

A few issues... #1 the zipper is cheap. I noticed this first on the larger coat I sent back. However, it is also an issue on the one I kept. If the zipper is not PERFECTLY aligned at the bottom, the zipper gets a few inches up, separates & then jams up so you can't move it in either direction, then have to pull one side through. Not at all happy with that, and I am being extremely cautious in making sure it is aligned to try to get more than one season out of it. The hood is very open, so in a Chicago wind it is a losing battle to keep it up if you haven't snapped the neck all the way to the top. You might be able to change that with a scarf on the outside of the hood to snug it up. Otherwise you had better be comfortable with one arm up to hold it.

Toss up - I am on the short side and the neck of the coat comes up to my nose if I don't shrug it down. I think I would prefer to have about an inch less on it, because it cannot be easily folded down. However, for the nasty blowy days if the hood isn't cooperating in the gusts and I don't have hands free, my neck & lower part of my head are covered, which is nice. I think I'd still prefer the neck a touch shorter (or perhaps softer material) & a way to snug the hood slightly. The arms are the perfect length for me and I'm happy there, but if you are tall or have long arms, you may have the opposite issue (maybe the neck would be fine, but the arms would be too short).

Anyhow, it is a cute coat & I have received compliments on it, but I feel like they have a few kinks to work out in terms of quality & fit.

This is awesome! I travel a great deal and for my carry on I bring along the essentials. This keeps them stored away properly and the small compartment of my camera bookbag organized.

In the past, I just stuck my hand in the compartment and felt around for a few minutes until i tacitly felt what I was looking for... only to discover it was an old piece of gum. This keeps everything tidy and easy to find. Even if things are organized on the bottom of the Grid-it, you can just pull out the entire grid-it and it has everything held securely, so nothing tumbles out when you do.

For such a great price, I recommend it to all my travel buddies that are tied to their electronics.

title: Great set, with everything you need to get started
text: I appreciate the listing for this set, as it is very upfront that it might not have everything you need for your watch repair needs, depending on what you are looking to do, but it is a great starter set, with more than many other starter kits. If you want to adjust your own watch bands, pretty much every set will give you what you need to adjust spring bars, which are very common. Where this kit steps it up, is the punch bars, and small mallet, for solid pins. Removal and replacement of solid pins is something that you want to practice, before trying it on your own watch collection, but it is easy to find a set of broken watches, for a very inexpensive price, to get some practice. Watch repair is a great hobby, but you better practice before you start playing with your Swiss watch collection! Good luck!

title: Great Slimming Garment!
text:
This seems to be a well built waist cincher. The material is thick and it doesn't roll down around the edges like other slimming garments I've tried. My waist is 31 inches (size 6 jeans) and the medium fit me well. There are three rows of closures and the middle row fit me, so I can (hopefully) still go one row smaller soon. It really flattens my tummy nicely when worn under a dress.

This took less than five minutes to put on and it seems durable, it definitely didn't feel flimsy and the clasps feels strong. I was able to wear it for a full work day (8 hours) and it didn't start to bother me around the top edge until towards the end of the day.

One added benefit is it improves my posture since it is uncomfortable to slouch in this. Also, the tightness of it makes me more aware of what I'm eating which is always a good thing. Not to mention, I didn't have much of an appetite after sqeezing my stomach flab into it :/

I've been wanting to try a cincher and this is a great choice. Thanks to the seller for providing this at a discounted rate for my honest review. I can't wait until my waist is small enough to order the small!

title: Shrink in wash -- A good thing for me!
text:
Update: After sending them through a hot wash and dry cycle with the towels, these fit perfectly. So if they're too big, go with heat. But if they come to you and fit to begin with, send them through the wash with cool water and hang to dry. I was surprised by how much the socks shrunk, although I had shrunk them on purpose, because I know they're only about one third wool.

Since size was the only problem I had with the socks, I'm very happy with them now. The colors and design are good, and they're the thickness and warmth I was hoping for.

Original review, cut down for relevance: The socks I received do not fit US Women's shoe size 6-10. In fact, they wouldn't fit the whole range of US Men's size 6-10: I wear men's shoe size 6.5, (a women's 8, solidly in the middle of the size range,) and they're about two inches too large.

title: very soft, nice thickness to it
text:
This 'pashima' scarf is what I tend to notice anymore a generic label for a very soft scarf/shawl - yes, it has some wool (25%) and cashmere (25%) in it, with the rest being polyester, but I wouldn't consider it to be a true 'pashmina' scarf. That said, it is very soft and is thick enough that you don't see through it at all, unlike with most cashmere scarves (unless they are VERY expensive). It's almost 80" long without the fringe, and almost 30" wide, so it covers the shoulders and hangs down one's back, and can be wrapped around to provide warmth as a shawl or knotted in cute ways for a scarf.
It's very soft, definitely a nice touch around one's neck or against the face, and with the polyester in this I'm fine with washing it (delicate cycle, in a bag for protection, cold wash, hang to dry. The non-fringe ends look as if they were just cut, no stitched seems, but the material is such that as its worn, it should 'mat' together. All and all, this is a lovely, large wrap that's so soft and will provide some warmth during the cooler months at a great price point (especially considering the fact that I've lost a couple over time - I'll be sad but not as sad as if this was the real thing). Also, lots of color options.
