title: Abundant compartments, protection and configuration options...
text:
First:
There's no doubt this is a bag carrying a premium price. Anybody considering purchasing (or not) this product based on the price alone should pause and ask about the relative worth of the items it will store. Water bottles, pens and portable computing periphals? Not a big deal. But the laptop, tablet, smart phone (and their digital contents) ? These may not be as expendable, and users in search of a "full function" bag that combines flexibility and durability may find that this bag offer value in excess of its cost.

Generally, messenger-style bags aren't my first choice; I don't care for how they interact with business attire in routine donning/doffing. Because most of my computer schlepping is in suburban car-to-office type situations, I normally prefer briefcase style. But for urban commuters, frequent flyers, bicycle, train or pedestrian commuters, the messenger style offers a great alternative for keeping your hands free and ready for other matters.

The features of this bag begin on its exterior. Each side has a pocket that can accommodate a water bottle or other items you might need quick access too. The front of the main bag has a zipper pocket with an organizer for pens, a key fob and two more slip pockets and another zip pocket.

The interior has three velcro-secured pockets and a large zipper pocket and a padded pocket for laptop storage.
If you want to get this bag off your shoulder and carry it, there is also a carry handle.

For transport, the exterior flap secures with dual wide velcro strips and squeezable plastic clasps. The bag secures over your shoulder and chest with a substantial metal/magnetic buckle mechanism. This is further secured with a secondary stabilizing strap that can attached to either side of the bag.

This bag is roomy and flexible, the construction quality yields confidence that it will shield your stuff from the elements and your fellow humans. I've loaded it with stuff that easily expanded it front to back to more than 6" of bulk.

Do yourself a favor: take a look online for videos describing "operation" of the shoulder/chest strap. While it's not complicated, it's not necessarily intuitive, and others (both Booq itself and other users) have already done an excellent job of illustrating this.

The bag has an included "terralinq.com" id tag with a unique barcode and an "if found please visit terralinq.com" label. This obviously requires you to register in advance to be effective (assuming the finder is honest!). I've had printed labels in my travel bag for years with my contact information and a reward offer. I'm not sure that either method is effective in the hands of a dishonest finder.

Overall, this is a bag that shows lots of thought for the real-world uses it might find itself in.

Note: this item provided for review purposes.

These socks are as comfortable as they are cute. They're supposed to be men's socks, but I'm the wearer of the fun socks around these parts. I don't feel he could properly appreciate them. They're soft and warm without making my feet sweaty.

The fit is very good; I usually have issues with socks not fitting properly, because of my larger feet. I wear a women's size 11, with a narrow foot, and I usually wear men's socks to accommodate the length of my foot. This means I often have to deal with the heels being too deep, or a too-thick seam rubbing my baby toe. Not these. They're comfortable both in and out of my shoes. I love the thin, tight weave of these socks. I have them on now, and wiggling my toes around in my shoes, it feels like I don't have on any socks. I don't feel the seam at all, and there is nothing tight or rubbing against my foot.

The patterns are adorable and very unique. Naturally, the first pair I grabbed was the brightest and most colorful. My only complaint is that the elastic is a little binding. It's not uncomfortable while wearing the socks, but when you take them off, you can see the imprint. It isn't a concern for those with small calves, but I thought it worth mentioning for those, like myself, with larger calves.

title: A Better Choice
text: Although every thing that the other reviewers have said about this necklace is quite true, to me these facts do not add up to a negative.  I really like this necklace.  The chunkiness goes well with chunky Carolyn Pollack enhancers, and it does not droop around your neck, but it lays in a circle.  After a day of supporting an enhancer, it does bend down a little bit.  Personally, I have no trouble with the lobster claw clasp.  I guess you either do well with them or you don't.  The cord is a nice braided bronze color, but has no silver in it.  The silver is in the fittings.  Why they made a bronze end for the necklace, and didn't just stick to bronze for the chain is beyond me, because it is true that where two metals touch, corrosion occurs.  The fact that the ends of the necklace are chunky doesn't pose a problem for Carolyn Pollack jewelry, because most of the enhancers have a clasp that opens.  Overall, I like this piece, and would recommend it.

title: Very Satisfied.
text:
[[VIDEOID:103fe00e698cb5dc28235d0007f0adee]] No complaints. Right off, there's nothing I'm disappointed by or dislike. I love the watch. Now that my review in broad strokes is out of the way, here are the details:

Setup: Setup does require someone with a basic knowledge of how to download an app on their smart phone. But the instructions are super easy. First, you scan the QR code in the enclosed booklet or, better yet, go straight to your app store and search fivesenses watches. Since the watch gets instructions from the phone, you have to allow the app to access your location and turn on Bluetooth. No need to remember this since you’re prompted to do all of this once you open the app. The tricky part is pairing the watch with the phone but, again, this was straight forward. Note: My phone was a Samsung.

There is an instruction booklet with small type but you don’t need to read it. The only step is to download the app and follow the instructions. It took less than five minutes.

Readability: The large black numbers on the white background are big enough for me (age = 85+ years old) to see. I don’t need my glasses to see what time it is. But the clock face does not glow in the dark.

Volume: The talking voice is semi loud, not overpowering. If you’re hard of hearing or in a somewhat crowded or noisy room, you’ll have to put the watch to your ear to hear the voice. On the positive side, no one will know your checking your watch to see if it’s time to make a dash for the door.

You can visually look at this watch to tell the time if you like, but when you want to hear the time instead, simply press the button (one time) on the top right-hand side of the face. Press a 2nd time and it tells you the day and date, press a 3rd time and it’ll tell you the month and year.

The watch makes no sound, no ticking noise. It won’t disturb your sleep.

Voice: If you don't like the female voice that's built into the Talking Watch you'll have to get used to it since it can't be changed.

Alarms: I wasn’t interested in setting up different alarms so I didn’t fully explore this feature. However, setting up alarms also seemed an extremely easy setup through your phone. Pressing the lower button on the right-hand side of the face will tell you if any alarms are set.

Battery: The watch comes with one battery already installed and a spare.

Band: Because the watch is unisex the band may be too big for smaller wrists (my wrist is 5 ½”) and you’ll have to go to a jeweler to remove a few links for a proper fit. The jeweler removed 3 links which cost $20. He had no problem opening the band and removing the links, but putting it back together was difficult. The whole process took 20 minutes.

Secondly, this type of band with the links has a reputation as a "hair puller" but I haven't had any instances of that so far.

Appearance: The watch is described as for both men and women but, honestly, the wide silver band makes it look like a man’s watch. They should provide a lady's version. Unfortunately for ladies, you can’t switch out the band for one that has a smaller width. The handles on the watch are too wide and don’t accommodate a narrower band.

Final thoughts: As soon as the watch was set up the relief of wearing a watch without struggling to tell the time was sheer happiness. All in all it’s a good little watch that’s light and comfortable to wear.

title: Great for migraine sufferers.
text:
This is my new favorite hat! Because of bad migraines, I have to wear a hat with a good brim that blocks out light whenever I go outside. This isn’t hard with winter hats, but summer hats are often woven and allow some light to penetrate. Not this one! This hat has a solid brim but isn’t super hot because it has mesh sides that allow your head to breathe. This is also a big bonus, because allowing your head to get too hot when you have migraines is also a big no-no.
Another great feature of this hat is the chin strap. It’s adjustable, so you can wear is loose behind your head when it’s not needed, but for windy days you can tighten it up to keep the hat from blowing off.
Not only is this a great functional hat, but it looks great too! It’s stylish and looks good with almost any outfit.

title: Pretty Cool, Funky Little Number!  I love it!
text: I did not think this looked good on the model.  It looked like a green (or red) checked bag. The material appears stiff in the photo. But the reviews were so encouraging.  Since I have already purchased a number of Mordenmiss's garments, and loved the ones that had gotten good reviews, I thought I'd try this one in green.  I wasn't expecting much.  But again, the reviews were excellent.  That's why I gave it a go. Well, the green one arrived!  Surprise! Surprise!  I Mean, I was delightfully surprised!  Ahh...this is just lovely!  I'm so pleased with this light weight, very summery dress/shirt/blouse.  It is ideal for hot weather!  Beads, chunky jewelry, pendants, scarves all dress this up or down, a muscle shirt can allow you to leave it totally unbuttoned and that gives a new look, too!  Throw on a pair of sun glasses and a big broad brimmed hat! Or wear it with tights, jeans, whatever!  Even by itself.  It is like wearing nothing--and still looking  funkily and adorably appealing!  I went ahead and ordered two more.  One in red and one in green.  Why two green?  If this first one gets stained or ragged (eventually) or just gets dirty and in need of a wash,  I will have a spare. The green is a beautiful Irish green.  By the way, I am 130 pounds, 5' 5" tall with a 36C bust 30 inch waist and 38 inch hips.  But it would fit my sister, too, who is a size 18.  It is the way it drapes that makes it lovely for nearly any size woman 6-18.  I roll the sleeves up--but I like that they are long enough to cover my forearms because there are times I don't want that much sun on my arms. Only thing missing:  I would have liked pockets.  This is the first Mordenmiss garment I have purchased that doesn't have pockets.  However, it is a small thing compared to how I feel wearing this cool outfit.  I will simply take a cross-body bag with me when I wear it traveling.

title: It's alright for the Price
text:
So I have been looking for a doctor's satchel for a long time. And was really excited to find this at a great price. I knew for the price there was no way it was going to be real leather, so my review will not be reflecting that.
First, I love the size and the shape of the bag. I also like the hardware that is on the purse. It is sturdy and well made.
The things I don't like about the bag is the color, the inside extra pocket and the outside pocket.
I chose the brown color, but the bag that came was an orange brown. I was hoping for a more true brown. I saw the picture ahead of time, HOWEVER, prior to buying it, I had seen other people's pictures of their bags on a different website and noticed that the color in their pictures were not true to the color posted on Amazon. So that's why I gave it a shot. I was disappointed. I did, however, get a compliment from an employee at Kohls that mentioned that she loved the color of my bag (while I was purchasing a new purse). It just wasn't my color. So the color that is on Amazon is the actual true orange brown that is in the picture.
There is an inside pocket that is strangely placed. I didn't use it for anything. It is placed in the middle of the purse, so when I would try to put my wallet back into my bag it would get caught on it. It was so bad my wallet almost fell out a few times. I would have to stop what I was doing, open the bag, and try to stuff the wallet back in. I didn't think something like that could bug me so much. I have had purses when an extra inside pocket, but my wallet or other items never got stuck on it before. It's just poorly placed.
The outside pocket, I was excited to use. But after awhile I noticed, I didn't like it as much as I thought I would. It sits a bit "off" the bag, so it gives it a weird look.
I was really hoping for a hit out of the ballpark, because like I said I have been searching for a doctor's satchel for so long. But unfortunately this does nothing for me. I thought it looked a bit cheap, and probably why I headed to buy a new one.
I wasn't for, may be for you. Can't beat the price.

title: Feel fat? No? Just buy these...
text:
Ugh, I'm so disappointed in these pants. Initated the return process the same day I opened the package.

Pros: They arrived quickly and in good shape.

I was so excited to have a new, bright outfit to wear at work. In my job, I need ultra professional clothes as I sit with clients daily. I had ordered a mint-colored blazer and bought these pants to go with the blazer.

I'm 5'7", 125 lbs, 34-25.5-34, size 2 dress.

I ordered the medium. I could not: zip them up, button them (not even with the inner button that's there for preventing your pants from falling down), or bend over. My legs looked like they were squished into balloons.

Wow, did these make me feel overweight. Absolutely horrible, considering I know that deep down that I'm not - these pants are ridiculously small, it almost makes me angry - no wonder why so many women have body image issues! What about making clothes that actually fit real women's bodies...

Let's talk about the material. SO thin. You can even see in the model photos of the back view that underwear shows through them. Pair that thin material with the ridiculously "squeeze-yourself-in" fit and you get very obvious and unflattering underwear lines and not a smooth backside. You couldn't even wear a thong because a) you could see it, and b) your bare butt would show through the material. Talk about unprofessional.

While the color is fabulous - bright, cheerful, beautiful, I don't know who these pants would fit - maybe a life-size Barbie, perhaps?

Save yourself some dampened self-esteem and take a hard pass on these pants.

title: Decent quality for the price, some fitment issues
text:
The Amazon Essentials Women's Push-up Bra is a fine brassiere considering the price point. The construction is decent, the materials are comfortable, and the wires are just the right length and do not poke out from the channels.

It fits as one would expect a brassiere at this price level to fit-with a bit of a gap at the top of the cups if you are not what the manufacturer considers a true B cup. I f you are on the smaller end of the 36 range (just a bit to big to be comfortable in a 34 band) in higher end brands, I would suggest going for a 34 from Amazon Essentials. I am on the last hook of a 34 in a Soma or Wacoal brassiere, and am on the tightest hook on this brassiere. So as the band inevitably stretches, it will be too large.

It washes well, and the covering of the cups remains smooth at 5 washes and counting. Hand or machine wash on delicate in a bra bag and air dry.

title: good fit, solid product
text:
This is the 4th magnetic bracelet I have bought recently. I have been intrigued by them and am at a point where I will try anything.

I have degenerative disc disease in my C5/C6 (neck), osteoarthritis in my neck and feet (at the very least) and psoriatic arthritis everywhere else. I have good days and I have bad days. Today, as I write this is a bad day, so I decided to wear this bracelet, which made me think, I had not sat down to review it yet.

I already eat a low sugar, fairly healthy diet and I try to walk and run, as well as stretch and body weight train to keep my joint and body from rebelling against me even more than they already do. I try and take herbs such as turmeric, mushrooms, MSM, etc to keep inflammation down. Every little bit counts.

The jury is really out with magnetic bracelets, some people love them, some people do not notice a difference. Does it work? Is it psychosomatic? I guess to each his/her own. For me, I believe it does help a little. I think it also served as a reminder to me that I just have to plain take care of myself.

The bracelet is lovely and actually fits my wrist. For a female, I am average in size, about 10 pounds overweight, but I have a large bone structure whether I am thin or not. I have one cuff bracelet that fits perfectly, one that was too big and I had to give it to my husband and this one, which is cuff. I have it bent just right where I can get it on and off, but it fits not overly loosely on my wrist.

It is 8.5" long and about 1/2" wide.

I purchased this discounted in order to review it honestly, which was a pleasure. It fits good, it looks good, and feels good. The retail price is a good value considering the price of copper these days. I could recommend this to someone looking for this sort of thing.

title: Decent concept, poor in practice
text:
If you are like me, you were browsing for barbering/hair assessories and you accidentally tripped over this item like “ooooh what’s this”. I will urge you now, if your expectations are high, lower them to save your self from the emotional power trip. If your expectations are low already, just save yourself the money and frustration and keep on browsing. You are just like me: looking for a convenient way to avoid messy barbering and cleaning. Well, this isn’t it.

Firstly, the material is very meager. Folding and storage is not intuitive. The attempt in manufacturing is admirable but not impressive. If you aren’t too strict on that, note that the design doesn’t reliably “umbrella” to catch the hair; at least not all the time. The straps that connect to the next that would fulfill the “umbrella” function should be adjustable to ensure this; otherwise, it looks more like a “plate”.

Here’s the part where you and I neglect: if and after you’ve managed to cut the hair and it all lands perfectly in the “umbrella”, how do you get it out and into the trash can without making too much of a mess? That there is the mystery, for there are no instructions. This debacle all rests on your creativity. The hair doesn’t simply slide off the material and into the trash, considering that hair texture is not universal. Some may be greased and oily and others dry. Nonetheless, it’s not coming out of the umbrella without a fight! Conclusively, if you were to conduct an experiment where you cut and clean-up using the old cape and allowing the clippings to hit the floor (using a vacuum or broom) vs. “the new way”, you will not see a significant improvement in convenience in the latter. I used a vacuum to clean the item (because dumping in the trash was not so simple due to the product’s design) and I felt that the old-fashioned cape and floor caused me less grief.

The product concept is attractive for its novelty, but the design is impractical compared to the traditional approach. In closing, just use the old barbering cape; let the hair fall to the floor...and use a vacuum.

title: The thickest I’ve found yet!
text: I’ve been on a search for some thick socks to help make my diabetic feet feel some relief and these are the thickest ones I’ve found so far! They are fantastic! My only regret is there were only three pair in this pack! These are probably the first piece of clothing that you could honestly answer yes to if someone asked…  “Do these make my ‘feet’ look fat?” And that is a good thing! I don’t know how important it is to know, but I wear a 10.5 in shoe size and these fit like they should.  I learned with socks like these, it is best to sit down, roll them up along your thumbs till you only have the top toe part of the socks remaining and slide them over your toes and up your foot. It may not be as easy to put on as cheap socks, but they don’t perform like cheap socks either! Your feet are important to your health and you should put some extra time and effort into them!

title: Well-constructed fashion jewelry gold chain that wears beautifully! Strong links, secure clasp, resists kinking and tangling.
text:
Benevolence LA Gold 24” Necklace Chain

Ordering fashion jewelry is typically an iffy thing to do online – it’s difficult to tell from listing pictures how the piece will look/wear in real life. Benevolence LA takes all of the guess work out ordering a high-quality fashion necklace chain online for me.

This 1mm box chain necklace is not only gorgeous, it’s actually prettier in person than it looks online. The stainless steel chain is expertly finished with 14k gold and is virtually indistinguishable from a high-end solid gold box chain. The chain has a mid-size link that is suitable for either men or women and is perfect for hosting any size pendant. Smoothly finished links resist kinking and the well-finished ends keep my hair from getting tangled in the chain. The jump ring appears to be soldered closed – versus fold-over crimped– this makes a HUGE difference in how strongly a chain wears and is my favorite feature of this chain. The lobster claw style clasp opens smoothly and closes securely. I have only worn this necklace for two days but I showered with it on and wore it to bed both days and it’s still perfect: if I notice any decrease in appearance/strength over the next few months I will update this review. The necklace chain arrived in a cute cardboard box and combined with the socially responsible mission of Benevolence LA it makes it a feel-good product to buy and to receive.

I received the Benevolence LA Gold 24” Necklace Chain at a promotional cost in exchange for an unbiased review and love the strength of the chain, the craftsmanship and integrity of the links, and the easy-to-fasten but secure lobster claw clasp.

I have worn it most indoors while at my computer where it is cool enough and will be wearing it EVERYWHERE this fall and winter. This is a knit beanie with a fleece lining so it is perfect for cool or cold temperatures. I can't wait to try this out at the beach soon, the nights on the pier can get chilly. The sound is good with clear mid tones and plenty of volume. My hat size is a 7 1/2 and this fits me well. The controls are easy to use and I have had no trouble pairing the Bluetooth to my Samsung Galaxy or computer. The lining is zippered so that the headset can be removed for washing. I have had consistent connections at up to 24 feet.

I think this beanie with headset is a great idea and this one is put together exceptionally well. This will be the perfect cold weather fishing cap for me when the steelhead run this winter. I have not used this for phone calls but for music it sounds good. If you are used to wearing beanies and are looking for one that you can also listen to music with – this is the one you want. I am quite happy with this and will be purchasing others as gifts.

I received the Soundbot SB210 Smart Beanie at a discounted cost in exchange for an unbiased review and would definitely recommend it!

title: Gorgeous 24” gold plated rope necklace – indistinguishable from the real thing!
text:
[[VIDEOID:fe9b7a5dbb58040a32986f40f21c783f]] [[VIDEOID:88b9c2e011f4a444f1f360732104a086]] Rope Chain Necklace 14k Gold Plated 4mm

I’m typically not a huge fan of fashion jewelry – it’s not that I don’t love the variety of styles, I do – but for my entire life every time that I wore plated or filled jewelry my skin would either break out or get a weird green cast under the piece. The Look Real Jewelry is one of the only fashion jewelry lines that I can wear that doesn’t irritate my skin, and it doesn’t leave any skin discoloration. It’s a total win that the LR jewelry is stunning and looks exactly like fine jewelry!

The Look Real Jewelry Rope Chain that I ordered is a 24 inch long braided rope necklace that weighs 28.2 grams. The chain is thick and strong. The ends are seated in high-quality catches that are attached to a lobster claw clasp. The clasp is well-sized, moves smoothly, and fastens securely. title: A nice looking watch
text:
This watch is overall a nice decent watch and I like wearing it.
When It first came in I immediately had to take off about 5 T bars because it was too big for my hand.
Thankfully it came with a little tool to make the process much easier.
After removing the T bars the watch fit very nicely and wasn't overly heavy. Its a great looking watch for going out and could easily look more expensive than it is.

Lets start with the PROS.
I like the thickness and weight of the watch. Easy to wear all day but over time it does get annoying because of the metal band.
It appears to keep the time well and in sync with my phone. Time will tell though if it will stay this way.
The design is very nice and looks more expensive than it actually is.
The Other dials do work but more about them in the Cons.
Date ring is nice and not too flamboyient

CONS.
It sometimes snags at my wrist hairs and that's annoying.
The sub-dials are not idea and or quality at that.
The 1/10 second hand will rotate about twice or 3 times and then will stop while the seconds and minutes will go on.
When you try to reset the sub-dials they sometimes won't work and then when they do the 1/10 sec will never stop at 00. I don't know why but its annoying so I just don't use them.
It looks like it would be nice to have but over all I think they are useless.

Overall I think its a nice watch and good for just telling you the time and date. It has class and I like that. 4/5 for the sub-dials not working right.

title: Stylish and comfortable.
text:
Sometimes you just need a practical watch for everyday classy looks. This watch fits the style and class and on the plus side its not expensive. That doesn't mean though that its cheaply built and will fall apart. From my inspection of the glass to the clips and the mechanism that's inside.
The watch has been functioning very well for some time now and it clearly tells the time accurately. The date is easy to read and large.
The band is not normal for me as I like to have the classic leather bands more but this was the stainless steel mesh which was soft of the wrist and comfortable for all-day wear.
I had no problem wearing the watch for over 8 hours.
Really for the cost and function, I can't find a reason to give it any cons. It even came with a little tool to adjust the strap length. Even the box was very nice and easily a great gift for anyone this holiday season.
I can't say what the battery power will be but I hope it won't die quickly as other reviewers have mentioned.
Looking forward to wearing this watch more often.

title: So many uses
text: This organizer is very easy to assemble. It has a lot of customizable options for shelf height, and even some removable trays at the top. It was packaged very well and there was no obvious damage. I would like to note that there were very faint lines throughout, but they looked like it was part of the manufacturing process. They're not very noticeable, but they are identical throughout the middle base. The base revolves 360 degrees easily. Everything slides into place easily and there are some places where you need to use tiny silicone bands(provided) to secure it all together. Nothing really "clicks" into places, which is god because if you wanted to move something around, it would be harder without trying to break it. The little silicone bands are easy to put on and remove so that you can move a shelf if needed. This is a really nice stand that can hold a lot.

title: SO COMFORTABLE I FORGOT I WAS WEARING THEM!
text:
These are great for flowy shirts, that are not skin tight. They work great. The only reason I say not with skin tight shirts is it left a big ring around my nipple region that you could see through the shirt. And not white either, haha! I put on a white tank top and couldn't stop laughing. BUT for something like a summer dress or maxi, these are amazing. Very comfortable, I actually woke up the next day and went to take a shower and realized i slept in them and didn't even realize it until I saw myself in the mirror. So VERY comfortable, feels so much like real skin, I didn't even notice they were still on. They adhere really well, and have kept their tackiness. I just kept the little plastic box it came in to make it easy to store in my dresser. I've worn them a few times now and so far no trouble out of them minus the white shirts and skin tight shirts. I included some pictures (in clothes) so that you could see what I'm talking about. Overall, I would recommend these to a friend. I wish you couldn't see them through a shirt, but I'm thinking that might be the case with any nipple cover.

title: Cute but not very durable.
text: Please read before you buy: this material is Modal which should definitely be considered and researched before you purchase it. Modal is a blend of rayon and cotton made from cellulose. I won't go into detail but I do believe that should be stated as a warning due to the double dose of the you'll be wearing. As far as sizing, rayon is a form of spandex and cotton shrinks, this isn't as fitted due to the cotton but it will hug your curves. Also, you should  ALWAYS hand wash in cold water and hang dry rayon. The elastic waistband is just below the bust all the way around the shirt, the bottom does flair somewhat. The XL fits like a women's petite small or junior's medium. I'm 5'5, 141pds. (36D,28,39) The neckline is extremely cute, the sleeves are are long which I like and the hemline ends just above my bottom. Unfortunately, I've already cut a good deal of increasing amounts of loose stitching from the inside and out, so I don't think it will last long. It's cute, I just wouldn't buy it again.

title: Just Awful
text: I've ordered from Gem Stone King in the past and have always been satisfied.  This item was horrible in every way.  The main problem was the large and ungainly clasp which didn't work right.  It was hard to open and hard to close, and the ring on the other side barely fit around it.  The white beads looked like freshwater pearls but the pink beads looked very plastic, like a child's cheap necklace.  The strands were large and ungainly, not delicate at all.  I didn't mind having to twist them myself, but I did mind that it looked like I had a pink and white sausage ring around my neck.  Finally, the workmanship was dreadful.  As if the clasp wasn't ugly enough, the cheap looking strings used for the beads were all sloppily knotted at the clasp, with straggly ends sticking out all over.  I have purchased a lot of necklaces at craft shows and I have never seen anything put together as badly as this.  Really Gem Stone King, if this were the first time I had ever ordered from you, it would be the last time!  Returned it.

text: Perfect post-mastectomy bra. I put it on 48 hours after surgery and was very pleased-- it doesn't look medical like the hospital bra did, it's got enough support, and is stretchy so I can put it on without raising my "bad" arm over my shoulder. Doesn't dig in underneath the breast where the incision is, and is long-lined enough to cover the drain and not allow it to move around. Did I mention it doesn't look medical? I am so eager to return to any kind of normalcy that having something lacy and pretty and "normal" made a big difference. I'm 5'2" 145 lbs usually a 34B and the L fit great. I got this as a gift for my boyfriend, only to find out (before giving it, thankfully) that he "Couldn't see what all the Bob Ross fuss was about and, frankly, finds it weird." Ok, killjoy, I kept the set for myself, and I'm absolutely enamored with them. Three people already stopped me, pandemic be damned, just to ask where I got the pins.

They look even nicer in person than they do in the photo and that happy little tree catches the light really nicely. I read that some folks found the quality lacking from pins they'd gotten in the past from this seller. Since I've never bought pins from this seller before, I thankfully didn't have any basis for comparison and I am overall very pleased with them. Boyfriend is going to regret his carelessly callous comments when he sees these babies shining on my lapel.

They DID lose one star, only because i felt the backing (The little thing that holds the pin in place) feels like it may come loose easily. If I'm wrong, I'll come back and give back the star.

EDIT: I returned to this pin set its rightful 5th star. Not only have the pins stayed firmly in place, they don't even rotate much from the pleasing angle at which I originally pinned them. Five stars, guys

They're freaking adorable. I don't even know how to paint. My happy little trees look like green blobs.

I have a larger head, size 7 1/4. These fit me fine without being too tight. They ride well on the nose and don't tend to 'let go' and come off when I get sweaty.

That the lens rides a bit higher and away from the face than normal sunglasses means that it is less likely to fog up when wearing a mask. You can still fog them, of course, but you have some additional buffer distance (or at least I do when wearing them with a mask).

Product came as described with the glasses, semi-hard zippered case, nylon bag, and lens cloth.

I have yet to drop them on the concrete to see how well the lens handle it, but will report back when that happens.

title: Extremely light weight sunglasses
text:
These were inexpensive and their extreme light weight is reflected by this. That sounds a bit misleading, but I have my doubts that these classes will last for very long as they are on the flimsy side. HOWEVER, they work very well and I do like them.

The benefits of such lightweight and inexpensive glasses are that they are a great consideration for when you want to wear sunglasses but you don't want to damage or loose your expensive sunglasses to your activity (boating, climbing, work, etc.).

These create absolutely no nose bridge strain from being too heavy.

These easily flex to fit fat heads like mine.

There are problems with being too light and that is you can run the risk of having them blown off your head in a high wind. This is a problem with all glasses and the lighter the glasses, the more apt this is to happen.

Also, they are advertised as being polarized and testing for polarization by rotating the lens of one pair over the lens of another pair should result in an opaque image as the polarization crosses when held up to a light source. I do notice a slight change of lighting when trying this, but the image does not become opaque, indicating that the polarization is extremely weak. Polarization works to reduce glare and being so lightly polarized, these don't appear to do much for reducing glare beyond that of regular sunglasses.

------

Now updating my review. I have been wearing these for months. I thought they would break and be trash. So far, none have broken. They ride comfortably on the nose for many hours because they are so light. I really like this a lot. The price was great as well. I still have all four pairs, two ride in cars, the yellows I wear as safety classes when doing yard work. The last pair is a spare.

title: Super Sparkly!!
text: This necklace is excellent! I did not expect it to be as heavy as it is! There are three strands of microbead that transition into the larger beads around the bottom, then it goes back into the microbeads for the knot at the end and back into the larger beads at the bottom on the dangly part. These beads truly are super sparkly!! They catch the light from every single direction and reflect a beautiful sparkle back on each and every bead. This necklace looks like it has had a lot of love and care put into it because everything is very even and uniform, not one bead was out of place. My order arrived a little late due to some shipping errors so I was very concerned that it was going to end up arriving broken, even through all of the shipping errors it was still in perfect condition, it is very durable!! It is a little on the heavy side in comparison to costume jewelry but I love the weight of it! The very end of the necklace hit right at the top of my belly button so it is a long necklace, I'm 5'9 so I don't have a short torso. If you do have a short torso you might have to just wrap the necklace around twice or find a way to adjust the length, that is just my opinion though. I love this necklace and would absolutely buy it again anytime!!

title: Love The Size & Style Of This Purse!
text:
[[VIDEOID:936db1d1e1598ccfc292e3b798009e21]] I really like the size and style of this YALUXE Triple Zipper Purse. YALUXE was formerly Yahoho and have updated their brand name. However, the quality and make of their items is the same as before and nothing is lacking in the quality aspects. I am one of those people who like an organized purse and to know where everything is from the day I change them out. This one has numerous pockets and compartments but not too many so I can easily remember and find where I placed everything.

The main compartment on top opens and closes with a metal zipper. There is a leather pull on it to make it easier to grab and unzip. Inside there is a large compartment for your items and also a few others. There is a small zipper compartment on the wall of one side and on the other side, there are 2 small pockets on the wall. One of those is a little larger than the other. You may be able to slide your phone into the larger one depending on the type and size of your phone which is a great place to keep it.

The next 2 zipper compartments under that one are just open storage areas with no additional pockets inside. These both also have metal zippers with leather pulls on them and all zippers open and close freely without any sticking at all. The whole purse is nicely lines with a fabric lining which is really a nice thickness. It's definitely durable and will last.

On the outside, you have one last zipper pocket on the one side which is metal with the leather zipper pull. This is a smaller pocket which works great for keeping your keys handy or your phone as well. This has a removable shoulder strap which is adjustable. It adjusts easily and will adjust to a length of around 47" when extended fully. There are nice little clamps on the ends to hook onto the rings on the purse. They don't stick either and hold securely. The strap is long enough to carry as a crossbody too which I like to do from time to time. One thing I want to mention that I really liked about this purse strap compared to the many others that I own and use, is that this one is leather on 1 side and then a nylon on the other. I have noticed that with it being this way, it hardly ever slides off my shoulder where I have to place it back up there. The nylon kind of "grips" onto your clothing and isn't as slippery as the leather is. It's nice and flexible too.

The bottom is a flat bottom so when you set your purse down, it doesn't fall over or tip. Lastly, there is a small leather "keychain" attached on this which is removable. Basically it is of the leather that this purse is made of and same color. It is a genuine leather and you can use the key holder for holding like a spare house key or something light since it's just on one of those ball-type chains. Overall, I love this purse, the quality and the size. I am able to keep everything in it I want and still have a little bit of spare room. My husband always picks on me how heavy my purse is and how much I carry in it but this really does hold a lot. I would recommend this and love the pink color!

title: Cute Bras! Combination Between a Bra & Sports Bra Style!
text:
[[VIDEOID:c99c59a5c96e185d5acd7fcc9d38727d]]This 3 pack of Lace Bralettes is kind of combination between a bra and sports bra in my opinion. They are all lace including the back. The back is a sports bra style and there are no hooks. The shoulder straps are lace as well and have some elasticity to them. The straps are not adjustable. The cup area is lined on the underside with a cotton material. That is the only "padding" if you even want to call it that. It's not thicker like padding so I would say it a lining. These do have underwire in them.

These are a very pretty style and have a nice look when on. My daughter wears a 38C bra and I ordered the XL for her and they fit her around the back and in the cup area. The shoulder straps worked good for her too and do not slide down on her. Over many times of wearing, I could see that the straps may possible stretch out but if that happens I will be sure to update this for you to let you know.

Seeing how these looked on her and being a C cup, I don't think these would fit a larger size breast. These don't have much support even though they are underwire. I think it's due to them being all lace. My daughter said they are comfortable but she almost feels like when she bends over she's gonna slip out of the cup area.

The only issue I noticed with these as far as quality goes is the straps. There are some threads/fuzz on the side of all the straps (I show this in my video). I think it's just because of them being lace because it's not like they are falling apart or unraveling or anything. Overall, they are a pretty style and a decent quality. Definitely not a VS quality but I wasn't expecting that when I ordered them.

title: Very Nice Quality With Lots Of Room!
text:
[[VIDEOID:24c1374626425ac5eb12c761fa2b1189]] This Hobo Style Purse by DDDH is made from a PU (Synthetic) Leather but it's a very nice quality and if I didn't know it wasn't genuine leather, I would probably think it was. I ordered the Claret Red (Wine) color and it's a real nice shade. You can carry this purse in 1 of 2 ways. It has carry handles you can use or else there is a removable shoulder strap which is adjustable.The shoulder strap just hooks on with a clasp on each end. The clasps are easy to open and attach and hold nice and snug.

On the front of the purse there is a zipper pocket which is a gold metal zipper with a tassel pull attached which gives you something to extra to open and close the zipper with. The pocket is fabric lined with a nice lining and is good for holding your keys or cell phone. There are 2 small rivets and a gold name plate attached on the pocket which just dress it up some. On the back side you have another zippered pocket but this one is a plastic zipper and there is no pull on it. It is also fabric lined though.

The top main compartment zipper is a full length plastic zipper. On the inside you have 2 larger compartments with a zipper compartment in the center of them. The inside is all nicely lined with fabric and the lining is sewn very well and nice thickness. On the one wall you have a small zippered pocket and on the other side wall you have 2 sewn in wall pockets with one being a little larger than the other. Depending on what type and size phone you have, you may be able to store your phone in the larger one.

All the zippers work well and I have not had any issues with them sticking or separating. All the hardware on the purse is gold color. There are buckles on the outer sides which are there for dressing it up. The bottom of the purse is flat so when setting it down on the floor or a table it will stand up without tipping over. Overall, this is a nice quality purse with a lot of storage room inside. It is soft and not stiff at all. I am very pleased with this and would recommend.

title: Soft and comfortable.
text:
Let's keep things short.

As my headline reads, these are soft and comfortable. The socks offer a bit of compression in the arch, but if I'm honest I barely noticed that. It's not a high enough compression to be a factor, at least not in my eyes (or feet, as it were).

I must point out the cuff of these socks. Have you ever gone running and had your sock droop a bit and you had to pull it up out of your shoe? No? Oh. Well, I have and it's annoying.

These socks have a slight cushioning at the back of the cuff and I initially thought it was weird. After running around for nearly 6 hours yesterday, I now think it's genius because my socks didn't droop down into my shoe at all! Kudos to these guys for this simple, effective design.

I received 6 pairs of various colors at about $13, which I think is a good deal. I did notice that single-color 6-packs run closer to $16. Unless you absolutely need them to all be the same color, I'd save yourself a few bucks; $13 is just about the perfect price for these, in my opinion.

Regardless of that, though, they're quality and comfortable. I recommend them.

title: Cheap, cheap, cheap.
text: I purchased the purple pendant.  What a mistake!  When you go cheap, you get cheap.  The "turquoise" in this pendant is not veined nor is it "chunky" looking as you are led to believe from the pictures.  The pendant also looks considerably larger on the mannequin's chest than it really is.  The dimensions are listed; however, the pendant's  large bail  is included in the sizing.  Also, the picture shows the turtle's back to be solid silver.  Mine is hollow and shows the "stone."  I purchased a matching stone bracelet from this same company.  It appears to be of better quality, i.e. it's heavier and has a little more veining; however, I will be retuning both items as they were intended as a set.  The nicest thing about this pendant is the included silver chain.  Suggestion:  the Amazon Collection has a gorgeous 18k yellow gold over sterling silver genuine jade turtle with included chain for $36.37.

title: Very basic flawed minimalistic design.
text: Brigada's black watch with a white second hand is  a very basic theme for a watch display. Not the most exciting of minimalistic watches, but it does have an automatic movement. There are no numbers on the watch dial, the hour marks are on the bezel with impressed lines in the metal and are hard to read. The hour hand is in black which blends into the black watch dial and it is very hard to tell the time in low light or indoors, if Brigada had made both hands in white contrasting the black background it would be a much better design. The strap is a two piece construction that is glued together and with my experience will not last long before it starts coming apart and will need to be replaced. I like minimalist watches which have become a growing trend, but as it stands this watch is to basic, nice try as an art piece but not a very good watch.

title: Elegant minimalist watch, recommended.
text:
Large watch has a nice case and dial design. The watch is easy to read with a black dial. Interesting seconds hand is made as a smaller subdial in gold with its own time bars, which gives you a different way to read the time. I have seen reviews that list watch movements getting slow or non-functioning within days of purchase, this is because the BATTERY is old and needs to be replaced in my experience, not because the watches movement isn't working.

The wristband is two piece vinyl construction that is comfortable on your wrist. However, I did not like the white stitching which looked very tacky. I had some problems with the watch band buckle adjustment, the end of the strap broke and the buckle came loose. The wristband is constructed with thin strips of vinyl over foam rubber. I had to replace the wristband with another band that was made with solid leather construction and would hold up with prolonged use.

title: Fits small, not warm, awkward down jacket
text:
I own two other down jackets by Orolay so I am familiar with their sizing. I love their balance in price and quality and I've developed a brand confidence with them. If I'm happy with my other down jackets, why did I buy this one? The style! Well, in order to carry this style, the jacket can't be too roomy or you would lose the trendy, fitted look. I am 5'4" 125lbs in average shape and I wear US size small or medium. My other two Orolay jackets are in small, but I ordered a medium for this one per other reviews. I find the medium is still snug.

The jacket arrived in a plastic zip bag. As soon as I took it out I knew it was not made with the same level of quality I'm familiar with. The shell is thinner than my other jackets. The down fill felt thin too. I hung it up to air to allow it to decompress fully and unwrinkle. After a few days I checked on it and it did not change my initial thoughts. I decided to test it out on a 40° day with a little breeze given its lightness, I did not feel warm! My other two Orolay down jackets would have made me sweat. The only closure are snap buttons, no zippers, so I think cold air gets in easily in between. Also, the buttons snapped off easily; when I got into my car, the bottom two unsnapped. When I walked, the bottom most one unsnapped. Cold air could easily travel up from the bottom. We've had some really blustering weather this season in the Northeast and my other Orolay jackets protected me well, with some smart layering of course.

More on the buttons... Because of the asymmetrical design, there are a lot of awkwardness with the button placements. In order to be sure I'm lining up the buttons right, I have to start from the bottom. Once I get to the neck, I have to feel around to find the button. If I leave the top unbuttoned, the look is weird and sloppy. The buttons are sewn through so the stitches are visible inside the jacket. That's not an issue; however, the button in the pocket area should not have been done this way because the pocket got sewn through! I was cold and I tried to keep my gloved hands in my pockets. The left hand had to be extra careful because of fear of ripping the stitching out from the inside of the pocket for that button that is sewn through! The left pocket is usable but it is oddly shaped inside due to a slight blockage with the button stitching. It's roomy enough to fit my wallet or phone, but not deep enough for fear of things falling out. Also, I think there's a worksmanship issue, the fabrics were not lined up right when sewning in that trouble button because the fabrics is not straight there.

In sum, I think this jacket material and style combination is too ambitious and it failed in the end to satisfy functionality. Disappointingly, I returned it and did not try a large because I would lose the fitted look.

title: Received a different dress, but color and size are true
text:
I ordered the dress in navy size medium, but I received a totally different dress of same size and color with lace and pleated collar instead. I tried it on anyway just to check the size so that I know if the fit is good when I return the wrong dress and reorder the proper one again. So I am not really reviewing the right dress here; however, I am commenting on the brand's sizing and material. I did find the listing for the dress I received in case if you're interested: Miusol Women's 1950S Style V Neck Cap Sleeve Flare Lace Cocktail Party Dress (http://a.co/aPcyNVf).

I find the size to be true. The navy is what I would expect. The cutting is flattering. Workmanship is better than expected given the price point. I would definitely look for other dresses under this label for inexpensive stylish fashion. However, I would like to comment that if I were looking for the lace version, I probably would return it because the lace is not the classy type. The lace is what gave away the cost of the dress. I would not wear it to a nice party. The style is good for the occasion but not the material. I would order a lighter color and wear it during the day instead as the lace material suggests casual. It's a pull over type of wear, no zipper. It's thick enough to wear alone.

title: So many compliments on this dress!!
text: I bought this dress to use as a Halloween costume with the hope that I would like it wear as a dress outside of Halloween.  It did not disappoint.  I did a lot of research reading through the reviews before i purchased it and I was very happy with my choice.  I received so many compliments on the dress and how it looked and fit.  I used it twice, as 50's Rockabilly and also a sugar skull.  I am 5'7'' 245 pounds and a 38 DDD bust.  I ordered the XL and it fit great.  I generally where a XL in normal everyday clothes or a size 16. I was not able to wear a bra with it mainly for the cut.  It came just below the knee without the petticoat, right at the knee with the petticoat.  The material was a good thick cotton as described in the prior reviews.  The only reason that I could not give this dress 5 stars is because of the zipper.  It is one of the zippers that is small and hidden so they are kinda hard to zip especially if you are doing it by yourself and the stretch panel in the back does not aid in the zipping process.  I feel this would not be an issue if you have some one to zip it for you however I did not.  I ended up putting on the dress over my head fully zipped and just pulled it down.  I did not like the ribbon belt that came with it, I would have liked something a little thicker.  Over all I loved the dress and so did everyone else.  I will be buying another in a different color.

I was really excited when I ordered these earrings, they just looked so pretty and shiny and I loved the design. I couldn’t wait for them to arrive. Then the disappointment set in when I opened the package…ugh. They honestly look very dull and cheaply made. Hardly anything like the ad picture. The cardboard box and plastic bag was literally just like what you would get at that store that begins with a W and ends in mart. My husband said if he had paid that kind of money to give these as a gift to me and this is what came and in the cheap packaging? He’d be so angry. So, moving right along…
There is no shine, no sparkle at all. I put one in just fine. When I put the other in I had just a bit of trouble getting the back on. I tried again and nothing. I took it out and the post was bent! Hardly any pressure, just from trying to put the back on and the post bent, not good. I easily bent it back in place but at this point I thought it was going to break off. I finally got it back in and all was good. They haven’t hurt my ears at all and I’ve worn them for 3 days.
It’s a nice design and they are not ugly; they are just very overpriced to me and not at all what you think you’re getting.

title: Cheap softshell fabric, overall fairly well made, light to medium weight. Zipper is in backward.
text:
Approximate measurements: Black size Medium
Chest: underarm to underarm 24"
Length: front shoulder to hem 27", back top of collar to hem 30.5"
Shoulders: across back sleeve seam to seam 19.5"
Sleeve length: underarm to cuff 19.5", shoulder seam to cuff 25.5"
Waist: across banded hem side to side unstretched 18"

My husband wears size large in basic t-shirts, fruit of the loom, Haynes etc, and the medium jacket fit well. Loose enough for easy movement but not so baggy that it looked oversized. It's a light-medium weight jacket, more than a windbreaker but less than a medium weight. The softshell outer fabric is a cheap version and more like a water repellant polyester or nylon style. I think the softshell fabric has a thin lining/backing between the actual lining because it has an almost 'puffy' feel to it. Due to the style and fit it's definitely a men's jacket but like other reviewers have noted, the zipper is backward so it zips like a woman's jacket. It came out of the plastic packet with a chemical smell which I'm hoping will go away after washing. Overall it appears to be a cheaply but fairly well made jacket which will be good for fall and possibly early mild winter with a sweater. I rated in 3 stars, it lost stars due to the cheap style softshell, backward zipper and would have looked better with basic black or grey lining.

I typically wear a comfortable size 6 in American Eagle jeans and the size 4-6 in these pants was a pretty good fit. Not tight or biding in the waist or butt, relaxed through the leg. The rise is kind of high and comes up to my belly button. The inseam/length is a few inches too long for my 5'6" height but there is a tie at the ankle to cinch them in. Loads of functional pockets. Fabric is midweight and feels durable, no stretch. Overall I'm happy with the fit and quality.

**Update: cold wash and hot dryer with a small amount of shrinkage. Waist 15” and Inseam 32.75”.
Also, the pocket flaps creased and warped during washing and won't lay flat. The press snaps hang on the ends of straps/laces which are too long. Even with the pockets all wrinkled up, they easily reach to snap closed but the pockets are gaping open. Even when the flaps are ironed flat and snapped closed they hang loose and are not securely closed. I can stick my hand in the pocket without having to unsnap them. I believe this is only a problem with the camo colors as the solid colors appear to be a different style. I originally rated these 4 star but dropped a star because of this issue.

title: Decent quality neck ties for a decent price.
text:
These ties are great if you are looking to add some different colors to your collection.

The material that these ties are made of is nice. It’s not super soft but it’s not super rough it’s just right in the middle.

One slight negative about these ties is that they wrinkle pretty easily. After wearing it all day (8-10 hours), it was pretty wrinkled. I assume this would be expected but I was not expecting it since the other ties that I own do not wrinkle as much as these do. It is definitely recommend to hang these ties up or roll them up when they are not being worn. If folded you might have to iron out the folds. I did have to iron out the fold by placing a light towel or sheet over the top and iron out the wrinkles but they came out fairly easily. Other than that there really isn’t anything else bad I would have to say about these ties.

I definitely recommend this box of neckties if you are looking for quality and variety. They are worth saving money to iron out a few folds if needed.

360 pieces spring bar pins with strap link pin remover and cleaning cloth

title: Manufacturing Malpractice
text:
First of all, I want to say this is a beautiful looking bracelet. I think it makes my Luminor really shine. The manufacturing is great (with a big exception I'll talk about in a second). It's a heavy, solid bracelet; it's doesn't rattle or feel cheap. It's easy to remove the links for sizing and it comes with two half links, so you can really fine tune the sizing. It has solid end links and fits the case of the watch well. In many ways, this bracelet is as good as any OEM steel bracelet I own. It has a fantastic, expensive feel in the hands.

So what's the problem? It's like wearing a bracelet made of thorns. For some reason, iStrap decided to leave all the edges sharp, like little knives. This is the least comfortable steel bracelet I own or have ever worn. After about an hour, my wrist is covered in welts. Why, iStrap, why? How hard would it have been to buff the edges down a little bit? I mean seriously, this is just manufacturing malpractice. A watch should not hurt to wear.

I'm going to get this thing to a buffing wheel and see if I can fix it. iStrap, if you're reading this, take a few seconds to buff off the sharp edges off these things. If you do, you'll have a five star product.

title: Most Impressive
text:
Surprisingly Comfortable

I have a small, modest collection of watches and am a bit of a nascent enthusiast. I’ve found that I have a hard time getting comfortable in leather bands, particularly with larger, heavier watches. They always creep up my wrist toward the elbow, or they are too tight, or watch twists around on my wrist. They always seem to get in the way. So in general, for big heavy watches I’ve stuck to steel bracelets which I find far easier to wear.

But, one of my watches (a Panerai PAM 111) is traditionally found on leather, so I wanted to try this band on it in place of the steel bracelet I was using. The PAM 111 is a huge, heavy watch, and the leather band that fits it is thick and stiff and 24mm wide. But somehow, this band is comfortable, the watch is riding on my wrist just right. In truth, I find this band to be more comfortable than the steel bracelet – a first for me.

The one hitch (at least for Panerai watches) is the quick release springbar that comes integral to the band: on most watches, it would be a godsend, because it allows you to change the band without any tools. The springbars on a Panerai actually screw into the case itself, and there are metal tubes that go inside the ends of the band to reinforce everything. It’s all a lot more heavy-duty than the traditional method of attaching bands, but you can’t use it with this band because cool tool-free springbar is sewn in. The band fits, but it’s just a couple of long springbars holding your watch on. Time will tell if that’s ok.

The band itself is handsome and well-finished. I wouldn’t call it super-luxury watch grade, but it’s definitely above the norm in construction and finishing. In fact, I find the price they are asking a little hard to believe, as to me this feels like about a $60-$80 strap.

The contrast stitching is even, with no loose ends. The exterior is top grain leather, firm and solid, while the inside is soft and feels almost like nubuck. The rectangular tang holes are well spaced so that I had no difficulty getting a great fit. The keepers look to be well made and shouldn’t fall apart as they do on cheap bands.

As for the hardware, I’ve already mentioned the integral quick release springbars. Since they are sewn in, you’re not going to lose them as can happen when working with regular springbars which have a tendency to shoot across the room and then hide. The removable buckle is polished on the top side and brushed and delicately signed on the underside. This may seem unimportant, but this exquisite and subtle signature tells me that the maker of this band took the time to get it right.

I’m impressed. I’ve tried half a dozen leather bands in this price range and well above it, and I’m beginning to believe the more expensive ones are not worth it, because judging from this sample, it’s possible to make an excellent band and still keep the price reasonable. This would be a five star band at twice the price.

title: Disappointing, Priced Wrong
text:
While this watch is decent, it doesn’t have the same value as other Chinese watches priced around $120. In fact, it’s more like a $35 watch, which is how much it costs if you buy direct. So right off the bat, I wonder why the $83 markup. If there is a difference between this and the same model number direct from the maker, the listing needs to explain what it is. The listing also says that it requires batteries, which of course is wrong. And while we’re talking about the listing, in one place it says that the crystal is sapphire, and in another it says Hardlex, which is a Seiko trademark for their proprietary mineral glass. My money is on it being mineral crystal, which is neither Hardlex nor sapphire.

Let’s talk about the good: according to my timegrapher, the movement is very accurate, coming in at about +10 seconds a day average, depending on position. With cheap automatic movements, you get what you get. You could be lucky, you could be unlucky. I got lucky. Also good, the bracelet has solid links, though the end links are hollow. The center links are polished, and side links brushed, which to me looks cheap, but it could be just the ticket for people with other perspectives. As far as removing links, the watch comes with a little poker, and poking out the pins was easy and satisfying. Once again, the bracelet (not the clasp) is pretty good.

Another good thing is the display back. I love seeing the movement, which in this watch is very utilitarian looking, except for the nicely decorated rotor. The movement, by the way, hacks and hand winds, but is a low-beat movement of only 21,600 bph. Not a big deal though.

Here’s what you don’t get that you often find on Chinese watches in this price range from companies like Pagani Design (which is by all accounts the same company as Benyar); for starters, the clasp is crude and primitive compared to other oyster-style bracelets they make which emulate the Rolex glide lock. There is no micro adjust function and no half-links, so sizing is not very fine-tuned. Also, for the money, you often find the links in the bracelet are screwed. Not here; it’s a simple pin setup. But, to be fair, the bracelet is comfortable and serviceable.

While the case is shiny and silvery, it does not appear to be stainless steel. Upon close examination, the surface of the case looks wavy and uneven, and I can only conclude it’s chromed brass or other base metal. Or maybe it’s just badly finished stainless. Not great. The bezel feels cheap and hollow, about the way bezels on $35 watches feel. There is back play in the unidirectional bezel to the tune of about four minutes, rendering the thing more or less ornamental. The whole thing in the hand is a little rattly, with a very audible rotor swoosh sound, in keeping with what you get from a $35 to $45 watch. The bezel insert, by the way, does not appear to be ceramic, as it is on other watches like this that cost this much. Rather, the bezel insert appears to be aluminum. The crown, by the way, is unsigned. It’s not a big deal, but another sign this watch is overpriced compared to what you can get.

Another disappointment is the lume. If you think the numerals 12 and 6 contain lume, so did I. But nope. Only the circular hour indices and the hands contain any lume, which is a lot less fun than it would be otherwise.

Finally, there’s the fit and finish, which is good for a $40 watch, but does not seem good enough for the price being asked. The end links where they meet the case have uneven gaps that look less than magnificent.

Lest I sound like I just hate Benyar, I should disclose that I have reviewed other Benyar watches that I loved. I think what happened here is the wrong price somehow got attached to this product, and it should be fixed.

metadata.title: Men's Watches Automatic Wrist Watch Scratch Resistant Synthetic Sapphire Glass Date Display Waterproof Men Watch Stainless Steel Watches (Green)

title: Really Nice, But it Rattles
text:
This is a pretty nice watch with some caveats.

The main issue is the bracelet, which, if not worn tightly, rattles like a toy on the wrist. I wear my bracelets loose, though. And, to be fair, a lot of automatic watches rattle as the rotor spins inside. This rattle, though from a different source (as it’s a quartz watch), isn’t any more annoying than that. In this case, the specific source of the rattling is at the end links, where the bracelet and the end links are not snug. When it rattles, it resonates through the case and produces a hollow metallic sound. When the bracelet is snug, the end links can’t rattle around loosely.

Other than that rattling, the fit and finish is fairly good for the price. The quality of the bracelet is about the same as a Seiko 5. The clasp is stamped and there’s a single-sided, spring-loaded release button. The links themselves appear to be solid. The bracelet is comfortable, with no sharp edges.

The case and bezel appear to be polished steel. The unsigned crown has no crown guards, but feels firm and solid, as do the chronograph pushers which also serve as crown guards here. The numerals appear to be printed and are not luminescent, but there are lume pips at every hour marker and on the hour and minute hands. As expected at this price point, the lume does not have the best longevity, losing its charge in an hour or so.

The thing about this watch is it looks amazing. It’s really a handsome watch in person. Perfectly sized, great design, easy to read (for a chronograph) and quartz accuracy all come together to make this watch a treat. And, aside from the rattling, the fit and finish are good.

If you plan to change the bracelet, or if you wear your watches fairly snug, I would recommend this watch. If you like to wear your bracelets a little loose, or have no intention of changing to a different strap, the rattling might be a deal breaker.

title: Torn Between 3 Stars and 2
text: I ordered 2 of these, one in XL and one in 2X. I am 5'4" and 163 lbs. I usually wear a large in tops. My first impression was disappointment, as the dresses I received (except for the stripes) look nothing like the one the model is wearing in the photograph here on Amazon. They are cut strangely and rather than slits on the sides, they have these huge, almost silly-looking U-shape cutouts. They have ordinary boat necklines, and if your shoulders aren't too broad, you'll be able to pull it down off a shoulder, but unless you're truly tiny, it will not hang way off the shoulder like it does on the model. The XL fit me well and looked slenderizing on me. The 2X did have a little extra fabric, and was baggier and less slenderizing on me than the XL. I gave it to a relative who is about 40 lbs heavier than me, and she fit it, although it doesn't really hang off her shoulder. I noticed that both the XL and the 2X have exactly the same size neck opening. I also noticed some sloppy stitching and broken threads. Only because of the very reasonable price, did I decide to keep it and wear it around the house. I may even get a couple more, (at this low price), because they do make nice house dresses and the fabric feels soft and comfortable.

title: Swiss watch companies seem to like to pair relatively large watches (40-43mm) with 20mm bracelets
text: This bracelet is designed for a big watch with 20mm lug spacing, which includes a lot of the high end Swiss brands.  For some reason, Swiss watch companies seem to like to pair relatively large watches (40-43mm) with 20mm bracelets.  I bought this brushed Engineer specifically for a TAG Heuer Formula 1 quartz that came with a bracelet of similar design to the Engineer, but the original TAG bracelet tapers in both width and thickness and looked too small for this particular watch.  The Engineer, in my opinion, is the perfect replacement.  Like the original TAG bracelet, the Engineer is square-ended to fit the hooded lugs of the Formula 1, but the Engineer maintains the same width and thickness along its entire length.  And because the Engineer has links with beveled edges, it doesn't look overly bulky for a watch that you might want to wear for both casual and sport.  Also, the Engineer has screw-pins holding the links together, so removing a link or two to adjust the bracelet length is very easy.  Only one small screwdriver is required, not two like on some bracelets.  (Tip- As long as you have that jeweler's screwdriver out to remove the links, test the remaining screw-pins to make sure they are sufficiently tight.  I found a couple of loose ones.)  Bracelet quality?  Solid steel links that are machined to the perfect tolerance to give the bracelet very good flexibility, and a very secure triple-locking clasp that feels very secure with solid clicks on closing, but with easy opening.  And, if that wasn't enough, this bracelet uses the really tough-looking 2.5 mm spring bars, much heavier than the usual bars.  I really like this bracelet.  Highly recommended.

title: Sure looks like the original
text:
From any distance, this looks for all the world like a real Speedmaster. I thought that, surely, the maker of the real "Speedy", with its iconic and unique design, would be seeking what the lawyers call injunctive relief. The case size is 42mm diameter and 14mm thick with 20mm lug spacing. Black dial with long, thin, high-viz white hands and three sub dials at or below the dial's horizontal center line. And the tachymetre scale on the fixed bezel is the real deal, although I doubt many people will take the time to learn how to use it. (I didn't and probably won't learn how to use it, but I understand that it's used in conjunction with the chronograph seconds hand to measure the speed of an object or person over a predetermined distance. So, a time/speed/distance calculator familiar to any blue-water skipper. )
Closer inspection of the watch will reveal lots of differences. Inside the case is a Seiko quartz movement, not a multi-jewel Swiss mechanical chronograph. The bracelet, with solid end links, closely resembles the real Speedy bracelet, but it's obviously of somewhat lesser heft and quality, especially the clasp. I can't comment on the comfort of the bracelet, because I replaced it with a rubber strap right out of the box. And the three sub dials, there's the rub. Different sub dial functions on the Pagani vs the Speedy. So, not to worry, Speedmaster, this Pagani Design 1701 is an homage to your accuracy and stellar aerospace history, not a clumsy stylistic ripoff.

text:
I WANT to give this dress a FIVE star review, but due to observed inconsistencies I cannot.

I ordered in multiple colors and sizes, and same size different colors, for a wedding. I had 3-4 days before the wedding, some of the dresses came on time, but some, after checking out, said they would arrive AFTER the 2 day prime shipping that was guaranteed. Thankfully, the last batch came the day before the event I needed them for. I had two other dresses lined up to choose from, and this one came and instantly canceled all of the others out!

I got the black dress...the color and print is lovely, the neckline fit great, and the length was perfect at the ankles. It looked great with black heels.

The issues, and minus 1 star: inconsistencies. I also ordered the same size in different colors, and though I was originally going to keep the green one for the event, it had too much material. Without a belt, all the dresses were too big, but especially the green. When belted, both looked great, but more/extra material bunched with the green, and not with the black. Like, multiple folds of material. The green belt (same belt for both) was too large, it never would have cinched the waistline, and overlapped when I tied it shut. The black dress belt fit, but wasn't quite cinching nicely. I ended up wearing a belt I already owned, which worked better than the one it came with.

My suggestion is to buy multiple dresses of the same size, because I don't think they will all be sewn the same. Then, return the ones that are sewn badly.

title: Add some fun glitz to your hair with this gorgeous, neutral toned, embellished headband
text:
I got a similar headband from this same company in turquoise and thought it was lovely, so I ended up ordering this black one for a more sedate but still beautiful option. I like how there are various styles of embellishments in a few neutral colors for added "texture." It makes the headband more visually interesting than beading done in one color in my opinion, but is not done over the top, so it still versatile in what you can wear it with. The quality is good with all the decorative beading and rhinestones sewn on rather than added as an appliqué. I was also pleased to discover (on the turquoise but this one has it too) that the actual headband used is metal, which I prefer because it's more sturdy so it stays in place better and more durable so it should not break easily.

Because it is a handcrafted piece, it does have a slight Etsy feel to it, like you can see some of the seams at the bottom where it was hand sewed closed. This might concern people who want "perfect" items, but I think it gives it a little more charm and it does not show anyway. The inside of the fabric has a contrasting white fabric that is cute, but I do wish a darker, more matching color was chosen because I can see a little on the bottom where it is sewn together. That part goes behind my ear so it probably would not be that noticeable but I do have concerns that some of the white might show depending on how I wear my hair or if the fabric shifts - my hair is black so bright white would definitely not blend in.

For the price it is being sold for, I think this handcrafted, metal headband with sewn on beading is a steal. You could maybe find something cheaper at an accessory store but with lesser quality, or you might see something similar at a boutique or department store, but I am sure that price would be far higher. If the contrasting fabric was a darker color, this would have been a 5 for me all the way, but I still recommend it as is - it is a beautiful, fun hair accessory that I think anyone who might be interested in the turban trend would enjoy.

title: NOT high waisted - low, low, LOW!
text:
I already have a multitude of leggings, but justified adding these to my stash because I wanted to try some with pockets for my phone. I was quite excited when they finally arrived and I could try them on, but unfortunately, these are a big NO for me.

I was afraid these might not fit because of "foreign" sizing, so I was pleased when these fit fine as I was pulling them up. Then, all of a sudden my "pull up" just stopped. Turns out these "high waist" pants are NOT high waisted at all! The rise on these aren't even normal waisted on me. Technically, the pants fit but they stopped so low that it gave me flashbacks of wearing low rise hip-huggers in the 90's. Not a look I want to bring back.

Maybe if they were normal pants, a waist that low might be okay, but for yoga? I could barely move without flashing someone, much less bend over and stretch around. Also, I'd be afraid to put my phone in the pockets (the ONE feature I was looking forward to!) because I'd have concerns that the weight would cause the pants to sag down further. Perhaps I needed to size up in these - the legs fit fine though, so even if a bigger size had ended up higher on me, they might have been too baggy in other areas. I'll probably pass this particular pair to someone smaller to see if that might help.

For anyone who is still interested in these (maybe low-rise lovers!), going up a size or two might be beneficial. Otherwise, I don't recommend these at all.
