title: Not a fan of the printed stars, but the t-shirt itself is comfy, lightweight and flattering
text:
When I took this t-shirt out of its bag, my initial reaction was that it seemed cheap, which made me surprised because I love esstive products and usually find them to be really great and high-quality. I guess first impressions are not always correct because I tried it on anyway and actually found it to be flattering and fit well. I did size up and the fit is similar to the model pictured, ever so slightly relaxed but fitted, so I would consider it to run small. It is stretchy, so people who want a snug fit could get their true size. I think the reason I was initially surprised was because I was expecting a thicker material - this t-shirt is soft and comfortable, but it is thin and somewhat sheer. Luckily, in combination with the fit, it does not cling or show off any rolls. I still think the stars DO look a little on the tacky side, but perhaps that is just a personal issue because screenprinting makes me think of cheap souvenir tshirts. There were no problems with the stars themselves though, no blurring or peeling.

While I personally do not love the print, this might be a comfy, fun option for people who do really love stars. I will still wear this one, but would likely not order any more printed options. However, since I did find this t-shirt to be lightweight, but substantial and flattering, I would consider ordering some plain ones if they are offered.

title: Liked these so much, this is my second pair!
text:
I have a cream colored pair of these slippers that I like a lot, so much so that when I saw that they also come in grey, I knew that I "needed" a second pair. Although the color is "grey," it has a blue/purple tone to it that I think is quite lovely. Just like my original pair, these are soft, plush and feel amazing on my feet! It does not seem to specify in the listing, but they are made of faux suede and what I assume to be fake fur as well, so they are likely a good option for vegans or people who prioritize not using animal products. The "suede" does not look bad, but it is obviously not real. I love that the fur, on the other hand, actually looks and feels like it could be the real thing - it is just as soft and cozy as the inner lining of my Ugg boots, but does not make my feet overly warm or cause them to sweat, like some faux materials often can. I also really like that they have a rubber sole, which does not make the slippers any less comfortable, but does add some structure, allows them to be used outside and makes them more durable! Compared to my soft soled slippers, I think these will last significantly longer.

I normally wear size 7.5-8 in most shoes, and these in a 7 fit perfectly. They fit snug at first, but stretch to fit quickly, within a few minutes of the first time wearing them, so they do have some leeway in sizing. A size 8 would probably be okay too, just slightly roomier. My other pair did arrive with some loose threads (which were not a problem at all after I simply cut them off), but this pair had no issues at all with its construction.

At the time of this review, no price has been added, so I cannot comment on their value, but I can say that recently, one of my favorite things to do when I got home was to take off my shoes and slip on my cream colored slippers, so now I am glad to have been able to add this pretty grey pair to the rotation! So yes, I think these "shoeslocker women's slippers" are quite wonderful [in any color!] and I would recommend them.

title: Lovely Cubic Zirconia Ear Vine Earrings
text:
This is a set of ear vine earrings 18K and the metal is brass-plated-gold. They are dainty and quite sparkly and to me quite lovely. I have never owned a pair of earrings with this type of hook. It is extremely comfortable and they are very lightweight. I really didn't even know I had earrings on while wearing them. I like earrings that are comfortable and easy to wear and these truly fit that bill.

These are approximately three-quarters of an inch long and not very wide. The design is unique starting with one small round crystal at the bottom and then there are five sets of triangles, each containing three sets of round crystals and then a pear shaped (or teardrop) crystal at the top making 17 Cubic Zirconia Crystals in each earring. I love them and plan to wear them anytime. They could be worn down if a person wanted to, but they are so dainty traveling up the ear. I'm very pleased with these earrings and believe they would make a very nice gift for someone and I wouldn't hesitate in recommending them.

text: I appreciate that this TSA approved, locking luggage strap is as simple, effective and well made as advertised. Those pictures are all about the size of the buckle, which you must manipulate around and through the triangular piece, rather than try to force it straight through, due to the buckle's width. title: Extra skinny legged pants & heavy
text: I chose this pant due to a magazine review that was quite favorable done by a short, stocky reviewer who normally wears a 38 waist. He ordered XXL for his fit and the photos showed a rather comfortable looking pant. After looking at the sizing charts, and making a few assumptions about the fit in respect to the two zipped-in liners, I figured my 33 waist would work with the XL. Sure, my waist worked just fine, however, I couldn't even pull the pant legs up over my legs with either one or both of the liners installed. It didn't make sense to buy a pair of pants that were well constructed, including the 2 liners, just to only wear the textile outer layer and relegate the liners to the "worst idea ever" box. The pants are nicely made, so 2 stars, but if you have any calf or thigh muscles at all, you most likely will not be able to wear the liners with the pants. If you get them on at all, good luck throwing your leg over the saddle and actually sitting comfortably. If you get a pair to fit over your legs, the inseam for someone under 170 pounds will most likely be pretty long, and the armor won't line up. I am an expert on my own opinion, which is based on personal experience(s). Others may disagree, but simply ordering a size or two larger will not cure the massive amount of material stuffed into the pant legs.

title: Why all the negative comments? THIS IS A GREAT COAT!!! Have Purchase a Second in White!
text: I read all the awful reviews on this coat, but took a chance and purchased it anyway. I am so happy I did. We live in St Louis and it has snowed here several times during the past week. This coat is warm, made remarkably well and I just can't figure out why all the negative comments. The fur trim comes separate and there was no issue with fur coming off when attaching to the coat, nor has there been any come off since. I will advise anyone that does purchase to upsize because it does fit small. I am 5'8" and 120 lbs. I wear a lot of oversized sweaters, so I purchased an XL, where I would often just purchase a M. It is so warm and the two outside pockets are deep and holds my beanie, gloves and ear muffs without even bulging out where it looks like they are stuffed to the gills. I would recommend anyone who lives in the colder areas to buy this coat. The price was exceptionally cheaper than a North Face or that type of coat. I love it and have just purchase the white one as well. Warm, durable, the hood is very large and covers your forehead and both sides of your face. You can even pull it back a ways and it won't fall down, still keeping your head warm and toasty. Excellent purchase!! Just remember to upsize to your desired outer wear (bulky sweaters, etc) and even when I'm not wearing something that bulky it still fits to a T!!!
